sentence1: International energy policy Over 70 per cent of Switzerland ' s overall energy supply depends on imports of fossil fuels and nuclear fuels from abroad . Even the country ' s electricity supply is dependent on imports , at least during the winter . Switzerland ' s high dependence on imports , the need to ensure security of supply and its climate targets make close cooperation with international energy organisations and foreign energy authorities indispensable . Regular talks are held with neighbouring countries at Federal Council and director level . The areas of cooperation range from security of supply and infrastructure to the promotion of renewable energies , energy efficiency matters and research cooperation . In the negotiations with the EU on an electricity agreement , Switzerland is prioritising the legal protection of its position in the European energy market . Furthermore , Switzerland is involved in multilateral bodies such as the International Energy Agency ( IEA ) , the International Atomic Energy Agency ( IAEA ) , the Energy Charter and the International Renewable Energy Agency ( IRENA ) , in which it participates as a member . sentence2: Politique \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique internationale L\u2019approvisionnement \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique de la Suisse d\u00e9pend pour plus de 70 % des importations de combustibles ou carburants fossiles ainsi que de combustibles nucl\u00e9aires . Son approvisionnement en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 , lui aussi , ne peut pas se passer des importations , du moins pendant les mois d\u2019hiver . En raison de cette forte d\u00e9pendance aux importations , de la n\u00e9cessit\u00e9 d\u2019assurer la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 de son approvisionnement et des objectifs climatiques qu\u2019elle s\u2019est fix\u00e9s , la Suisse doit collaborer \u00e9troitement avec les organisations internationales du secteur \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et les autorit\u00e9s \u00e9trang\u00e8res concern\u00e9es . Les contacts avec les pays voisins font l\u2019objet d\u2019un suivi r\u00e9gulier au niveau du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et de la direction de l\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019\u00e9nergie . La collaboration s\u2019\u00e9tend \u00e0 de nombreux domaines allant de la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 de l\u2019approvisionnement aux infrastructures , en passant par la promotion des \u00e9nergies renouvelables , l\u2019efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et la recherche . La pr\u00e9servation , au niveau juridique , de la position de la Suisse au sein du march\u00e9 europ\u00e9en de l\u2019\u00e9nergie figure au premier plan des n\u00e9gociations men\u00e9es avec l\u2019Union europ\u00e9enne pour un accord sur l\u2019\u00e9lectricit\u00e9 . La Suisse s\u2019investit \u00e9galement au sein d\u2019organismes multilat\u00e9raux comme l\u2019Agence internationale de l\u2019\u00e9nergie ( AIE ) , l\u2019Agence internationale de l\u2019\u00e9nergie atomique ( AIEA ) , la Charte de l\u2019\u00e9nergie ainsi que l\u2019Agence internationale pour les \u00e9nergies renouvelables ( IRENA ) , \u00e9tant donn\u00e9 qu\u2019elle peut y intervenir en tant que membre . sentence1: EU Partnerships The Swiss Federal Office of Energy , together with other national and European funding agencies and the EU Commission , promotes international cooperation between innovative universities , companies and organisations , end users and civil society to solve the challenges in the energy sector . With their participation , qualified Swiss universities and companies can help to shape international solutions and standards and link up with driving forces in these thematic areas . Innovative Swiss organisations thus benefit from integration in consortia that implement European solutions , as well as from the planned investments . To this end , the funding agencies team up and jointly launch calls for transnational projects . The funded projects receive the funds directly from the participating organisations in their country . European Partnerships With the launch of Horizon Europe , the various types of multilateral initiatives were brought together under one umbrella : the European Partnerships . Some existing initiatives , e . g . , ERA - Nets , will continue in their current form through to their completion , while others have been merged and will continue as partnerships . A number of new thematic partnerships were also launched . The partnerships bring together a wide range of stakeholders from research , innovation and the private sector to work towards a common goal . In particular , they want to have a social impact and make the best possible use of synergies with other national and regional initiatives . The Swiss Federal Office of Energy participates in both energy - related partnerships : Links Clean Energy Transition Partnership ( CETPartnership ) Driving Urban Transitions ( DUT ) Innosuisse Swiss National Science Foundation Last modification 15 . 08 . 2022
sentence2: Partenariats europ\u00e9ens L\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019\u00e9nergie encourage , avec d\u2019autres agences d\u2019encouragement nationales et europ\u00e9ennes ainsi que la Commission europ\u00e9enne , la coop\u00e9ration internationale entre les hautes \u00e9coles , entreprises et organisations innovantes , les utilisateurs finaux et la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 civile afin de r\u00e9soudre les d\u00e9fis li\u00e9s au domaine de l\u2019\u00e9nergie . Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 leur participation , les hautes \u00e9coles et entreprises qualifi\u00e9es peuvent contribuer \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9laboration de solutions et de normes et \u00e9tablir un r\u00e9seau avec les forces motrices dans ces domaines . Les organisations suisses innovantes b\u00e9n\u00e9ficient ainsi de l\u2019int\u00e9gration dans des consortiums qui mettent en \u0153uvre des solutions europ\u00e9ennes , ainsi que des investissements pr\u00e9vus . Les agences d\u2019encouragement s\u2019unissent dans ce but et lancent des appels d\u2019offres communs pour des projets transnationaux . Les projets financ\u00e9s per\u00e7oivent les fonds directement des organisations participantes dans leur pays . Partenariats europ\u00e9ens Les diff\u00e9rents types d\u2019initiatives multilat\u00e9rales sont r\u00e9unis sous un m\u00eame toit ( les partenariats europ\u00e9ens ) dans le cadre d\u2019Horizon Europe . Certaines initiatives existantes ( par ex . ERA - NET ) se poursuivent sous leur forme actuelle jusqu\u2019\u00e0 leur conclusion ; certaines ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9unies et poursuivies dans le cadre d\u2019un partenariat . De nouveaux partenariats , ax\u00e9s sur des th\u00e8mes sp\u00e9cifiques , ont aussi \u00e9t\u00e9 lanc\u00e9s . Les partenariats r\u00e9unissent un large \u00e9ventail d\u2019acteurs venant de la recherche , de l\u2019innovation et de l\u2019\u00e9conomie priv\u00e9e afin qu\u2019ils collaborent sur un objectif commun . Leur but est notamment d\u2019avoir un impact sur la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 et d\u2019exploiter au mieux les synergies avec d\u2019autres initiatives nationales ou r\u00e9gionales . L\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019\u00e9nergie participe aux deux partenariats concernant le th\u00e8me de l\u2019\u00e9nergie : L\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019\u00e9nergie favorise , avec d\u2019autres agences d\u2019encouragement nationales et europ\u00e9ennes ainsi que la Commission europ\u00e9enne , la coop\u00e9ration internationale entre les hautes \u00e9coles , entreprises et organisations innovantes , les utilisateurs finaux et la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 civile afin de r\u00e9soudre les d\u00e9fis li\u00e9s au domaine de l\u2019\u00e9nergie . sentence1: Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce \u00abSOGC\u00bb The Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce ( SOGC ) appears five times weekly with the latest official information and legal proclamations . The SOGC was first published on 4 January 1883 . Today it is still the only official publication of the Swiss Confederation , which is published five times a week and contains the most recent official information and legally prescribed announcements . SOGC provides economic subjects - primarily companies in the segments of services , commerce , trade and industry - with relevant information on their business environment . The information provided is thus frequently of an operational character . 1200 - 1500 individual publications are published daily , of which the majority are legally binding . Today ' s SOGC is well positioned in the market due to the official information and , with a daily circulation of 70 , 000 \ users \ , has excellent media values . Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce Last modification 31 . 03 . 2016
sentence2: Feuille officielle du commerce \u00abFOSC\u00bb La feuille officielle du commerce FOSC para\u00eet cinq fois par semaine , publiant les toutes derni\u00e8res informations officielles et les annonces prescrites juridiquement . La FOSC a \u00e9t\u00e9 publi\u00e9e pour la premi\u00e8re fois le 6 janvier 1883 . C ' est , \u00e0 ce jour , le seul organe de publication officiel de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration ; il para\u00eet cinq fois par semaine , publiant les toutes derni\u00e8res informations officielles et les annonces prescrites juridiquement . La FOSC met \u00e0 la disposition des acteurs \u00e9conomiques , et notamment des entreprises actives dans les services , les arts et m\u00e9tiers et l ' industrie , des informations essentielles \u00e0 leur secteur d ' activit\u00e9 . Chaque jour , de 1200 \u00e0 1500 avis paraissent , dont 90 % ont un effet juridique . Gr\u00e2ce aux informations officielles qu ' elle contient , la FOSC occupe actuellement une position forte sur le march\u00e9 , touchant quotidiennement quelques 70 000 \ utilisateurs \ . Feuille officielle du commerce FOSC Derni\u00e8re modification 31 . 03 . 2016

sentence1: Staff Around 340 people work in many different capacities , supporting , organising , informing and communicating on behalf of the Federal Chancellery . Our employees work to uphold balance , participation through consultation and democracy . The Federal Chancellery employs many highly qualified specialists , particularly in the fields of languages , law , policy , communication , social science and the humanities . We also offer interesting job opportunities in IT , electronic records and process management , and in the digital transformation of future work processes . Multilingualism is a part of our culture at the Chancellery . We are committed to a balanced representation of Switzerland\u2019s various language communities . We also take care to ensure both sexes are represented equally at all levels . The Federal Chancellery\u2019s HR strategy defines how we do our jobs as employees and managers , and how we prepare for future challenges . Mutual trust , commitment and flexibility in the work we do are central elements of our working culture . We consider ourselves : Links www . stelle . admin . ch Documents Flyer HR - Strategy ( PDF , 265 kB , 01 . 03 . 2022 ) Specialist staff
sentence2: Collaborateurs La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale compte quelque 340 collaborateurs travaillant dans de nombreux domaines . De nombreux collaborateurs sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9s tr\u00e8s qualifi\u00e9s travaillent \u00e0 la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , notamment dans les secteurs linguistique , juridique et politique , dans la communication ou encore dans les sciences sociales et humaines . Nous offrons par ailleurs des postes int\u00e9ressants dans le domaine informatique , de la gestion \u00e9lectronique des affaires et la num\u00e9risation des processus qui en d\u00e9coule . Nous vivons le multilinguisme au quotidien et nous engageons en faveur d\u2019une repr\u00e9sentation \u00e9quilibr\u00e9e des diff\u00e9rentes r\u00e9gions linguistiques ainsi que des femmes et des hommes \u00e0 tous les niveaux hi\u00e9rarchiques . La strat\u00e9gie de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale en mati\u00e8re de personnel illustre la mani\u00e8re dont nous , en notre qualit\u00e9 de collaborateurs et de sup\u00e9rieurs , agissons dans notre travail au quotidien et dont nous ma\u00eetrisons ensemble les d\u00e9fis du futur . La confiance r\u00e9ciproque , l\u2019engagement et la flexibilit\u00e9 sont les \u00e9l\u00e9ments centraux de notre culture d\u2019entreprise et c\u2019est pour nous une \u00e9vidence : Liens www . stelle . admin . ch Documents D\u00e9pliant Strat\u00e9gie RH ( PDF , 265 kB , 02 . 03 . 2022 ) Contact sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9

sentence1: The Federal Gas Supply Act For the gas market , the Federal Pipelines Act of 1963 merely sets out an obligation to transport gas . It obligates network operators to conclude contracts with third parties on the transport of gas , providing this is technically possible , economically feasible and the third party provides appropriate compensation . In the event of disputes , the SFOE adjudicates on the obligations set out in the contract and the contractual conditions on a case - by - case basis . Alternatively , the Swiss Competition Commission ( COMCO ) can enforce the right to through - transmission on the basis of relevant cartel law . With the development of the EU internal gas market , which began in the 1990s , interest grew among major industries and traders in Switzerland to buy gas on the European traded markets and to transport it themselves to Switzerland as far as the point of consumption . Legal uncertainty regarding numerous details relevant for the implementation of the transport obligation led to the conclusion of the Associations Agreement on Gas in 2012 , which regulated access to the network for gas supplies to large industrial customers . For other end - consumers , there was no provision for free choice of supplier . In 2020 , however , COMCO decided that smaller end - consumers should also be permitted in principle to choose their supplier . For this reason , two gas network operators in central Switzerland were fined for illegally refusing access to the gas network . While this decision was only binding for the two companies concerned , it sent a clear message to network operators throughout Switzerland . Still today , however , there is no standard legal framework to ensure effective competition for the whole of Switzerland . As a result , different conditions for the supply of gas by third parties have become established within the various regions of the network , for instance concerning measurements or relating to forecasts and accounting in the context of what is known as the balancing process . Access to the transport network is still decided on a case - by - case basis , and four separate accounting zones continue to exist in Switzerland . The Federal Gas Supply Act , which underwent a process of national consultation from October 2019 to February 2020 , provides for clear rules in order to facilitate the development of an efficient gas market in Switzerland . In the next step , the Federal Council will refer the dispatch to Parliament . sentence2: Loi sur l\u2019approvisionnement en gaz La loi sur les installations de transport par conduites ( LITC ) , qui remonte \u00e0 1963 , ne pr\u00e9voit , en ce qui concerne le march\u00e9 du gaz , qu\u2019une obligation de transporter : en vertu de celle - ci , les gestionnaires de r\u00e9seau sont tenus de se charger par contrat d\u2019ex\u00e9cuter des transports pour des tiers dans les limites des possibilit\u00e9s techniques et des exigences d\u2019une saine exploitation et pour autant que le tiers offre une r\u00e9mun\u00e9ration \u00e9quitable . En cas de diff\u00e9rend , soit l\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019\u00e9nergie ( OFEN ) d\u00e9cide au cas par cas si l\u2019entreprise doit conclure un contrat et arr\u00eate les conditions contractuelles , soit la Commission de la concurrence ( COMCO ) peut imposer le droit au transport en se fondant sur la l\u00e9gislation sur les cartels . Le d\u00e9veloppement du march\u00e9 int\u00e9rieur du gaz au sein de l\u2019Union europ\u00e9enne , \u00e0 partir des ann\u00e9es 1990 , a suscit\u00e9 l\u2019int\u00e9r\u00eat d\u2019entreprises industrielles et de n\u00e9gociants d\u2019une certaine importance , qui ont souhait\u00e9 acheter du gaz sur les march\u00e9s de gros europ\u00e9ens , puis l\u2019importer eux - m\u00eames en Suisse et le transporter au lieu de consommation . En raison de l\u2019ins\u00e9curit\u00e9 juridique qui pr\u00e9valait sur les nombreux d\u00e9tails \u00e0 r\u00e9gler dans le cadre de l\u2019obligation de transporter , une convention de branche a \u00e9t\u00e9 conclue en 2012 . La convention octroie l\u2019acc\u00e8s au r\u00e9seau pour les livraisons de gaz \u00e0 de grands clients industriels , mais ne pr\u00e9voit aucun droit au libre choix du fournisseur pour les autres consommateurs finaux . En 2020 , la COMCO a d\u00e9cid\u00e9 que les petits consommateurs finaux auraient droit au libre choix leur fournisseur . C\u2019est pourquoi elle a sanctionn\u00e9 deux gestionnaires de r\u00e9seau de gaz en Suisse centrale suite \u00e0 leur refus , qui \u00e9tait ill\u00e9gal , de donner acc\u00e8s \u00e0 leur r\u00e9seau \u00e0 des tiers . Cette d\u00e9cision n\u2019est contraignante que pour ces deux entreprises mais envoie un signal \u00e0 toute la Suisse . Jusqu\u2019\u00e0 pr\u00e9sent , aucun cadre uniforme n\u2019est appliqu\u00e9 \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9chelle nationale pour favoriser le bon fonctionnement de la concurrence . Ainsi , diverses conditions de livraison par des tiers ont pu s\u2019\u00e9tablir dans les diff\u00e9rentes zones de desserte ( p . ex . pour les mesures , les pr\u00e9visions et les d\u00e9comptes dans le cadre de ce qu\u2019on appelle le bilan d\u2019ajustement ) . L\u2019acc\u00e8s au r\u00e9seau de transport reste \u00e9galement un point \u00e0 r\u00e9gler au cas par cas ; il existe en Suisse quatre zones - bilans diff\u00e9rentes . La loi sur l\u2019approvisionnement en gaz ( LApGaz ) , qui \u00e9tait en consultation d\u2019octobre 2019 \u00e0 f\u00e9vrier 2020 , pr\u00e9voit des r\u00e8gles claires et uniformes afin qu\u2019un march\u00e9 du gaz plus efficace puisse \u00e9clore . La transmission du message au Parlement par le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral constitue la prochaine \u00e9tape . sentence1: Central Language Services , Terminology Section The Terminology Section in the Federal Chancellery\u2019s Central Language Services provides relevant and up - to - date terminology in the four national languages and in English for the whole of the Federal Administration . It translates laws and other texts into Romansh and English , and so enables the government and Federal Administration to communicate and provide information in these languages as well . Terminology The Terminology Section supports the federal offices and other federal agencies with terminology work , i . e . in recording , publishing and distributing their specialist vocabulary . Assuring the quality of terminology used in a text , be it originally written or a translation , greatly influences its clarity and readability . The Terminology Section operates in all four national languages plus English , and ensures that the terminology it processes is made publicly available via TERMDAT , the Confederation\u2019s terminology database . The work of the Terminology Section helps to ensure the quality of multilingual communication and information distribution in the Federal Administration . Romansh translation The Romansh coordination office in the Terminology Section coordinates all matters relating to the use of Romansh in the Federal Administration . Texts are translated in - house or sent out to the Graub\u00fcnden Cantonal Chancellery in Chur . Besides translating and updating legislative texts , the service is also responsible for the Romansh ( Rumantsch Grischun ) version of other important texts such as the Federal Council\u2019s explanatory statements on popular votes ( including videos ) . Other publications , webpages etc . are translated as required . The Terminology Section thus plays an important role in providing official communications in all four national languages . English translation The English Language Service in the Terminology Section translates texts into English for the Federal Chancellery , the President of the Confederation , for many of the federal offices and agencies and for the Parliamentary Services . The English Language Service is also responsible for the English translation of legislative texts and for keeping existing English language versions of laws up to date . It plays an important role in ensuring the quality of communication in English by the government and Federal Administration . Centre of Expertise for Language Technologies The Centre of Expertise for Language Technologies ( CoELT ) provides ICT services in language technologies for the Federal Administration . It offers training and technical support for the CAT tool ( computer - assisted translation ) used throughout the Federal Administration , organises and assists with the rollout of new versions of the tool , and ensures the development of interfaces to related systems . Machine translation and other language technologies such as computer - assisted text and corpus analysis are also within its remit . Moreover , the CoELT keeps track of market developments and , with user involvement , initiates evaluation and procurement projects for appropriate technologies . The CoELT maintains close contact with the Conference of Language Services , the Terminology Section and the Federal Office of Information Technology , Systems and Telecommunication FOITT and also with higher education institutions and language technology companies . Coordination and cooperation The Terminology Section coordinates its work with the multilingual cantons and participates in international bodies such as the Rat f\u00fcr deutsche Terminologie and Conference of Translation Services of European States ( COTSOES ) . Linguistic advice In addition to the TERMDAT terminology database , the Terminology Section also compiles guidelines and other aids to drawing up and translating texts . These publications ensure greater coherence among texts published in several languages . The section also provides advice to federal employees and members of the public on language and terminology issues . Continuing education and training Each year , the Terminology Section runs courses in several languages on using TERMDAT . The English Language Service coordinates the Federal Administration\u2019s network of English translators and regularly organises continuing education and training events . Further Information Documents Terminology TERMDAT English Romansh Translation
sentence2: Services linguistiques centraux , Section de terminologie La Section de terminologie des Services linguistiques centraux de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale met \u00e0 la disposition de toute l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale une terminologie actualis\u00e9e et adapt\u00e9e dans les quatre langues nationales et en anglais . Elle traduit par ailleurs des actes l\u00e9gislatifs et d\u2019autres textes en romanche et en anglais , ce qui permet au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et \u00e0 l\u2019administration de communiquer et d\u2019informer de mani\u00e8re comp\u00e9tente dans ces langues \u00e9galement . Terminologie La Section de terminologie apporte son concours aux offices et autres services sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9s dans leurs travaux terminologiques pour recenser , mettre en forme et diffuser leur vocabulaire sp\u00e9cifique . L\u2019assurance de qualit\u00e9 qui en d\u00e9coule b\u00e9n\u00e9ficie largement \u00e0 la clart\u00e9 et l\u2019intelligibilit\u00e9 d\u2019un texte , qu\u2019il s\u2019agisse d\u2019un original ou d\u2019une traduction . Aussi la Section travaille - t - elle dans les quatre langues nationales et en anglais et veille - t - elle \u00e0 rendre le fruit de ses travaux accessible \u00e0 tous via TERMDAT , la banque de donn\u00e9es terminologique de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Elle contribue ainsi \u00e0 assurer une communication et une information d\u2019excellente qualit\u00e9 . Traductions en romanche Le service de coordination des mandats de traduction en romanche , rattach\u00e9 \u00e0 la Section de terminologie , est l\u2019interlocuteur pour toutes les questions li\u00e9es au romanche au sein de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , qu\u2019il traite en \u00e9troite collaboration avec la Chancellerie d\u2019\u00e9tat du canton des Grisons , \u00e0 Coire . Parall\u00e8lement \u00e0 la traduction d\u2019actes l\u00e9gislatifs et \u00e0 leur mise \u00e0 jour , l\u2019activit\u00e9 du service consiste aussi \u00e0 transposer en rumantsch grischun des textes importants paraissant r\u00e9guli\u00e8rement tels que les explications du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral consacr\u00e9es aux votations ( vid\u00e9os comprises ) . D\u2019autres publications , pages Internet , etc . , paraissent en romanche selon les besoins . La Section de terminologie contribue ainsi \u00e0 la communication des autorit\u00e9s dans les quatre langues nationales . Traductions en anglais Le Service linguistique anglais , qui est rattach\u00e9 \u00e0 la Section de terminologie , traduit des textes en anglais \u00e9manant de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , du pr\u00e9sident ou de la pr\u00e9sidente de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , des Services du Parlement ainsi que de nombreux offices f\u00e9d\u00e9raux . Il est en outre charg\u00e9 de traduire des textes juridiques et de les actualiser , ce qui permet plus g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et \u00e0 l\u2019administration de communiquer et d\u2019informer en anglais dans la mesure n\u00e9cessaire et avec un niveau de qualit\u00e9 \u00e9lev\u00e9 . Centre de comp\u00e9tences pour les technologies linguistiques Le Centre de comp\u00e9tences pour les technologies linguistiques ( CCTL ) a pour mission de fournir des prestations informatiques dans le domaine des technologies linguistiques \u00e0 l\u2019ensemble de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Il assure ainsi le support technique et la formation pour l\u2019outil de traduction assist\u00e9e par ordinateur choisi pour \u00e9quiper les services linguistiques , organise et accompagne l\u2019installation de ses nouvelles versions tout en favorisant le d\u00e9veloppement d\u2019interfaces avec les syst\u00e8mes environnants . Le domaine de comp\u00e9tences du CCTL englobe \u00e9galement la traduction automatique et d\u2019autres technologies linguistiques telles que l\u2019analyse de textes et de corpus . Par ailleurs , il m\u00e8ne une veille technologique ainsi que des projets d\u2019\u00e9valuation et d\u2019acquisition d\u2019outils appropri\u00e9s en y associant les utilisatrices et les utilisateurs . Le CCTL interagit avec diff\u00e9rents acteurs : Conf\u00e9rence interd\u00e9partementale des services linguistiques de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , Section de terminologie , Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019informatique et de la t\u00e9l\u00e9communication , des hautes \u00e9coles ainsi que des entreprises fournissant des solutions dans le domaine des technologies linguistiques . Coordination et coop\u00e9ration La Section de terminologie coordonne ses activit\u00e9s avec les cantons plurilingues et coop\u00e8re aux travaux d\u2019organismes internationaux tels que le Conseil pour la terminologie germanophone ( RaDT ) et la Conf\u00e9rence des services de traduction des \u00e9tats europ\u00e9ens ( CST ) . Conseils en mati\u00e8re linguistique Parall\u00e8lement \u00e0 la banque de donn\u00e9es terminologique TERMDAT , la Section de terminologie propose \u00e9galement des guides et autres instruments facilitant la r\u00e9daction et la traduction de textes tout en garantissant la coh\u00e9rence entre les diff\u00e9rentes versions linguistiques . Elle conseille en outre les employ\u00e9s de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et les citoyens dans les domaines terminologique et linguistique . Formation La Section de terminologie organise chaque ann\u00e9e des cours d\u2019initiation \u00e0 l\u2019interrogation et \u00e0 l\u2019alimentation de TERMDAT en plusieurs langues . Le Service linguistique anglais collabore avec les traducteurs de langue anglaise travaillant dans d\u2019autres services de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et propose r\u00e9guli\u00e8rement des formations continues . Informations compl\u00e9mentaires Documents La terminologie TERMDAT Formations en terminologie Anglais Romanche Traduction

sentence1: Winners of the 2015 Watt d ' Or awards The winners of the 2015 Watt d ' Or awards have been chosen ! This year ' s trophies were presented to the winners on the occasion of the Swiss Federal Office of Energy ' s New Year ' s event that was held on 8 January 2015 in Bern . The following projects were chosen to receive the various awards ( all of which are of equal value ) : \u201cSociety\u201d category Lighthouse \u2013 Energy - efficient hotels in the canton of Grisons More than a hundred years ago , the hotels in the canton of Grisons were pioneers in the electrification of Switzerland . And this canton is again setting a shining example today : with its \u201cLighthouse\u201d project aimed at promoting energy efficiency in hotels , hotelleriesuisse Grisons is sending a signal to the entire country in favour of increased energy efficiency in the tourism sector . In the \u201cSociety\u201d category , Watt d ' Or 2015 was awarded to hotelleriesuisse Grisons and Gustav Lorenz , the leading light behind the project . \u201cEnergy technologies\u201d category GridSense The electricity distribution network is approaching the limits of its capacity . It was originally designed for the end distribution of electricity into buildings , but now has to handle an increasing quantity of locally produced solar power , as well as meet the requirements of new products such as electric cars . Expanding the network is one potential solution , while another concerns the use of \u201csmarter\u201d networks . However , the conventional smart grid concept is too costly and places high demands on data protection . But now , a unique innovation from the canton of Ticino that is based on artificial intelligence demonstrates that this problem could be solved at considerably lower cost and with a higher level of security : a self - learning algorithm integrated directly into appliances and systems that autonomously maintains the load balance in the local network . In the \u201cEnergy technologies\u201d category , Watt d ' Or 2015 was awarded to Scuola universitaria professionale della Svizzera italiana ( University of Applied Sciences and Arts of Southern Switzerland ) for its development of this technology , and to the Alpiq InTec Group , which is responsible for its overall industrialisation and will be bringing the new products onto the market in 2015 under the brand name , GridSense . \u201cRenewable energies\u201d category Swisscom Wankdorf Data Center xDC The computer centre that was put into operation by Swisscom in October 2014 in Bern - Wankdorf is one the most secure , modern , and above all energy - efficient facilities of its kind in Europe . The cooling system exclusively utilises outside air and rainwater , which means that no electromechanical refrigeration machines and environmentally harmful refrigerants are used at all . The waste heat is fed into the new district heating system of the city of Bern , and is thus used for heating buildings in the immediate vicinity . On top of this , an innovative emergency power supply system has been installed that eliminates the need for batteries . For this pioneering project , Swisscom AG and RZintegral AG were awarded the Watt d ' Or 205 in the \u201cRenewable energies\u201d category . \u201cEnergy - efficient mobility\u201d category AHEAD \u2013 Advanced Hybrid Electric Autobus Design The diesel - electric hybrid buses manufactured by Carrosserie Hess AG are looking towards the energy future in just one direction : AHEAD . The \u201cAdvanced Hybrid Electric Autobus Design\u201d ( AHEAD ) technology developed by the Institute for Dynamic Systems and Control ( IDSC ) at the Federal Institute of Technology in Zurich introduces intelligence into buses . With this technology , buses can be configured for optimal energy efficiency and economic viability . With the aid of this innovative energy management system , buses are able to actively \u201clearn\u201d routes , which results in the extremely energy - efficient control of drive elements , and reduces fuel consumption by approximately 25 percent . Watt d ' Or 2015 was awarded to Carrosserie Hess AG and the IDSC in the \u201cEnergy - efficient mobility\u201d category . \u201cBuildings and space\u201d category wellnessHostel4000 and Aqua Allalin & new youth hostel building in Gstaad , Saanenland The Swiss Youth Hostels organisation is riding a wave of success despite the difficult situation currently facing Switzerland as a tourism destination . One of its recipes for success is that it consistently focuses on sustainability in its ultra - modern buildings . With an outstanding level of energy efficiency , comfort and design , combined with affordable prices , this 90 - year - old organisation belongs to the avant - garde of the Swiss tourism industry . In the \u201cBuildings and space\u201d category , the 2015 Watt d ' Or was awarded to the Swiss Foundation for Social Tourism ( SSST ) as developer of Swiss Youth Hostels , the Civic Community of Saas - Fee and Steinmann & Schmid Architekten ( Basel ) for wellnessHostel4000 and Aqua Allalin , and to the SSST and B\u00fcrgi Sch\u00e4rer Architektur und Planung AG ( Bern ) for the new youth hostel building in Gstaad , Saanenland . Special \u201cEducation\u201d award your + \u2013 Solar Decathlon Europe 2014 - Team Lucerne - Suisse A competition and a bright idea led to the initiation of this project , which culminated in the construction of a truly exceptional building . Seventy students from the Department of Technology and Architecture at the University of Lucerne decided to take up the challenge of participating in Solar Decathlon Europe 2014 . The project lasted more than three years and was brought to a successful conclusion in the Park of Versailles Palace , near Paris , in July 2014 . The concept chosen by the students for their house of the future was to \u201cshare space , objects and processes in order to live more socially , more ecologically , more economically and more enjoyably\u201d . The Watt d ' Or 2015 was awarded to the Lucerne - Suisse team from the University of Lucerne in the special \u201cEducation\u201d category for their outstanding achievement . Documents Watt d ' Or 2015 Links Gallery of photos taken at the awards ceremony on 8 January 2015 Watt d ' Or on Youtube Media Press releases in German Last modification 08 . 01 . 2015
sentence2: Laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2015 Les laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2015 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9compens\u00e9s ! Les laur\u00e9ats du concours de cette ann\u00e9e se sont vu remettre leur troph\u00e9e \u00e0 l ' occasion de l ' ap\u00e9ritif du Nouvel An organis\u00e9 par l ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie , le 8 janvier 2015 \u00e0 Berne . Les projets suivants ont tous re\u00e7u le m\u00eame prix : Cat\u00e9gorie Soci\u00e9t\u00e9 Phare \u2013 Les h\u00f4tels des Grisons \u00e9conomes en \u00e9nergie Il y a plus de cent ans , les h\u00f4tels des Grisons \u00e9taient les pionniers de l ' \u00e9lectrification de notre pays . Aujourd ' hui , ils montrent \u00e0 nouveau l ' exemple : avec le projet \u00abLes h\u00f4tels des Grisons \u00e9conomes en \u00e9nergie\u00bb , hotelleriesuisse Grisons lance un signal fort au niveau national pour davantage d ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique dans les \u00e9tablissements touristiques . Dans la cat\u00e9gorie Soci\u00e9t\u00e9 , le Watt d ' Or 2015 est d\u00e9cern\u00e9 \u00e0 hotelleriesuisse Grisons et \u00e0 Gustav Lorenz qui a initi\u00e9 le projet . Cat\u00e9gorie Technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques GridSenseLe r\u00e9seau de distribution d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 atteint sa limite de charge . Con\u00e7u autrefois exclusivement pour la distribution fine de l ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 jusqu ' aux prises \u00e9lectriques , il doit faire face \u00e0 un volume croissant de courant solaire produit localement et \u00e0 de nouveaux consommateurs tels que les voitures \u00e9lectriques . Une solution est l ' extension du r\u00e9seau et l ' autre , des r\u00e9seaux plus intelligents . Le concept classique des smart grids est on\u00e9reux et pose d ' \u00e9normes probl\u00e8mes en mati\u00e8re de protection des donn\u00e9es . L ' innovation tessinoise unique , bas\u00e9e sur l ' intelligence artificielle , est nettement moins co\u00fbteuse et plus s\u00fbre : un algorithme auto - adaptatif , directement int\u00e9gr\u00e9 aux appareils et aux installations , assurant de mani\u00e8re autonome le nivellement de la charge du r\u00e9seau local . Le Watt d ' Or 2015 dans la cat\u00e9gorie technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques est attribu\u00e9 \u00e0 la Scuola universitaria professionale della Svizzera italiana ( SUPSI ) pour le d\u00e9veloppement de la technologie et au groupe Alpiq InTec , responsable de toute l ' industrialisation , qui lancera ces nouveaux produits sur le march\u00e9 en 2015 sous le nom de GridSense . Cat\u00e9gorie Energies renouvelables Swisscom Wankdorf Data Center xDCLe centre de calcul de Swisscom mis en service en octobre 2014 \u00e0 Berne - Wankdorf , est l ' un des plus s\u00fbrs , des plus modernes et surtout des plus efficaces sur le plan \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique en Europe . Aucun dispositif de refroidissement \u00e9lectrom\u00e9canique ni fluide frigorig\u00e8ne n ' est utilis\u00e9 pour la climatisation , qui est enti\u00e8rement assur\u00e9e par un syst\u00e8me d ' air tournant et d ' eau de pluie . Les rejets de chaleur sont inject\u00e9s dans le nouveau r\u00e9seau de chaleur \u00e0 distance de la ville de Berne pour alimenter les b\u00e2timents du quartier . Un concept d ' alimentation de secours innovant rend par ailleurs inutile le recours aux batteries . Les auteurs de ce projet avant - gardiste , \u00e0 savoir Swisscom SA et RZintegral AG , ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9compens\u00e9s dans le cadre du Watt d ' Or 2015 , cat\u00e9gorie \u00e9nergies renouvelables . Cat\u00e9gorie Mobilit\u00e9 \u00e9conome en \u00e9nergie AHEAD \u2013 Advanced Hybrid Electric Autobus Design L ' autobus hybride diesel - \u00e9lectrique de l ' entreprise HESS AG ne connait qu ' un seul chemin vers l ' avenir \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique : AHEAD . La technologie AHEAD , pour \u00abAdvanced Hybrid Electric Autobus Design\u00bb , d\u00e9velopp\u00e9e par l ' Institut des syst\u00e8mes dynamiques et de contr\u00f4le ( IDSC ) de l ' EPF de Zurich embarque l ' intelligence \u00e0 bord . Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 cela , le bus peut \u00eatre configur\u00e9 de mani\u00e8re optimale au niveau efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et rentabilit\u00e9 . Le syst\u00e8me de gestion de l ' \u00e9nergie innovant peut apprendre de mani\u00e8re autonome un trajet pour permettre une utilisation \u00e9conomique du moteur . Ce qui permet de diminuer la consommation de diesel d ' un quart . Les Watt d ' Or de la cat\u00e9gorie Mobilit\u00e9 \u00e9conome en \u00e9nergie est d\u00e9cern\u00e9 \u00e0 Carrosserie HESS AG et l ' IDSC , qui au niveau de l ' efficacit\u00e9 laisse la concur - rence derri\u00e8re . Cat\u00e9gorie B\u00e2timents et espace wellnessHostel4000 et Aqua Allalin & construction de l ' auberge de Gstaad SaanenlandLes Auberges de Jeunesse Suisses surfent sur une vague de succ\u00e8s malgr\u00e9 la situation difficile du tourisme suisse . Le d\u00e9veloppement durable mis en \u0153uvre de mani\u00e8re coh\u00e9rente dans les \u00e9tablissements ultramodernes est l ' une des cl\u00e9s de leur succ\u00e8s . Tr\u00e8s haute performance \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique , confort , design et prix abordables : cette organisation cr\u00e9\u00e9e il y a 90 ans est aujourd ' hui \u00e0 l ' avant - garde du tourisme suisse . Dans la cat\u00e9gorie B\u00e2timents et espaces , le Watt d ' Or 2015 est d\u00e9cern\u00e9 \u00e0 la Fondation Suisse pour le Tourisme Social ( FSTS ) en tant que ma\u00eetre d ' ouvrage des auberges de jeunesse suisses , \u00e0 la commune bourgeoise de Saas - Fee et \u00e0 Steinmann & Schmid Architekten AG \u00e0 B\u00e2le pour le wellnessHostel4000 et Aqua Allalin ainsi qu ' \u00e0 la FSTS et \u00e0 B\u00fcrgi Sch\u00e4rer Architektur und Planung AG \u00e0 Berne pour la construction de l ' auberge de jeunesse de Gstaad Saanenland . Prix sp\u00e9cial \ Formation \ your + \u2013 Solar Decathlon Europe 2014 \u2013 Team Lucerne \u2013 Suisse Partis d ' une \u00e9nonc\u00e9e de concours pour arriver \u00e0 une maison qui rivalise d ' ing\u00e9niosit\u00e9 . Voil\u00e0 le d\u00e9fi r\u00e9alis\u00e9 par une septantaine d ' \u00e9tudiants de la Haute - \u00e9cole lucernoise Technique & Architecture dans le cadre du Solar Decathlon Europe 2014 . Un projet d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 sur 3 ans avec comme point d ' orgue le concours , en juillet 2014 dans le parc du Ch\u00e2teau de Versailles pr\u00e8s de Paris . \u00abPartageons l ' espace , les biens et les cycles , pour construire un projet de vie sociale , plus \u00e9cologique et plus \u00e9conomique\u00bb tel est le slogan choisi par les \u00e9tudiants , pour ce projet qui nous emm\u00e8ne vers la maison du futur , plus si lointaine que cela . Le Team Lucerne \u2013 Suisse de la Haute - \u00e9cole lucernoise Technique & Architecture se voit d\u00e9cern\u00e9 par le jury un prix sp\u00e9cial \u00abFormation\u00bb pour sa prestation exceptionnelle . Documents Watt d ' Or 2015 Liens Photos de la remise des prix du 8 janvier 2015 Watt d ' Or sur Youtube M\u00e9dias 9e \u00e9dition du Watt d\u2019Or : l\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019\u00e9nergie d\u00e9cerne le prix suisse de l\u2019\u00e9nergie Derni\u00e8re modification 08 . 01 . 2015

sentence1: Calculation of penalties for light commercial vehicles The individual target is calculated on the basis of the target value of 153 . 9g CO2 / km and also depends on the unladen weight . Calculation of penalties for large importers If the average carbon emissions of a large importer ' s newly registered LCV fleet ( at least six new registrations per year ) exceed the individually specified target level , a penalty is levied . The parameters for calculating the 2025 target are not yet finalised . As soon as the Federal Council has adopted the implementing provisions for 2025 , a calculation example for large importers will be published . These new implementing provisions are expected to come into force in the second quarter of 2025 , with retroactive effect from 1 January 2025 . Calculation of penalties for small importers In the case of small importers ( fewer than six new registrations per year ) , excess emissions and the penalty are calculated individually for each van or light articulated lorry . The size of the penalty is calculated on the basis of both on the vehicle ' s carbon emissions and its unladen weight . This means that a vehicle may be subject to a penalty even if it does not exceed the 153 . 9g / km carbon emissions target . The calculation formula will be adjusted in the course of 2025 when the updated implementing provisions enter into force by Federal Council decision . The calculation tool can be used to calculate any penalty due . Compensation of penalties for small importers Small importers of LCVs may be required to pay a carbon penalty before vehicles are registered in Switzerland . A penalty is due for vehicles that exceed the CO2 emissions target . If a vehicle ' s emissions are below the specified target , no penalty applies . However , no bonus is paid out in this case either . Small importers have the option of assigning their emissions to a large importer . This may reduce the penalty for a high - emission vehicle or a bonus may be paid out for an efficient vehicle . The assigning importer and the large importer draw up an agreement under private law to this effect . Assignments must be reported to the SFOE before initial vehicle registration in Switzerland . sentence2: Calcul des sanctions voitures de livraison et tracteurs \u00e0 sellette l\u00e9gers La valeur cible individuelle est calcul\u00e9e sur la base de la valeur cible de 153 , 9 g de CO2 / km et tient compte du poids \u00e0 vide . Calcul de la sanction applicable aux grands importateurs Si les \u00e9missions moyennes de CO2 du parc de v\u00e9hicules utilitaires l\u00e9gers nouvellement immatricul\u00e9s d ' un grand importateur ( au moins six immatriculations par an ) exc\u00e8dent sa valeur cible individuelle , celui - ci doit s ' acquitter d ' une sanction . Les param\u00e8tres pris en compte dans le calcul des valeurs cibles prescrites pour 2025 ne sont pas encore d\u00e9finitivement fix\u00e9s . D\u00e8s que le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral aura adopt\u00e9 les dispositions d\u2019ex\u00e9cution pour l\u2019ann\u00e9e 2025 , un exemple de calcul pour grands importateurs sera mis en ligne . Ces nouvelles dispositions d\u2019ex\u00e9cution devraient entrer en vigueur au deuxi\u00e8me trimestre 2025 , avec effet r\u00e9troactif au 1er janvier 2025 . Calcul de la sanction applicable aux petits importateurs Pour les petits importateurs ( moins de six nouvelles immatriculations par an ) , le d\u00e9passement de la valeur cible et la sanction applicable sont calcul\u00e9s de mani\u00e8re individuelle pour chaque voiture de livraison ou tracteur \u00e0 sellette l\u00e9ger . Le montant d\u2019une \u00e9ventuelle sanction d\u00e9pend non seulement des \u00e9missions de CO2 mais aussi du poids \u00e0 vide du v\u00e9hicule nouvellement immatricul\u00e9 . Ainsi , un v\u00e9hicule dont les \u00e9missions de CO2 sont inf\u00e9rieures \u00e0 153 , 9 g / km peut aussi \u00eatre passible d ' une sanction . La formule de calcul subira des modifications au cours de l\u2019ann\u00e9e 2025 avec l\u2019entr\u00e9e en vigueur des dispositions d\u2019ex\u00e9cution actualis\u00e9es d\u00e9cid\u00e9e par le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Pour en savoir plus sur le montant des sanctions \u00e9ventuelles , voir l ' outil de calcul . Compensation de la sanction pour les petits importateurs Les petits importateurs de VUL doivent acquitter le montant \u00e9ventuel d\u00fb \u00e0 titre de sanction CO2 pour obtenir leur immatriculation . Une sanction est applicable pour les v\u00e9hicules qui exc\u00e8dent la valeur cible . Si les \u00e9missions du v\u00e9hicule sont inf\u00e9rieures \u00e0 la valeur cible , aucune sanction ne s\u2019applique , mais aucun bonus n\u2019est vers\u00e9 non plus . Les petits importateurs peuvent cependant c\u00e9der leurs v\u00e9hicules \u00e0 un grand importateur . De cette mani\u00e8re , il se peut que la sanction pour un v\u00e9hicule \u00e0 fortes \u00e9missions soit r\u00e9duite ou qu ' un bonus soit vers\u00e9 pour un v\u00e9hicule efficace . Ces conditions sont fix\u00e9es dans un accord de droit priv\u00e9 entre l\u2019importateur c\u00e9dant et le repreneur . La cession doit \u00eatre annonc\u00e9e \u00e0 l\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie avant la premi\u00e8re mise en circulation en Suisse . This year ' s trophies were presented to the winners on the occasion of the Swiss Federal Office of Energy ' s New Year ' s event that was held on 8 January 2009 in Bern . The following projects were chosen to receive the various awards ( all of which are of equal value ) : \u201cSociety\u201d category Rhine Valley energy initiative . Verein St . Gall Rhine Valley have accomplished something that is usually difficult for even just two municipalities to achieve : they have drawn up a set of common guidelines , specifically a programme to promote energy efficiency in buildings . The Rhine Valley energy initiative is a model for the whole country . \u201cEnergy technologies\u201d categories Biogas from wood . Paul Scherrer Institute , Villigen ( canton of Aargau ) and Vienna University of Technology ( Austria ) As a source of energy , wood can be used for more than just heating purposes . In G\u00fcssing , Austria , a joint Swiss / Austrian project has constructed the world ' s first pilot facility for converting wood into synthetic gas . \u201cRenewable energies\u201d categories Mont d ' Ottan wind power plant . Rh\u00f4n\u00e9ole SA , Vernayaz ( canton of Valais ) Rh\u00f4n\u00e9ole SA has received the 2009 Watt d ' Or award for its Mont d ' Ottan wind power plant in Martigny , which was handed over for operation in May 2008 . This is Switzerland ' s largest wind power plant . \u201cEnergy - efficient mobility\u201d category \u201cFlyer\u201d e - bikes in Swiss resorts . Biketec AG , Kirchberg ( canton of Bern ) Biketec AG as made a breakthrough onto the market with its energy - efficient electric \u201cFlyer\u201d bicycles , and it is now opening up new opportunities in Swiss resorts : its cleverly conceived rental system is linked to various local services and enables even unathletic visitors to reach new heights . \u201cBuildings\u201d category Eulachhof ' zero - energy ' housing development . Allreal Generalunternehmung AG , Zurich Living in style , saving energy and protecting the climate \u2013 all at an affordable price : this is what the visionary Eulachhof housing development on the former Sulzer site in Winterthur has to offer . The first \u201czero - energy\u201d housing development in Switzerland . Special award Metalwork company Ernst Schweizer AG , Metallbau in Hedingen ( canton of Zurich ) The jury once again decided to award a special prize this year , which went to metalwork company Ernst Schweizer AG , Metallbau in Hedingen ( canton of Zurich ) . This award recognises the company ' s long - term and successful commitment to energy - efficient and environment - friendly production methods and products , as well as its exemplary treatment of personnel and business partners . Galler Rheintal , Rebstein ( SG ) , pour l ' initiative \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique de la vall\u00e9e du RhinDouze communes de la vall\u00e9e du Rhin saint - galloise ont r\u00e9ussi ce que deux communes peinent souvent \u00e0 accomplir : elles ont lanc\u00e9 un programme \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique commun pour le secteur du b\u00e2timent , programme qui pourrait servir de mod\u00e8le \u00e0 toute la Suisse . Cat\u00e9gorie Technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques L ' Institut Paul Scherrer , Villigen ( AG ) , et l ' Universit\u00e9 technique de Vienne ( Autriche ) pour la transformation du bois en gaz naturel de synth\u00e8seLe bois comme agent \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique ne sert pas qu ' \u00e0 chauffer . sentence1: The Federal Department of Finance ( FDF ) The Federal Department of Finance ( FDF ) mainly deals with the state budget and tax matters . It has been headed by Karin Keller - Sutter since January 2023 . Federal Councillor Karin Keller - Sutter Federal Councillor Karin Keller - Sutter was born in 1963 and is from the canton of St Gallen . She attended school in Wil and Neuch\u00e2tel . Karin Keller - Sutter is a trained translator / interpreter and secondary school teacher . Between 1989 and 2000 she worked as a freelance translator , and also taught at a vocational school . Karin Keller - Sutter is married . Karin Keller - Sutter began her political career in 1992 as a member of Wil town council . In 1996 she was elected to the cantonal parliament . In 2000 she entered the cantonal government where she headed the Justice and Security Department . In 2011 Karin Keller - Sutter was elected to the Council of States where she represented the canton of St Gallen . She held the presidency of the Council of States in 2017 / 2018 . Karin Keller - Sutter has also sat on the boards of various companies and foundations . Election to the Federal Council The United Federal Assembly elected Karin Keller - Sutter to the Federal Council on 5 December 2018 . She headed the Federal Department of Justice and Police FDJP from 2019 to 2022 . Since January 2023 , she has been head of the Federal Department of Finance ( FDF ) . The Federal Department of Finance ( FDF ) The FDF deals with a wide range of tasks , including the federal budget , both national and international finance , monetary and tax matters , customs and merchandise control and the implementation of legislation on alcohol . It also provides services for the whole of the Federal Administration , from IT to human resources , infrastructure and logistics . FDF facts and figures Staff ( full - time positions / 2022 ) : 8 , 756 Expenses 2022 : CHF 17 . 86 billion The President of the Confederation Karin Keller - Sutter This year Karin Keller - Sutter is not only the head of FDF , her government department , but also president of the Swiss Confederation . sentence1: The energy label for refrigerators and freezers This label provides information about the energy efficiency of the declared appliances . When we buy a new fridge or freezer , it is not only the purchase price that counts , but also the associated long - term electricity costs . With this label it is possible to identify the most energy - efficient models at a glance . In addition to the level of energy consumption and the noise level , the label also indicates the utilisable capacity of declared refrigerators and freezers . The information provided on the label is based on the results of a standardised test over a period of 24 hours . Ambient temperature and usage also influence the level of energy consumption . sentence1: Project organisation Parliament has given the Federal Council the task of gradually introducing e - voting . The Federal Council has in turn delegated the task to the Federal Chancellery , where the project is being carried out by the Political Rights Section . At the Federal Chancellery , the project team ' Vote \u00e9lectronique ' is responsible for the operational and technical management of the project . The Federal Chancellery is responsible for the authorisation procedure in relation to federal popular votes and elections and for coordinating the cantonal projects . Project organisation bodies The Steering Committee ' Vote \u00e9lectronique ' ( SC VE ) consolidates the strategic proposals for the project made by the Federal Chancellery before they are presented to the Federal Council and Parliament . The SC VE com - prises eleven members and is chaired by the Federal Chancellor . The representatives of the Confederation are : The cantons have six seats in the SC VE . The members of the Swiss Conference of Cantonal Chancellors determine the representation of the cantons in the SC VE . The Project Committee ' Vote \u00e9lectronique ' ( PC VE ) monitors the implementation of the catalogue of measures . The PC VE comprises the Federal Chancellery\u2019s project team , cantonal representatives and Swiss Post as a system provider . All Cantons that have already introduced e - voting or are planning to do so can join the PC VE .
sentence2: Organisation du projet Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a \u00e9t\u00e9 mandat\u00e9 par le Parlement pour instaurer le vote \u00e9lectronique par \u00e9tapes . Il a confi\u00e9 cette t\u00e2che \u00e0 la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , au sein de laquelle le projet est men\u00e9 par la Section des droits politiques . L ' \u00e9quipe du projet Vote \u00e9lectronique en assure la direction technique et op\u00e9rationnelle . La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale assume la responsabilit\u00e9 tant de la proc\u00e9dure d ' agr\u00e9ment dans le cadre des scrutins f\u00e9d\u00e9raux que de la coordination des projets cantonaux . Organes Le comit\u00e9 de pilotage Vote \u00e9lectronique ( CoPil VE ) examine les propositions strat\u00e9giques de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale avant qu ' elle ne les soumette au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral ou au Parlement . Le CoPil VE se compose de 11 membres . Il est dirig\u00e9 par le chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Les repr\u00e9sentants de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration sont : Les six autres si\u00e8ges sont occup\u00e9s par les cantons . Les membres de la Conf\u00e9rence suisse des chanceliers d ' \u00c9tat d\u00e9signent les repr\u00e9sentants des cantons au sein du CoPil VE . Le comit\u00e9 de projet Vote \u00e9lectronique ( CPr VE ) veille \u00e0 la mise en \u0153uvre du plan directeur . Il se compose des membres de l ' \u00e9quipe du projet Vote \u00e9lectronique de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , des repr\u00e9sentants des cantons et de la Poste Suisse , en sa qualit\u00e9 de fournisseur de syst\u00e8me . Les cantons qui ont d\u00e9j\u00e0 introduit le vote \u00e9lectronique ou qui se sont dot\u00e9s d ' un calendrier contraignant pour son introduction peuvent si\u00e9ger au sein du CPr VE .

sentence1: Digital Switzerland The Digital Switzerland Strategy sets the guidelines for Switzerland\u2019s digital transformation . It is binding for the Federal Administration . For other stakeholders such as the cantons , communes , business , science and civil society , it serves as an orientation with the aim of making the best possible use of the opportunities of digital transformation for everyone . Digitalisation is increasingly shaping the way we live . With its stable political system and its great capacity for innovation , Switzerland is well placed to transpose its successful model of an open and modern Switzerland with its high quality of life into the digital future . Against this backdrop , the Digital Switzerland Strategy serves as a framework for government action and shows where and how the authorities and actors from business , academia , civil society and politics must work together to shape the transformation process in the common interest . The Digital Switzerland Division is responsible for the ongoing development and implementation of the Digital Switzerland Strategy . Strategy digital . swiss Action plan The activities to implement the strategy are published in the form of an action plan . This action plan is updated annually and sets out the strategy\u2019s key measures . Action plan digital . swiss Digital Switzerland Advisory Committee Digitalisation and ICT Meetings of the Digital Switzerland Advisory Committee are attended by members of the Federal Council and representatives from business , academia , politics , the authorities and civil society who address issues relating to digital transformation . The meetings take place several times a year in different configurations , but are chaired by a member of the Federal Council or the Federal Chancellor . They complement the work of the Federal Council Committee . The meetings are organised by the Federal Chancellery\u2019s Digital Transformation and ICT Steering Sector ( DTI ) . sentence1: Adjustment for climatic conditions The level of energy consumption required for providing room heating ( and to a lesser extent , hot water and process heat ) depends on the existing ambient conditions . For example , more energy is required for generating heating in cold winters than in warmer periods . In order to identify long - term trends in energy consumption or emissions , it is necessary to quantify the dependence of consumption on climatic conditions and depict energy consumption levels after they have been adjusted to reflect those conditions . Special procedures have been developed for this purpose , and these are complemented by model - based estimates of ( climate - related ) energy consumption . Documents Adjustment for climatic conditions Specialist staff Last modification 31 . 10 . 2008
sentence2: Correction climatique La consommation d ' \u00e9nergie due au chauffage des locaux et , dans une moindre mesure , \u00e0 la pr\u00e9paration d ' eau chaude ainsi qu ' \u00e0 la fourniture de chaleur pour les proc\u00e9d\u00e9s industriels , varie en fonction des conditions climatiques . En d ' autres termes , on consomme plus d ' \u00e9nergie pour la production de chaleur lors des hivers froids que lors des hivers cl\u00e9ments . Pour d\u00e9terminer les tendances \u00e0 long terme de la consommation d ' \u00e9nergie ou des \u00e9missions , il faut quantifier leur degr\u00e9 de d\u00e9pendance envers les conditions climatiques et corriger les donn\u00e9es en cons\u00e9quence . On utilise \u00e0 cette fin des proc\u00e9dures sp\u00e9cifiques qui sont \u00e9galement appliqu\u00e9es \u00e0 l ' estimation , sur la base de mod\u00e8les , de la consommation d ' \u00e9nergie lorsqu ' elle est li\u00e9e aux conditions climatiques . Documents Correction climatique Contact sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9 Derni\u00e8re modification 31 . 10 . 2008

Rumantsch Grischun The five existing linguistic variants of Romansh have equal status in communications with the federal authorities . However , federal documents in Romansh are published only in Rumantsch Grischun , the standardised written language . Cooperation and Coordination The Federal Chancellery coordinates all matters relating to the use of Romansh in the Federal Administration , working closely with the Graub\u00fcnden Cantonal Chancellery in Chur . The federal offices and departments identify important publications for which a Romansh version would be useful . Translation Each year about 1 , 700 A4 pages of text are translated into Romansh . About two thirds of these are sent out to the translation service at the Graub\u00fcnden Cantonal Chancellery in Chur . Legislative texts are translated and updated , as are other important texts such as the Federal Council\u2019s explanatory statements on popular votes ( including videos ) and the annual publication The Swiss Confederation \u2013 A Brief Guide . Other publications , internet pages etc . are translated as required . Terminology The Federal Chancellery also establishes and records terminology in Romansh . TERMDAT , the Confederation\u2019s online terminology database , has a growing number of entries in Romansh . This work is also carried out by the Graub\u00fcnden Cantonal Chancellery in Chur and is coordinated by the Federal Chancellery . When accreditation is performed against international standards it facilitates the international recognition of conformity assessments . sentence1: SWEET KTT Toolbox \u2013 30 method cards , 6 project phases , 5 criteria The box contains 30 cards with well - known KTT methods for the interaction with stakeholders , which have been newly compiled especially for the SWEET consortia . Each card describes one method and is colour - coded to a specific project phase . In addition , the cards have been categorised according to five criteria and perforated accordingly . With the help of a stick , the cards that correspond to the desired mix of criteria can be quickly filtered out . Experiences with the individual methods can be written directly on the respective card . Further methods can be added on coloured blank cards . A digital version of the toolbox can be found under \u201cDocuments\u201d . The Toolbox is only available in English . The toolbox is primarily aimed at SWEET consortia . It is intended to provide low - threshold access to the topic , to provide inter - and transdisciplinary teams with new impulses for their KTT activities and to promote dialogue within the project team . The toolbox is well suited for use in workshops with internal and external stakeholders . A physical toolbox is provided to SWEET consortia by the SWEET Office . However , the toolbox can also be used by researchers in other thematic areas and by authorities and practitioners . Documents Last modification 25 . 06 . 2024
sentence2: Bo\u00eete \u00e0 outils SWEET TST \u2013 30 cartes m\u00e9thodologiques , 6 phases de projet , 5 crit\u00e8res La bo\u00eete contient 30 cartes de m\u00e9thodes TST reconnues pour l ' interaction avec les acteurs , qui ont \u00e9t\u00e9 red\u00e9finies sp\u00e9cialement pour les consortiums SWEET . Chaque carte d\u00e9crit une m\u00e9thode diff\u00e9rente et est associ\u00e9e \u00e0 une phase de projet sp\u00e9cifique . En outre , chaque carte a \u00e9t\u00e9 cat\u00e9goris\u00e9e selon cinq crit\u00e8res et perfor\u00e9e en cons\u00e9quence . \u00c0 l ' aide d ' un b\u00e2tonnet , les cartes peuvent \u00eatre filtr\u00e9es rapidement pour cr\u00e9er la combinaison de crit\u00e8res souhait\u00e9e . Les exp\u00e9riences relatives aux diff\u00e9rentes m\u00e9thodes peuvent \u00eatre \u00e9crites directement sur la carte correspondante . D ' autres m\u00e9thodes peuvent \u00e9galement \u00eatre ajout\u00e9es \u00e0 la bo\u00eete sur des cartes vierges . Une version num\u00e9rique de la bo\u00eete \u00e0 outils est disponible sous \u00abDocuments\u00bb . La bo\u00eete \u00e0 outils n ' est disponible qu ' en anglais . La bo\u00eete \u00e0 outils s ' adresse en premier lieu aux consortiums SWEET . Elle doit fournir moyen facile d\u2019aborder le th\u00e8me du TST , donner aux consortiums inter - et transdisciplinaires de nouvelles impulsions pour leurs activit\u00e9s de TST et encourager le dialogue au sein des \u00e9quipes des projets . Le SWEET Office met la bo\u00eete \u00e0 outils physique \u00e0 la disposition des consortiums SWEET . En principe , la bo\u00eete \u00e0 outils peut \u00e9galement \u00eatre utilis\u00e9e dans d ' autres domaines th\u00e9matiques ainsi que par d\u2019autres acteurs , comme pouvoirs publics et les repr\u00e9sentants de la pratique . sentence1: Digital Federal Administration Strategy The Federal Council ' s Digital Federal Administration Strategy defines the objectives of the digital transformation in the Federal Administration . These objectives are grouped into seven priorities . An annual transformation plan will steer the implementation of the strategy . The strategy comprises a vision for digital transformation , eight guiding principles for the Federal Administration , and a set of strategic objectives that are grouped into seven priorities . The strategy is implemented in an agile manner . The administration aims to achieve the expected benefits set out in the strategy by 2030 . Ordinance on the Coordination of the Digital Transformation and ICT ( DTIO ) The basis for the Digital Federal Administration Strategy is the , which defines the tasks , powers and responsibilities for the steering and management of ICT at federal level ( VDTI ) . The strategy is available in german , french and italian . Contact Digital Transformation and ICT Steering DTI Sector Monbijoustrasse 91 CH - 3003 Bern info . dti @ bk . admin . ch + 41 ( 0 ) 58 463 46 64
sentence2: Strat\u00e9gie Administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale num\u00e9rique La strat\u00e9gie Administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale num\u00e9rique du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral fixe les objectifs de la transformation num\u00e9rique au sein de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Ceux - ci sont regroup\u00e9s en sept priorit\u00e9s . La mise en \u0153uvre de la strat\u00e9gie est pilot\u00e9e au moyen du plan directeur annuel . Strat\u00e9gie La strat\u00e9gie comprend une vision globale de la transformation num\u00e9rique , huit principes guidant l ' action de l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et des objectifs strat\u00e9giques regroup\u00e9s en sept priorit\u00e9s . Elle est mise en \u0153uvre de mani\u00e8re agile . L ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale aura obtenu les effets d\u00e9crits dans la strat\u00e9gie en 2030 . l ' ordonnance sur la transformation num\u00e9rique et l ' informatique ( OTNI ) La strat\u00e9gie Administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale num\u00e9rique se fonde sur . Cette derni\u00e8re r\u00e8gle les t\u00e2ches , les comp\u00e9tences et les responsabilit\u00e9s en mati\u00e8re de pilotage de l ' informatique au niveau de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . But La strat\u00e9gie Administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale num\u00e9rique du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral fixe les objectifs de la transformation num\u00e9rique au sein de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et d\u00e9finit les priorit\u00e9s permettant d\u2019atteindre ces objectifs . Les unit\u00e9s administratives assument leurs t\u00e2ches li\u00e9es \u00e0 la transformation num\u00e9rique dans les limites du cadre strat\u00e9gique d\u00e9fini par le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Les strat\u00e9gies d\u00e9partementales et locales concr\u00e9tisent l\u2019orientation d\u00e9finie dans la pr\u00e9sente strat\u00e9gie et contribuent \u00e0 la mise en \u0153uvre de cette derni\u00e8re . La strat\u00e9gie porte sur le passage d\u2019une administration travaillant sur un mode essentiellement analogue \u00e0 une administration subissant une transformation sur le plan num\u00e9rique , et elle s\u2019attache \u00e0 cr\u00e9er un cadre propice \u00e0 cette mutation . Par transformation , on entend le fait de repenser sous l\u2019angle num\u00e9rique et d\u2019orienter en ce sens la mani\u00e8re dont les autorit\u00e9s f\u00e9d\u00e9rales accomplissent leurs t\u00e2ches . La strat\u00e9gie Administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale num\u00e9rique vise \u00e0 ce que la transformation num\u00e9rique soit abord\u00e9e de mani\u00e8re globale et suprad\u00e9partementale et \u00e0 ce que les efforts d\u00e9ploy\u00e9s par les unit\u00e9s de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et \u00e0 l\u2019ext\u00e9rieur de cette derni\u00e8re soient regroup\u00e9s . Elle est coordonn\u00e9e avec les autres strat\u00e9gies globales relatives \u00e0 la transformation num\u00e9rique de l\u2019administration : la strat\u00e9gie Suisse num\u00e9rique , qui chapeaute l\u2019ensemble des strat\u00e9gies , concerne la transition num\u00e9rique de l\u2019ensemble de la Suisse ; la strat\u00e9gie Administration num\u00e9rique suisse ( ANS ) fixe , quant \u00e0 elle , des lignes directrices pour garantir la coordination des administrations publiques de tous les \u00e9chelons \u00e9tatiques et d\u00e9finit des champs d\u2019action communs . Mise en \u0153uvre La mise en \u0153uvre des mesures coordonn\u00e9es \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9chelon global sera pilot\u00e9e au moyen du plan directeur annuel . Des mesures concr\u00e8tes de mise en \u0153uvre et des instruments permettant d\u2019en mesurer l\u2019efficacit\u00e9 pourront \u00eatre d\u00e9finis en sus . Le plan directeur de la nouvelle strat\u00e9gie sera arr\u00eat\u00e9 au printemps 2024 . sentence1: Legalisations Legalisations can then only be obtained by post . For the specific procedure , please consult the Factsheet ( PDF ) for the legalisation of documents on this page . The Federal Chancellery\u2019s HR , Finance , Controlling Section is responsible for certifying the authenticity of original signatures on documents required abroad . What has to be certified ? Signatures from administrative offices of the Federal Administration , including from Swiss embassies and consulates , foreign diplomatic missions and consulates in Switzerland , cantonal chancelleries and organisations that carry out public duties in the general interest of the country ( Article 8 , Organisation Ordinance for the Federal Chancellery , SR 172 . 210 . 10 ) . Certification by apostille For states which are party to the Hague Convention , certification in the form of an apostille is sufficient . Documents do not need to be certified by a consular agent and are otherwise recognised in the country for which they are intended ( Article 2 , Hague Convention of 5 October 1961 Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents ) . For all states which are not party to the Hague Convention , the normal certification process without apostille applies , in which authentication by a consular or diplomatic agent is required . Lists and factsheets Liste Apostillenl\u00e4nder _ DE . pdf ( PDF , 147 kB , 28 . 01 . 2025 ) Contracting Parties - Status Table Address list of the cantonal authorities ( PDF , 87 kB , 23 . 02 . 2024 ) Factsheet for the certification of documents by the Federal Chancellery ( PDF , 290 kB , 10 . 03 . 2023 ) Responsible SR 172 . 210 . 10 Organisationsverordnung f\u00fcr die Bundeskanzlei ( OV - BK ) , Art . 8
sentence2: L\u00e9galisations Les l\u00e9galisations pourront \u00eatre obtenues uniquement par courrier postal . Pour la marche \u00e0 suivre , veuillez consulter notre Aide - m\u00e9moire ( PDF ) concernant la l\u00e9galisation de documents ci - apr\u00e8s . C ' est \u00e0 la section du personnel , finances , contr\u00f4le de gestion de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale qu ' il appartient de l\u00e9galiser les signatures figurant sur des documents originaux . Elle certifie alors l ' authenticit\u00e9 d ' une signature appos\u00e9e sur le document , mais pas l ' authenticit\u00e9 du contenu du document . De quoi s ' agit - il ? Elle l\u00e9galise les signatures des unit\u00e9s de l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ( y compris celles des ambassades et des consulats de Suisse ) , celles des missions diplomatiques et des consulats des pays \u00e9trangers en Suisse , celles des Chancelleries d ' Etat des cantons et celles des organisations qui assument des t\u00e2ches publiques dans l ' int\u00e9r\u00eat du pays tout entier ( cf . art . 8 de l ' ordonnance sur l ' organisation de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , RS 172 . 210 . 10 ) . Certification par Apostille Pour les Etats qui ont adh\u00e9r\u00e9 \u00e0 la Convention de La Haye , la certification est valable au moyen d ' une apostille . Les Etats signataires de la Convention supprimant l ' exigence de la l\u00e9galisation des actes publics \u00e9trangers ( Convention de La Haye ) dispensent de la l\u00e9galisation les actes auxquels s ' applique la Convention et qui doivent \u00eatre produits sur leur territoire ( cf . l ' art . 2 de la Convention internationale de La Haye du 5 octobre 1961 supprimant l ' exigence de la l\u00e9galisation des actes publics \u00e9trangers ) . Pour tous les \u00c9tats qui ne sont pas repr\u00e9sent\u00e9s dans la Convention de La Haye , l ' attestation normale sans Apostille s ' applique , la sur - certification consulaire subs\u00e9quente \u00e9tant n\u00e9cessaire . Documentation Liste des Etats signataires de la Convention de La Haye ( PDF , 166 kB , 28 . 01 . 2025 ) Parties contractes Liste des autorit\u00e9s cantonales comp\u00e9tentes pour les l\u00e9galisations ( PDF , 87 kB , 23 . 02 . 2024 ) Aide - m\u00e9moire concernant la l\u00e9galisation de documents par la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ( PDF , 278 kB , 14 . 03 . 2023 ) Responsable RS 172 . 210 . 10 Ordonnance sur l ' organisation de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ( Org ChF ) , Art . 8
