sentence1: Guidelines and tools With the coming into force of the new Federal Act on Water Retaining Facilities as well as the corresponding Water Retaining Facilities Ordinance of January 1st 2013 , a revision of the old guidelines of 2002 has been necessary , taking the experience made so far into account . The presently valid guideline consists of parts A , B , C1 , C2 , C3 , D and E . Part A of the newly revised guideline deals with the regulatory framework and with the goals and purposes of the guideline , explains the safety concept for dams , includes a glossary for the guideline , gives an overview of the procedures relating to the construction and the operation of water retaining facilities and contains the list of references related to the guideline . This part replaces chapters 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 . 1 and 5 . 2 of the main guideline 2002 on dam safety as well as chapter 1 of the 2002 base document related to the criteria for subjecting water retaining facilities to the legislation . Part B ( dealing with the particular risk potential as a criterion for subjecting a water retaining facility to the legislation ) replaces chapters 5 . 3 and 5 . 4 of the main guideline on dam safety of 2002 as well as chapters 2 and 3 of the base document on the subjecting criteria of 2002 . Part C1 provides the procedure for the planning approval and the subsequent construction of dams as well as the operating and loading cases to be considered for the design of dams . It replaces chapters 6 and 9 of the main guideline on dam safety of 2002 as well as the corresponding base document of 2002 . Part C2 deals with the flood safety analysis of dams and replaces chapter 7 of the main guideline on dam safety of 2002 as well as the corresponding base document of 2008 . Part C3 deals with the earthquake safety analysis of dams and replaces chapters 8 of the main guideline on dam safety of 2002 as well as the corresponding base document of 2003 . Part D ( dealing with the commissioning , maintenance and surveillance of water retaining facilities ) specifies the procedure for commissioning and operation of water retaining facilities , defines the content of the surveillance regulations , specifies the continual inspections , the annual inspections and the five - yearly inspections , specifies the content of the archiving , specifies the procedure of planned overhauls and specifies the notifications of the operators to the supervisory authority . This part replaces chapters 10 and 11 of the main guideline 2002 on dam safety as well as the base document related to the surveillance and maintenance of 2002 . Part E ( dealing with the emergency concept ) specifies the requirements for the emergency concept of the operator and for the coordination of the emergency concept with the planning of the organs of civil defense bodies , gives an overview of the responsibilities for the creation of the emergency concept and for the handling of emergency situations , presents the means of alarm and the danger levels , and specifies the content of the emergency regulations . Documents Guidelines and tools Previous versions of the guideline Last modification 19 . 12 . 2017
sentence2: Directives et moyens auxiliaires Suite \u00e0 la r\u00e9vision de la l\u00e9gislation sur les ouvrages d ' accumulation entr\u00e9e en vigueur le 01 . 01 . 2013 , les anciennes directives de 2002 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9vis\u00e9es tenant compte des exp\u00e9riences faites \u00e0 ce jour . La directive actuelle comprends les parties A , B , C1 , C2 , C3 , D et E . La partie A de la directive r\u00e9vis\u00e9e ( \u00abG\u00e9n\u00e9ralit\u00e9s\u00bb ) introduit la base l\u00e9gale ainsi que le but et la port\u00e9e de la directive , explique le concept en vigueur pour la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 des ouvrages d ' accumulation , contient la d\u00e9finition des termes communs \u00e0 toutes les parties de la directive , donne la vue d ' ensemble des \u00e9tapes de proc\u00e9dure d ' un ouvrage d ' accumulation et contient la liste de r\u00e9f\u00e9rences unique \u00e0 la directive . Elle remplace les chapitres 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 . 1 et 5 . 2 de la directive 2002 ainsi que le chapitre 1 de la documentation de base de 2002 relative aux crit\u00e8res d ' assujettissement . La partie B ( \u00abRisque particulier comme crit\u00e8re d ' assujettissement\u00bb ) remplace les chapitres 5 . 3 et 5 . 4 de la directive 2002 ainsi que les chapitres 2 et 3 de la documentation de base de 2002 relative aux crit\u00e8res d ' assujettissement . La partie C1 ( \u00abDimensionnement et construction\u00bb ) contient des indications relatives \u00e0 la proc\u00e9dure d ' approbation des plans et \u00e0 la construction , contient des indications relatives \u00e0 l ' \u00e9laboration de la convention d ' utilisation et de la base du projet d ' un ouvrage d ' accumulation , et contient les objectifs de protection et les exigences minimales pour les cas de charge , les combinaisons de cas de charge ainsi que les facteurs de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 \u00e0 prendre en compte pour les sollicitations normales , exceptionnelles et extr\u00eames . Elle remplace les chapitres 6 et 9 de la directive 2002 ainsi que la documentation de base 2002 relative \u00e0 la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 structurale . La partie C2 ( \u00abS\u00e9curit\u00e9 en cas de crue et abaissement de la retenue\u00bb ) contient les objectifs de protection et les exigences minimales pour s\u00e9curit\u00e9 en cas de crue , contient les crit\u00e8res de dimensionnement des organes de vidange et de d\u00e9charge et d\u00e9finit le contenu du r\u00e8glement de manoeuvre des vannes . Elle remplace le chapitres 7 de la directive 2002 ainsi que la documentation de base 2008 relative \u00e0 la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 en cas de crue . La partie C3 ( \u00abS\u00e9curit\u00e9 aux s\u00e9ismes\u00bb ) contient les objectifs de protection et les exigences minimales pour la v\u00e9rification des ouvrages d ' accumulation aux s\u00e9ismes . Elle remplace le chapitres 8 de la directive 2002 ainsi que la documentation de base de 2003 relative \u00e0 la v\u00e9rification aux s\u00e9ismes . La partie D ( \u00abMise en service et exploitation \u2013 Mise en service , Maintenance , Surveillance\u00bb ) contient des informations relatives \u00e0 la proc\u00e9dure de mise en service et \u00e0 l ' exploitation , d\u00e9finit le contenu du r\u00e8glement de surveillance , pr\u00e9cise l ' \u00e9tendue des contr\u00f4les courants , annuels et quinquennaux , pr\u00e9cise le contenu du dossier sur l ' ouvrage d ' accumulation de l ' exploitant , pr\u00e9cise la proc\u00e9dure lors de travaux de r\u00e9vision et les diff\u00e9rents \u00e9v\u00e9nements devant \u00eatre annonc\u00e9s \u00e0 l ' autorit\u00e9 de surveillance . Elle remplace les chapitres 10 et 11 de la directive 2002 ainsi que la documentation de base de 2002 relative \u00e0 la surveillance et \u00e0 l ' entretien . La partie E ( \u00abPlan en cas d ' urgence\u00bb ) pr\u00e9cise les exigences au plan en cas d ' urgence de l ' exploitant , pr\u00e9cise les exigences quant \u00e0 la coordination du plan en cas d ' urgence avec le plan d ' intervention des organes de la protection de la population , donne une vue d ' ensemble quant aux comp\u00e9tences lors de l ' \u00e9tablissement du plan en cas d ' urgence et dans la ma\u00eetrise de situations d ' urgence , pr\u00e9sente les dispositifs d ' alarme ainsi que les niveaux de danger et d\u00e9finit le contenu du r\u00e8glement en cas d ' urgence . Documents Directives et moyens auxiliaires Versions pr\u00e9c\u00e9dentes de la directive Derni\u00e8re modification 19 . 12 . 2017

## Score scale

* **5:** Complete equivalence

* **1–2** Slightly similar or somewhat similar.
* **0:** No relation (there is no word in the other sentence that is even slightly similar in terms of semantics).
* **-1:** Punctuation

sentence1: Requirements for space and combination heaters The energy label for space and combination heaters with a rated heat output of 70 kW or less provides information on the energy efficiency , the rated heat output and the sound power level of the appliances declared with it . Minimum requirements apply to space and combination heaters with a rated heat output of 400 kW or less . The energy efficiency of space and combination heaters is to a large extent influenced by a proper installation , correct operation and maintenance . New : Electric boiler space and combination heaters will disappear from the Swiss market . The Federal Council has adopted stricter minimum requirements for these appliances than the EU , thus banning the latter technology . The new requirements apply as of 1 January 2024 . sentence2: Exigences pour les dispositifs de chauffage des locaux et mixtes L ' \u00e9tiquette - \u00e9nergie pour les dispositifs de chauffage des locaux et mixtes ayant une puissance thermique nominale inf\u00e9rieure ou \u00e9gale \u00e0 70 kW fournit des informations sur l ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique , la puissance nominale et le niveau de puissance acoustique des appareils d\u00e9clar\u00e9s . Des exigences minimales s ' appliquent aux dispositifs de chauffage des locaux et mixtes ayant une puissance thermique nominale inf\u00e9rieure ou \u00e9gale \u00e0 400 kW . sentence1: CO2 emission regulations for new vehicles CO2 emission regulations for new vehicles apply in Switzerland just as they do in the EU . As of 1 January 2025 , under the WLTP , the average level of emissions from passenger cars registered in Switzerland for the first time may not exceed 93 . 6 grams of CO2 per kilometre , while emissions from vans and light articulated vehicles ( known collectively as light commercial vehicles or LCVs ) registered for the first time may emit a maximum of 153 . 9 grams of CO2 per kilometre . The 2025 target values have been tightened compared to previous years . In addition , CO2 target values came into force for lorries and articulated vehicles ( heavy - duty vehicles , or HDVs ) for the first time on 1 January 2025 . Importers of new HDVs must reduce average emissions by 15 % against the EU regulation\u2019s reference values ( emissions of the new 2019 / 2020 fleet ) . Each importer\u2019s vehicle fleet has to meet an individual target based on these values . If the target is exceeded , the importer must pay a penalty . Small and large importers The CO2 regulations apply to all importers of new passenger cars , LCVs and HDVs , although a differentiation is made between small and large importers . A large importer is one who registers at least 50 passenger cars or at least six LCVs or two HDVs for the first time in Switzerland each year . All HDV importers and large importers of passenger cars and LCVs must be registered with the SFOE . Importers may join forces to form emissions pools in order to attain the minimum number of vehicles to qualify as large importers and so collectively meet the specified target level . Emissions pools have the same rights and obligations as large importers . Private individuals who import a new car directly are classified as small importers . They have the option of registering their vehicle via a large importer . In this way , they can reduce any penalties or benefit from a bonus that applies to privately imported efficient vehicles . Registering as a large importer or emissions pool www . uvek . egov . swiss To register as a large importer or emissions pool , go to the DETEC eGovernment portal at . Vehicle attestation FEDRO KDI portal for vehicle imports Small importers of passenger cars and LCVs must pay any carbon penalty due before registering vehicles in Switzerland . To start this process , the necessary vehicle data must first be recorded in digital form with the Federal Roads Office ( FEDRO ) . This can be done via the . The same obligations and procedures apply to small and large importers of HDVs as to large importers of passenger cars and LCVs . sentence2: Prescriptions concernant les \u00e9missions de CO2 des v\u00e9hicules neufs \u00c0 l\u2019instar de l\u2019Union europ\u00e9enne , la Suisse applique des prescriptions concernant les \u00e9missions de CO2 des v\u00e9hicules neufs . Depuis le 1er janvier 2025 , selon la proc\u00e9dure WLTP , les \u00e9missions des voitures de tourisme ( VT ) mises en circulation pour la premi\u00e8re fois en Suisse ne doivent en moyenne pas d\u00e9passer 93 , 6 g de CO2 / km . Les voitures de livraison et les tracteurs \u00e0 sellette l\u00e9gers ( ci - apr\u00e8s \u00abVUL\u00bb pour \u00abv\u00e9hicules utilitaires l\u00e9gers\u00bb ) immatricul\u00e9s pour la premi\u00e8re fois ne doivent pas g\u00e9n\u00e9rer plus de 153 , 9 g de CO2 / km . Les valeurs cibles pour 2025 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 abaiss\u00e9es par rapport aux ann\u00e9es pr\u00e9c\u00e9dentes . De plus , des valeurs cibles en mati\u00e8re de CO2 s\u2019appliquent pour la premi\u00e8re fois aux camions et aux tracteurs \u00e0 sellette classiques ( v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds ) \u00e0 partir du 1er janvier 2025 . Les importateurs de tels v\u00e9hicules neufs doivent r\u00e9duire les \u00e9missions moyennes de 15 % par rapport \u00e0 la valeur de base de la r\u00e9glementation europ\u00e9enne ( \u00e9missions du parc de voitures neuves 2019 / 2020 ) . Sur la base de ces valeurs cibles , l\u2019importateur doit respecter une valeur cible sp\u00e9cifique pour sa flotte . \u00c0 d\u00e9faut , il encourt une sanction . Petits importateurs et grands importateurs Les prescriptions relatives aux \u00e9missions de CO2 concernent tous les importateurs de VT , de VUL et de v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds neufs . On fait la distinction entre les grands importateurs et les petits importateurs . Est consid\u00e9r\u00e9 comme grand importateur celui qui immatricule pour la premi\u00e8re fois en Suisse au moins 50 VT , au moins six VUL ou au moins deux v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds neufs par an . Tous les importateurs de v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds ainsi que les grands importateurs de VT et de VUL doivent \u00eatre enregistr\u00e9s aupr\u00e8s de l\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie . Les importateurs peuvent former ensemble des groupements d\u2019\u00e9missions pour atteindre le nombre minimal de v\u00e9hicules permettant d\u2019acc\u00e9der au statut de grand importateur et d\u2019atteindre conjointement les valeurs cibles . Les groupements d\u2019\u00e9missions ont les m\u00eames droits et devoirs qu\u2019un grand importateur . Les particuliers qui importent directement leur voiture neuve sont consid\u00e9r\u00e9s comme de petits importateurs . Les petits importateurs ont la possibilit\u00e9 de soumettre leur v\u00e9hicule au calcul de la sanction par l\u2019interm\u00e9diaire d\u2019un grand importateur . Ils peuvent ainsi r\u00e9duire d\u2019\u00e9ventuelles sanctions ou profiter d\u2019un bonus lors de l\u2019importation \u00e0 titre priv\u00e9 de v\u00e9hicules \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiquement efficaces . Inscription en tant que grand importateur et groupement d\u2019\u00e9missions www . uvek . egov . swiss L\u2019inscription en tant que grand importateur ou groupement d\u2019\u00e9missions se fait en ligne sur le portail eGovernment DETEC . Attestation des v\u00e9hicules Importation d ' un v\u00e9hicule Avant d\u2019immatriculer un v\u00e9hicule , les petits importateurs de VT et de v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds doivent verser le montant d\u00fb en cas de sanction relative aux \u00e9missions de CO2 . Pour pouvoir lancer le processus , il convient tout d\u2019abord de saisir sous forme num\u00e9rique les donn\u00e9es requises concernant le v\u00e9hicule aupr\u00e8s de l\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral des routes via son portail d\u00e9di\u00e9 aux petits importateurs directs : S\u2019agissant des v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds , les obligations et les proc\u00e9dures pour les grands et petits importateurs sont les m\u00eames que pour les grands importateurs de VT et de v\u00e9hicules utilitaires l\u00e9gers . sentence1: Non - recurrent remuneration for large - scale photovoltaic systems With the amendments to the Energy Act adopted on 30 September 2022 ( urgent measures for the short - term provision of a secure electricity supply in winter , solar offensive ) , the Swiss Parliament facilitates the approval of large - scale photovoltaic plants and establishes a subsidy for these with a non - recurrent remuneration of up to 60 % of the investment costs . These facilitations apply until these new large - scale photovoltaic plants permit a total annual production of a maximum of 2 TWh throughout Switzerland . The amendments to the Energy Act are limited until 2025 . The plants must achieve a minimum annual production of 10 GWh and a specific production in the winter half - year ( 1 October - 31 March ) of 500 kWh per 1 kW of installed capacity . If these requirements are met , the non - recurrent remuneration is set at the level of the uncovered costs , but it amounts to a maximum of 60 % of the eligible investment costs . To benefit from the subsidy , at least 10 % of the expected production of the entire planned plant or 10 GWh must be fed into the grid by the end of 2025 . The deadline for full commissioning of the in - stallations is the end of 2030 . For those projects that do not meet these crite - ria , the normal non - recurrent remuneration for photovoltaic installations is available . The application for a non - recurrent remuneration in accordance with Art . 71a can be submitted to the SFOE as soon as a legally binding construction permit has been issued for the project . sentence2: R\u00e9tribution unique pour les grandes installations photovolta\u00efques Avec les modifications de la loi sur l ' \u00e9nergie adopt\u00e9es le 30 septembre 2022 ( mesures urgentes visant \u00e0 assurer rapidement l\u2019approvisionnement en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 pendant l\u2019hiver , offensive solaire ) , le Parlement facilite l ' autorisation des grandes installations photovolta\u00efques et fixe pour celles - ci une r\u00e9tribution unique , qui peut atteindre 60 % des co\u00fbts d\u2019investissement . Ces all\u00e8gements s\u2019appliqueront jusqu\u2019\u00e0 ce que ces nouvelles installations permettent d\u2019atteindre au niveau national une production annuelle maximale de 2 TWh . Ces adaptations de la loi sur l\u2019\u00e9nergie s\u2019appliqueront jusqu\u2019en 2025 . Les installations doivent atteindre une production annuelle minimale de 10 GWh et une production sp\u00e9cifique pendant le semestre d ' hiver ( 1er octobre - 31 mars ) de 500 kWh par 1 kW de puissance install\u00e9e . Si ces conditions sont remplies , la r\u00e9tribution unique correspond aux co\u00fbts non couverts ( selon le calcul de rentabilit\u00e9 ) , mais elle s ' \u00e9l\u00e8ve au maximum \u00e0 60 % des co\u00fbts d ' investissement imputables . Pour b\u00e9n\u00e9ficier de la subvention , l\u2019installation doit injection au moins 10 % de la production attendue pour l ' ensemble de l ' installation pr\u00e9vue ou 10 GWh dans le r\u00e9seau \u00e9lectrique d ' ici fin 2025 . La mise en service compl\u00e8te doit avoir lieu le 31 d\u00e9cembre 2030 au plus tard . Pour les projets ne remplissant pas ces crit\u00e8res , la r\u00e9tribution unique standard peut \u00eatre requise . La demande de r\u00e9tribution unique selon l ' art . 71a peut \u00eatre d\u00e9pos\u00e9e aupr\u00e8s de l ' OFEN d\u00e8s qu ' un permis de construire entr\u00e9 en force a \u00e9t\u00e9 d\u00e9livr\u00e9 pour le projet . sentence1: Standard ICT Services ICT services required by the different units of the Federal Administration with the same or similar level of functionality and quality are managed centrally for the entire Federal Administration and provided as standard services by the Digital Transformation and ICT Steering Sector ( DTI ) . The administrative units can choose between different specifications ( proposed services ) of standard ICT services . In accordance with the Ordinance on Digital Transformation and Information Technology , the Federal Chancellor defines the standard services that must be acquired . The DTI Sector also provides standard services . This means that it operates a centralised requirements and service provider management at federal level . The functionalities to be covered along with the sourcing , ordering and invoicing of services are defined In consultation with the departments and submitted to the Federal Chancellor . The principle of standard services allows for more effective steering and management of a substantial interdepartmental sub - segment of IT services by the Federal Council , and ultimately also enables synergies to be exploited and IT costs to be reduced . Current standard ICT services The DTI manages the following standard ICT services ( SS ) : Specialist staff

Selon l\u2019ordonnance sur la transformation num\u00e9rique et l\u2019informatique , le Chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration d\u00e9termine les services standard assortis d\u2019une obligation d\u2019acquisition . Le domaine TNI g\u00e8re les services standard , c\u2019est - \u00e0 - dire qu\u2019il op\u00e8re une gestion centralis\u00e9e des exigences et des fournisseurs de prestations au niveau de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . sentence1: Award of mobile telephony frequencies Planned award in 2027 Preparation for the new award of mobile phone licences The Federal Communications Commission ( ComCom ) has instructed the Federal Office of Communications ( OFCOM ) to prepare for awarding the mobile radio frequencies that will become available in 2029 . In the interests of competition and transparency , ComCom is planning a public tender for these frequencies , probably in 2026 . Frequency bands will be allocated by means of an auction if there is a shortage of frequencies . Public consultation regarding the allocation of mobile phone frequencies available from 2029 The Federal Communications Commission ( ComCom ) has instructed the Federal Office of Communications ( OFCOM ) to conduct a public consultation on the allocation of frequencies available from 2029 for the provision of telecommunication services for third parties . The results have been published in a report . Award in 2019 Mobile radio frequencies for 5G awarded in Switzerland The Federal Communications Commission ( ComCom ) has successfully awarded new mobile radio frequencies . All three current operators , Salt , Sunrise and Swisscom , could acquire a wide range of new frequencies in an auction . Consultation regarding the draft tender documents concerning the award The Federal Communications Commission ( ComCom ) has instructed the Federal Office of Communications ( OFCOM ) to prepare the award of new mobile telephony frequencies . Barring unforeseen circumstances , ComCom will launch the public invitation to tender concerning these frequencies during the current year . The frequencies will be awarded within the framework of an auction . With this in mind , interested telecommunications operators are invited to take part in this consultation on the initial draft of the tender documents . The consultation will run until 23 February 2018 . Award in 2012 Auction of mobile phone frequencies in 2012 The companies Orange , Sunrise and Swisscom have been allocated mobile telephony frequencies in the auction which took place in early 2012 . The allocation concerned on the one hand frequencies which were already free or which would soon become free and on the other hand all those granted to operators in the past ; the Communications Commission ( ComCom ) had launched the procedure to guarantee the future of mobile telephony provision of high quality and at the lowest possible prices . Last modification 17 . 09 . 2024

Consultation sur l ' attribution de nouvelles fr\u00e9quences de t\u00e9l\u00e9phonie mobile : prises de position L ' OFCOM a lanc\u00e9 une consultation publique sur l ' attribution de nouvelles fr\u00e9quences de t\u00e9l\u00e9phonie mobile qui seront lib\u00e9r\u00e9es d\u00e8s 2019 . Il souhaitait ainsi permettre \u00e0 tous les acteurs concern\u00e9s d ' exprimer leur avis , leurs besoins et leurs intentions . La consultation courrait jusqu ' au 31 juillet 2017 . L ' OFCOM a re\u00e7u 57 avis , qui peuvent \u00eatre consult\u00e9s ci - apr\u00e8s , ainsi que le rapport de synth\u00e8se des r\u00e9sultats . Attribution en 2012 Vente aux ench\u00e8res de fr\u00e9quences de t\u00e9l\u00e9phonie mobile en 2012 Les entreprises Orange , Sunrise et Swisscom se sont vu attribuer des fr\u00e9quences de t\u00e9l\u00e9phonie mobile dans le cadre des ench\u00e8res qui se sont d\u00e9roul\u00e9es d\u00e9but 2012 . L ' attribution concernait d ' une part les fr\u00e9quences qui \u00e9taient d\u00e9j\u00e0 libres ou allaient l ' \u00eatre prochainement et d ' autre part toutes celles octroy\u00e9es par le pass\u00e9 aux op\u00e9rateurs , La Commission de la communication ( ComCom ) avait lanc\u00e9 la proc\u00e9dure pour garantir \u00e0 l ' avenir des offres de t\u00e9l\u00e9phonie mobile de qualit\u00e9 et \u00e0 des prix aussi bas que possible . sentence1: Federal Chancellor Viktor Rossi Federal Chancellor Viktor Rossi , in office since 1 January 2024 , is the chief of staff of the Swiss government . He supports the President and the Federal Council in the performance of their government duties . Along with two vice chancellors , he attends the weekly Federal Council meetings . He participates in an advisory capacity and can submit motions . Born in 1968 , Viktor Rossi initially trained as a chef . He went on to earn a teaching degree in business and law from the University of Bern , and later , a master\u2019s degree in politics . He undertook further training in project and process management and in 2015 , he obtained a diploma of advanced studies in law . Before joining the Federal Chancellery , Viktor Rossi served as director of commercial school Bildung Formation Biel - Bienne ( BFB ) for 11 years . During that time he acted as vice president and secretary of the Canton of Bern\u2019s conference of vocational schools and professional colleges , and also as president of the Canton of Bern\u2019s conference of commercial school directors . He joined the Federal Chancellery in October 2010 to head the Records Management and Logistics Section . In November 2015 Viktor Rossi became the Federal Chancellor\u2019s delegate for GENOVA , a key ICT project to introduce a standard records and process management system for the Federal Administration . He was appointed vice chancellor in 2019 , heading the Federal Council sector . Viktor Rossi is married and has two daughters . He is a Swiss - Italian dual citizen . Specialist staff
sentence2: Viktor Rossi , chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration Le chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration dirige l\u2019\u00e9tat - major du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Il assiste le pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration et le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Il participe aux s\u00e9ances hebdomadaires du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , second\u00e9 par les vice - chanceliers ; durant ces s\u00e9ances , il a voix consultative et peut faire des propositions . Viktor Rossi est n\u00e9 en 1968 . Apr\u00e8s un apprentissage de cuisinier , il obtient une maturit\u00e9 gymnasiale et fait des \u00e9tudes \u00e0 l\u2019Universit\u00e9 de Berne pour devenir enseignant d\u2019\u00e9conomie et de droit . Il suit par ailleurs diverses formations en cours d\u2019emploi en gestion de conduite , de projet et de processus et obtient en 2015 un Diploma of Advanced Studies en droit . Viktor Rossi dirige pendant 11 ans l\u2019\u00e9cole professionnelle commerciale de Bienne . Il exerce en parall\u00e8le les fonctions de vice - pr\u00e9sident et de secr\u00e9taire de la Conf\u00e9rence des \u00e9coles professionnelles et \u00e9coles sup\u00e9rieures du canton de Berne et de pr\u00e9sident de la Conf\u00e9rence des recteurs d\u2019\u00e9coles professionnelles commerciales du canton de Berne . Il rejoint la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale en 2010 , o\u00f9 il prend la t\u00eate de la section Gestion des affaires et logistique . Il est responsable \u00e0 partir de 2015 , sur mandat du chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , du projet informatique cl\u00e9 GENOVA ( introduction d\u2019une solution standard de gestion des affaires pour l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale centrale ) . Il est nomm\u00e9 vice - chancelier en 2019 et dirige d\u00e8s lors le secteur Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Il est mari\u00e9 et p\u00e8re de deux filles adultes . This year ' s trophies were presented to the winners on the occasion of the Swiss Federal Office of Energy ' s New Year ' s event that was held on 10 January 2019 in Bern . The following projects were chosen to receive the various awards ( all of which are of equal value ) : \u201cEnergy technologies\u201d category DEPsys SA and IBB Energie AG : GridEye \u2013 autopilot in the smart grid DEPsys SA at Puidoux in the Canton of Vaud has brought the smart - grid platform \u201cGridEye\u201d to the point where it is ready for the market . The platform helps grid operators integrate ever - increasing amounts of decentrally produced fluctuating energy into the grid . Grideye can be easily incorporated into the existing infrastructure . On the basis of measurements the intelligent software learns about the actual condition of the grid . Information derived about the current situation is thus used to control energy flows optimally , safely and efficiently . GridEye was installed on behalf of IBB Energie AG at Birrfeld airfield . Since then the large 200 kW photovoltaic array on the hangar of the Aargau Aero Club has been able to feed in the maximum output without jeopardising the safety of the grid . \u201cRenewable energy\u201d category dhp technology AG and IBC Energie Wasser Chur : Suspended solar power plants \u2013 cable car technology facilitates double use of infrastructure areas To facilitate the use of infrastructure areas , such as car parks and the space above sewage treatment plants , dhp technology AG from Zizers in the Canton of Grisons has brought to market the \u201cHORIZON\u201d foldable , lightweight construction solar plant . Using cable car technology HORIZON is suspended five metres above the infrastructure area in question and folds up like a concertina . A meteorological algorithm deploys the array when the sun shines and folds it up again during windy spells and snowfall . The first major HORIZON plant was realised for IBC Energie Wasser Chur and installed over the Chur sewage treatment plant where it went into operation in 2018 . The plant produces 540 , 000 kilowatt - hours of electricity per year , which covers around 20 % of the electricity requirement of the facility . \u201cEnergy - efficient mobility\u201d category BLS AG and the University of Basel : Step by step toward greater energy efficiency If we want to save energy , we first have to have detailed measurements of consumption . When retired physicist Prof . Dr . Peter Oelhafen came up with the idea of such a measurement campaign in railway vehicles and rolling stock , he was welcomed with open arms by BLS AG . The impressive results of the campaign led to a comprehensive modernisation programme for 36 NINA suburban trains that will be completed in 2019 . In this way and using further efficiency measures for the remainder of the railway rolling stock , BLS saves about 13 million kilowatt - hours of electricity , an amount equivalent to the annual consumption of 3 , 000 households . Other transport companies and partners in research and industry are participating In sub - projects of the energy economy programme initiated by Peter Oelhafen . \u201cBuildings and space\u201d category Habitat Foundation and ADEV Energiegenossenschaft : Erlenmatt Ost \u2013 A sustainable , colourful area with local energy production and supply On the space that was once the Deutsche Bahn goods station in Basel the Stiftung Habitat ( Habitat Foundation ) has developed the new city district called Erlenmatt Ost . People moved into the first buildings in 2017 ; by the end of 2019 about 500 occupants will live in the area in more than 200 apartments . One thing is clear now : the district is lively , colourful and sustainable and entirely in harmony with the tenets of the 2 , 000 Watt Society . The standards for a sustainable district are measurable and create a logical framework which is understood by the residents and put into effect in their daily lives . The ADEV Energiegenossenschaft ( energy cooperative ) makes a significant contribution because it has established one of the largest solar energy consumer communities in Switzerland here . When it is completed Erlenmatt Ost will be supplied with 70 % of its electricity and heating requirement from on - site facilities . Special \u201cTransition\u201d award Empa , Eawag and dransfeldarchitekten ag : NEST \u2013 a Lego house expedites innovation Energy conservation and resource - saving innovations are only slowly making inroads in the building sector . Investors and builders are reluctant to innovate and take a risk so they often fall back on existing solutions . The NEST \ living lab \ initiated by Empa and Eawag in 2016 along with 140 partners from research , the economy and the public sector aims to accelerate innovation processes in the building sector . Thematic units , which can be built into NEST like Lego bricks , make this possible . One particularly attractive unit is the fitness and wellness facility which is entirely solar powered and uses six times less energy than a conventional spa . The unit was planned by dransfeldarchitekten ag from Ermatingen . sentence2: Laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2019 Les laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2019 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9compens\u00e9s ! Les laur\u00e9ats du concours de cette ann\u00e9e se sont vu remettre leur troph\u00e9e \u00e0 l ' occasion de l ' ap\u00e9ritif du Nouvel An organis\u00e9 par l ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie , le 10 janvier 2019 \u00e0 Berne . Les projets suivants ont tous re\u00e7u le m\u00eame prix : Cat\u00e9gorie Technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques DEPsys SA et IBB Energie AG : GridEye \u2013 pilotage automatique dans les r\u00e9seaux intelligents Install\u00e9e \u00e0 Puidoux dans le canton de Vaud , DEPsys SA a d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 et mis sur le march\u00e9 la plateforme de r\u00e9seaux intelligents \u00abGridEye\u00bb . Cette plateforme soutient les gestionnaires de r\u00e9seau , qui sont amen\u00e9s \u00e0 int\u00e9grer une quantit\u00e9 toujours croissante d ' \u00e9nergie d\u00e9centralis\u00e9e et fluctuante dans le r\u00e9seau \u00e9lectrique . GridEye s ' int\u00e8gre tr\u00e8s facilement dans l ' infrastructure existante . Le logiciel intelligent effectue des mesures pour conna\u00eetre le comportement du r\u00e9seau . Il en d\u00e9duit des informations concernant l ' \u00e9tat actuel de ce dernier , ce qui lui permet de g\u00e9rer les flux d ' \u00e9nergie de mani\u00e8re optimale , efficacement et en toute s\u00e9curit\u00e9 . GridEye a \u00e9t\u00e9 install\u00e9 \u00e0 l ' a\u00e9rodrome de Birrfeld sur mandat d ' IBB Energie AG . Depuis , l ' installation photovolta\u00efque de 200 kW , pos\u00e9e sur le toit du hangar de l ' a\u00e9roclub d ' Argovie , peut injecter sa puissance maximale sans menacer la stabilit\u00e9 du r\u00e9seau . Cat\u00e9gorie Energies renouvelables DHP Technology AG et IBC Energie Wasser Chur : Centrales solaires flottantes \u2013 double utilisation de la surface des infrastructures avec une technologie emprunt\u00e9e aux remont\u00e9es m\u00e9caniques Afin de faire un usage multiple de la surface d ' infrastructures telles que les parkings ou les stations d ' \u00e9puration , DHP Technology AG de Zizers dans le canton des Grisons a d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 et mis sur le march\u00e9 \u00abHORIZON\u00bb , une installation photovolta\u00efque de conception l\u00e9g\u00e8re et mobile . HORIZON flotte cinq m\u00e8tres au - dessus de la surface des infrastructures gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 l ' utilisation d ' une technologie emprunt\u00e9e aux remont\u00e9es m\u00e9caniques et est capable de se replier comme un accord\u00e9on . Un algorithme m\u00e9t\u00e9orologique d\u00e9ploie automatiquement l ' installation par temps ensoleill\u00e9 et le replie en cas de vent fort ou de chute de neige importante . Mise en service en 2018 , la premi\u00e8re grande installation HORIZON a \u00e9t\u00e9 construite \u00e0 la station d ' \u00e9puration de Coire sur mandat d ' IBC Energie Wasser Chur . Elle produit chaque ann\u00e9e environ 540 000 kilowattheures de courant , ce qui permet de couvrir environ 20 % des besoins en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 de la station d ' \u00e9puration . Cat\u00e9gorie Mobilit\u00e9 \u00e9conome en \u00e9nergie BLS SA et l ' Universit\u00e9 de B\u00e2le : Davantage d ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique sur les rails Si on veut \u00e9conomiser de l ' \u00e9nergie , il faut commencer par effectuer une mesure d\u00e9taill\u00e9e de la consommation . L ' id\u00e9e du professeur Peter Oelhafen , physicien \u00e9m\u00e9rite , d ' une campagne de mesure pour v\u00e9hicules ferroviaires a \u00e9t\u00e9 accueillie avec int\u00e9r\u00eat par BLS SA . Les r\u00e9sultats impressionnants ont conduit au lancement d ' un vaste programme de modernisation des 36 rames NINA , qui s ' ach\u00e8vera en 2019 . Cette mesure d ' efficacit\u00e9 , compl\u00e9t\u00e9e par d ' autres qui concernent le reste de la flotte de v\u00e9hicules sur rails , permet \u00e0 BLS d ' \u00e9conomiser environ 13 millions de kilowattheures d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 par an , ce qui correspond \u00e0 la consommation annuelle de plus de 3000 m\u00e9nages . D ' autres entreprises de transport et de nombreux partenaires issus de la recherche et de l ' industrie participent aux projets partiels du programme d ' \u00e9conomie d ' \u00e9nergie lanc\u00e9 par Peter Oelhafen . Cat\u00e9gorie B\u00e2timents et espace La Fondation Habitat et la coop\u00e9rative ADEV : Erlenmatt Ost \u2013 un quartier durable et h\u00e9t\u00e9roclite qui produit son \u00e9nergie et s ' approvisionne en local La Fondation Habitat d\u00e9veloppe le nouveau quartier urbain d ' Erlenmatt Ost \u00e0 l ' emplacement de l ' ancienne gare de marchandises de la Deutsche Bahn \u00e0 B\u00e2le . Les premiers habitants ont emm\u00e9nag\u00e9 en 2017 et environ 500 personnes y occuperont plus de 200 appartements d ' ici \u00e0 fin 2019 . Le quartier affiche d\u00e9j\u00e0 un caract\u00e8re dynamique , h\u00e9t\u00e9roclite et durable : tout \u00e0 fait dans l ' esprit de la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e0 2000 watts . Les objectifs de durabilit\u00e9 sont mesurables et forment un cadre logique que les habitants comprennent et mettent en application . La participation de la coop\u00e9rative ADEV est \u00e9galement importante : elle a cr\u00e9\u00e9 ici une des plus grandes communaut\u00e9s de consommation propre dans le domaine de l ' \u00e9nergie solaire en Suisse . Au terme du projet , Erlenmatt Ost sera approvisionn\u00e9 \u00e0 plus de 70 % avec du courant et de la chaleur produits directement sur place . Prix sp\u00e9cial \ Transition \ Empa , Eawag et dransfeldarchitekten ag : NEST \u2013 une maison s ' inspirant des briques Lego pour acc\u00e9l\u00e9rer l ' innovation Dans le domaine des b\u00e2timents , les innovations \u00e9conomes en \u00e9nergie et pr\u00e9servant les ressources ne progressent que lentement . Les investisseurs et les ma\u00eetres d ' ouvrage rechignent \u00e0 prendre des risques et \u00e0 innover , et privil\u00e9gient souvent les solutions existantes . Lanc\u00e9 par l ' Empa et l ' Eawag en 2016 , le \u00abliving lab\u00bb NEST entend acc\u00e9l\u00e9rer les processus d ' innovation dans le domaine des b\u00e2timents en collaboration avec quelque 140 partenaires issus de la recherche , de l ' \u00e9conomie et des pouvoirs publics . Cela est possible gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 des \u00abunit\u00e9s\u00bb th\u00e9matiques qui peuvent \u00eatre int\u00e9gr\u00e9es \u00e0 NEST telles des pi\u00e8ces de Lego . Le centre de fitness et de bien - \u00eatre con\u00e7u par dransfeldarchitekten ag d ' Ermatingen est une unit\u00e9 particuli\u00e8rement attrayante : le centre fonctionne uniquement \u00e0 l ' \u00e9nergie solaire et consomme six fois moins d ' \u00e9nergie que les installations classiques . Documents Watt d ' Or 2019 Liens OFEN - Blog energeiaplus du 10 janvier 2019 OFEN - Blog energeiaplus du 11 janvier 2019 Photos de la remise des prix du 10 janvier 2019 Watt d ' Or sur Youtube M\u00e9dias L\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019\u00e9nergie d\u00e9cerne pour la douzi\u00e8me fois le Watt d\u2019Or , le prix suisse de l\u2019\u00e9nergie Derni\u00e8re modification 10 . 01 . 2019

sentence1: Translation The Federal Administration serves a multilingual population , and so is required to produce publications and documents in German , French and Italian . Some official texts are also published in Romansh and in English . Translation services ensure that all texts can be understood both within and outside of the Administration . Translation also contributes to national cohesion and establishes a link between the different languages and cultures . Network of translators in the Federal Administration The translators in the Federal Administration are organised into a network comprising , for each of the official languages ( German , French and Italian ) : Translations into English are produced by the English Language Service in the Federal Chancellery and by translators in the federal departments and offices . The Romansh language service is also based in the Federal Chancellery ; a sole person coordinates the Romansh translations for the whole of the Federal Administration . Links English Language Service Style Guides for English - language translators Conference of Translation Services of European States ( COTSOES )

Elle renforce \u00e9galement la coh\u00e9sion nationale en \u00e9tablissant un lien entre les diverses langues et cultures . R\u00e9seau des traducteurs de l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale Les traducteurs de l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sont organis\u00e9s en un r\u00e9seau qui regroupe , pour chacune des trois langues officielles que sont l ' allemand , le fran\u00e7ais et l ' italien : Les traductions en anglais sont assur\u00e9es par un service linguistique central rattach\u00e9 \u00e0 la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , et par des traducteurs dans les d\u00e9partements et les offices f\u00e9d\u00e9raux . Le service linguistique romanche est lui aussi rattach\u00e9 \u00e0 la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Il comprend une seule et unique personne qui coordonne les traductions de toute l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . sentence1: Energy perspectives 2050 Energy Perspectives 2050 were produced while devising the first package of measures for Energy Strategy 2050 . This involved updating Energy Perspectives 2035 and extending it to cover the period to 2050 . A summary of the results have been published online along with the comprehensive reports on electricity supply and demand and the economic impact in 2012 and 2013 ( see below ) . At the start of 2011 , Energy Perspectives 2035 was updated for the first time to provide a basis that would allow the Federal Council , following the reactor accident at Fukushima , to review and revise its basic position on energy policy ( Federal Council Media Release on 25 . 05 . 2011 ) . The resulting reports are available online under \ Grundlagen f\u00fcr die Energiestrategie des Bundesrates ; Fr\u00fchjahr 2011 \ ( see below ) . sentence2: Perspectives \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques 2050 Les perspectives \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques 2050 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 d\u00e9velopp\u00e9es dans le cadre de l ' \u00e9laboration du premier paquet de mesures de la Strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique 2050 . Pour ce faire , les perspectives \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques 2035 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 mises \u00e0 jour et l ' horizon temporel a \u00e9t\u00e9 port\u00e9 \u00e0 2050 . Une synth\u00e8se des r\u00e9sultats a \u00e9t\u00e9 publi\u00e9e en 2012 et 2013 sous forme \u00e9lectronique avec les rapports complets sur la demande en \u00e9nergie , l ' offre d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 ainsi que les cons\u00e9quences \u00e9conomiques ( voir ci - dessous ) . Les perspectives \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques 2035 ont d\u00e9j\u00e0 \u00e9t\u00e9 mises \u00e0 jour une premi\u00e8re fois d\u00e9but 2011 . Il s ' agissait de disposer de donn\u00e9es de base permettant au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral d ' examiner et de red\u00e9finir sa position de principe en mati\u00e8re de politique \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique apr\u00e8s la catastrophe de Fukushima ( communiqu\u00e9 de presse du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral du 25 mai 2011 ) . Les rapports en r\u00e9sultant sont disponibles sous forme \u00e9lectronique ci - dessous ( Donn\u00e9es de base pour la strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral ; printemps 2011 ) . HSG , head of the Economic Cooperation and Development Division and delegate of the Federal Council for Trade Agreements since 1 September 2021 . From 2017 to 2021 , Ambassador of Switzerland to Turkey and from 2012 to 2017 , deputy director of the Directorate for European Affairs of the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs ( FDFA ) , where he was in particular responsible for the economic and sectoral matters of Swiss relations with the EU . In 2010 / 2011 , he headed the Section for Humanitarian Policy and Migration in the FDFA\u2019s Peace and Human Rights Division . From 2007 to 2010 , he was head of economic affairs at the Swiss embassy in Rome and from 2003 to 2007 , member of the OECD delegation in Paris , where he was appointed Counsellor of the embassy in 2007 . From 2000 to 2003 , he worked at SECO\u2019s WTO division , after having worked in 1999 for the Permanent Mission of Switzerland to the WTO in Geneva . Mr Paravicini joined the FDFA\u2019s diplomatic service in 1998 . From 1993 to 1998 , he was a delegate of the International Committee of the Red Cross ( ICRC ) , working in field operations in Sri Lanka , Mexico , Haiti , South Sudan , and Rwanda , and at the ICRC\u2019s headquarters in Geneva . HSG , est le chef du centre de prestations Coop\u00e9ration et d\u00e9veloppement \u00e9conomiques et d\u00e9l\u00e9gu\u00e9 du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral aux accords commerciaux depuis le 1er septembre 2021 . Il a \u00e9t\u00e9 ambassadeur de Suisse en Turquie de 2017 \u00e0 2021 et , de 2012 \u00e0 2017 , directeur suppl\u00e9ant de la Direction des affaires europ\u00e9ennes du D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral des affaires \u00e9trang\u00e8res ( DFAE ) , o\u00f9 il \u00e9tait notamment charg\u00e9 des questions \u00e9conomiques et sectorielles dans les relations de la Suisse avec l\u2019UE . En 2010 et 2011 , il a dirig\u00e9 la section charg\u00e9e de la politique humanitaire et des migrations au sein de la Division Paix et droits de l\u2019homme du DFAE . Apr\u00e8s avoir \u0153uvr\u00e9 de 2003 \u00e0 2007 au sein de la D\u00e9l\u00e9gation de l\u2019OCDE \u00e0 Paris , o\u00f9 il a \u00e9t\u00e9 nomm\u00e9 conseiller d\u2019ambassade en 2007 , il a repris la direction du service \u00e9conomique de l\u2019ambassade de Suisse \u00e0 Rome ( 2007 - 2010 ) . Entre 2000 et 2003 , il a \u00e9t\u00e9 au service du secteur OMC du SECO , apr\u00e8s avoir travaill\u00e9 en 1999 pour la Mission permanente de la Suisse pr\u00e8s l\u2019OMC \u00e0 Gen\u00e8ve . sentence2: Transparence et implication de la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 civile Afin de tenir compte des pr\u00e9occupations des parties prenantes et d ' assurer un dialogue continu avec ces derni\u00e8res , diff\u00e9rents instruments sont r\u00e9guli\u00e8rement utilis\u00e9s . La soci\u00e9t\u00e9 civile est r\u00e9guli\u00e8rement inform\u00e9e et consult\u00e9e sur les th\u00e8mes actuels dans le cadre des n\u00e9gociations et de la mise en \u0153uvre des accords \u00e9conomiques . Les informations pertinentes ainsi que les \u00e9ventuels probl\u00e8mes et propositions sont pr\u00e9sent\u00e9s et discut\u00e9s dans diff\u00e9rents forums . Information sur l ' \u00e9tat et les perspectives des n\u00e9gociations en cours , la mise en \u0153uvre des accords conclus et possibilit\u00e9 de prendre position ( diff\u00e9rents accords ) . Echange sur les d\u00e9veloppements et les d\u00e9fis actuels du commerce mondial , information sur l ' \u00e9tat et les perspectives des n\u00e9gociations en cours , la mise en \u0153uvre des accords conclus et possibilit\u00e9 de prendre position ( OMC , ALE , accords sp\u00e9cifiques ponctuels et autres th\u00e8mes li\u00e9s \u00e0 l ' exportation ) . Information sur l ' \u00e9tat et les perspectives des n\u00e9gociations en cours , la mise en \u0153uvre des accords conclus et possibilit\u00e9 de prendre position ( OMC , ALE et accords sp\u00e9cifiques ponctuels ) . Commission de la politique \u00e9conomique Membres : voir Consultation r\u00e9guli\u00e8re des organisations centrales des partenaires sociaux et des repr\u00e9sentants de l ' administration sur les questions relatives \u00e0 la durabilit\u00e9 sociale et aux dialogues bilat\u00e9raux sur le travail ( OIT et ses conventions ) . Commission tripartite pour les affaires de l ' OIT Membres : voir Les textes mod\u00e8les de l ' AELE sont consult\u00e9s avec les Comit\u00e9s consultatifs de l ' AELE , information sur l ' \u00e9tat et les perspectives des n\u00e9gociations en cours , la mise en \u0153uvre des accords conclus et possibilit\u00e9 de prendre position ( ALE ) . Advisory Bodies | European Free Trade Association Membres : voir Information aux repr\u00e9sentants de la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 civile , de l ' \u00e9conomie , de la communaut\u00e9 scientifique , des secr\u00e9tariats des partis et des cantons ( CdC ) sur l ' \u00e9tat et les perspectives des n\u00e9gociations en cours , la mise en \u0153uvre des accords conclus et possibilit\u00e9 de prendre position ( OMC , ALE et accords sp\u00e9cifiques ponctuels ) . Tables rondes informelles / panels de discussion ( Chatham House Rule ) avec des repr\u00e9sentants de la communaut\u00e9 scientifique , de l ' \u00e9conomie , de la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 civile , de l ' administration sur des questions actuelles dans le domaine du commerce et du d\u00e9veloppement durable ( OMC , ALE , Coop\u00e9ration et d\u00e9veloppement \u00e9conomiques ) . La premi\u00e8re table ronde a eu lieu en juin 2021 sur le th\u00e8me du commerce , du changement climatique et des ODD . sentence1: Strategic Management Support What will Switzerland look like in the year 2030 ? What challenges does the country face ? These are questions that the Federal Chancellery attempts to answer for the Federal Council . It monitors international trends , constructs scenarios and , on the basis of these , proposes the political action to be taken . This forms the basis of the four year legislature plan , from which the Federal Council\u2019s annual objectives are derived . sentence1: English The Federal Chancellery\u2019s English Language Service translates texts into English for many of the federal offices and agencies and for the Parliamentary Services . English is increasingly important , but has no legal force English is neither an official nor a national language of Switzerland , yet it plays an important role in our country . Just as the export industry , service sector and tourism would not be able to exist nowadays without using English , the Federal Council and Federal Administration increasingly need to be able to communicate and produce information in English in certain contexts . More and more important legislative texts are being made available in English , although the English version does not have any legal force . The English Language Service in the Federal Chancellery is responsible for the English translation of legislative texts and for keeping existing English language versions of laws up to date . As Switzerland is a European country with close ties to the European Union , the Federal Chancellery applies the conventions of British English , the exception being when correspondence or documents are specifically intended for a US audience . Cooperation and Coordination The English Language Service coordinates the network of English translators in the Federal Administration and regularly organises continuing education and training events . Translation In addition to translating and updating the English versions of legislative texts , the English Language Service also translates publications , speeches , webpages and regular publications such as The Swiss Confederation \u2013 A Brief Guide . Terminology The Federal Chancellery also records terminology in English . The federal terminology database , TERMDAT , contains an increasing number of English entries and equivalents . Contact english @ bk . admin . ch The English Language Service is part of the Terminology Section . All enquiries and translation assignments should be sent to Important information As the English Language Service is a small team and serves a large number of clients , we usually operate at full or close to full capacity . It is therefore in everyone ' s interests to think ahead ! Every assignment should be accompanied by the following information : Further information Documents Legislation ( English ) \u2022 Article 14 of the Language Services Ordinance ( English ) Terminology Section Translation Terminology Federal Chancellery English Style Guide ( PDF , 1 MB , 07 . 06 . 2016 ) TERMDAT , the Federal Administration\u2019s terminology database ( www . termdat . ch )
sentence2: Anglais Le Service linguistique anglais de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale effectue des travaux de traduction pour de nombreux offices f\u00e9d\u00e9raux et pour les Services du Parlement . Une langue incontournable mais sans force juridique Bien que l\u2019anglais ne fasse pas partie des langues nationales ou officielles suisses , son usage est toujours plus fr\u00e9quent dans notre pays . Si l\u2019industrie d\u2019exportation , le secteur des services et le tourisme ne peuvent gu\u00e8re se passer de l\u2019anglais aujourd\u2019hui , il arrive aussi de plus en plus que le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et l\u2019administration doivent communiquer et informer en anglais \u00e0 certaines occasions . Une version anglaise est donc \u00e9galement disponible dans le cas d\u2019actes normatifs importants , mais elle ne fait pas foi . C\u2019est le Service linguistique anglais de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale qui est charg\u00e9 de traduire et d\u2019actualiser les textes juridiques existants . Compte tenu des liens \u00e9troits que la Suisse entretient avec l ' Union europ\u00e9enne , la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale utilise en g\u00e9n\u00e9ral l ' anglais britannique , sauf pour les textes qui s ' adressent \u00e0 un public am\u00e9ricain . Coop\u00e9ration et coordination Le Service linguistique anglais collabore avec les traducteurs de langue anglaise travaillant dans d\u2019autres services de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et organise r\u00e9guli\u00e8rement des formations continues . Traduction Parall\u00e8lement \u00e0 la traduction d\u2019actes l\u00e9gislatifs et \u00e0 leur mise \u00e0 jour , le Service linguistique anglais fournit une version anglaise des textes d\u2019information paraissant r\u00e9guli\u00e8rement tels que la brochure La Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration en bref , qui est publi\u00e9e chaque ann\u00e9e . D\u2019autres parutions , discours , pages Internet , etc . , sont traduits selon les besoins . Terminologie La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale recense aussi la terminologie anglaise . La banque de donn\u00e9es terminologique de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration ( TERMDAT ) compte ainsi un nombre croissant de fiches contenant des \u00e9quivalents dans cette langue . Demandes et mandats de traduction english @ bk . admin . ch Le Service linguistique anglais de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale est rattach\u00e9 \u00e0 la Section de terminologie . Veuillez svp . adresser vos demandes et vos mandats \u00e0 . Information importante Le Service linguistique anglais est une petite \u00e9quipe qui doit satisfaire un nombre important de clients . Pour cette raison , il est indispensable , avant d ' envoyer tout mandat de traduction , de tenir compte des \u00e9l\u00e9ments suivants : Tout mandat devrait \u00eatre accompagn\u00e9 des informations suivantes : Actes l\u00e9gislatifs ( en anglais ) Article 14 de l\u2019ordonnance sur les services linguistiques ( Anglais ) Section de terminologie Traduction Terminologie Liens utiles pour l\u00b4anglais English Style Guide ( PDF , 1 MB , 07 . 06 . 2016 ) Banque de donn\u00e9es terminologiques de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale TERMDAT ( www . termdat . ch )

sentence1: History of the Federal Chancellery The Federal Chancellery has existed since 1803 , making it 45 years older than the Swiss federal state itself , which was established in 1848 . The office of federal chancellor has been held by fifteen men and women to date . The Swiss Federal Chancellery ( FCh ) is the oldest institution among the federal authorities . It was created as a permanent federal body on the initiative of Napoleon Bonaparte . The Act of Mediation establishing the Swiss Confederation , issued by the French ruler in 1803 , mentions both a chancellor and a chamberlain . These two positions were almost the only permanent posts in the Confederation up to the founding of the modern federal state in 1848 . Federal Council\u2019s staff office When the federal state was founded , the chancellery lost in importance : it became the secretariat to the Federal Council and Parliament , responsible for taking the minutes of their meetings . It also issued legislative texts and the Federal Gazette , organised popular votes and , up to 1919 , curated the federal archives . In the 1960s administrative reforms were introduced which led to the Federal Chancellery becoming the Federal Council\u2019s staff office . Since then , the Chancellor has been the government\u2019s chief of staff . He or she has the right to make proposals at Federal Council meetings ; initially this right applied to Federal Chancellery business only , but since 2014 it has applied to all items of business . The Chancellor also presents the Federal Chancellery dossiers before Parliament . Major dates in the history of the Federal Chancellery 1803 The Act of Mediation of 19 February 1803 mentions both a chancellor and a chamberlain . Their salary and accommodation are paid for by the canton presiding over the Tagsatzung in the given year ; since the presiding canton changes each year , the Federal Chancellery has to move to a new city every twelve months , taking with it all its files and furniture . On 5 July the Diet elects Jean Marc Samuel Isaac Mousson as the first chancellor of the Confederation . 1848 Article 93 of the Federal Constitution of 12 September defines the role of the Federal Chancellery and the Federal Chancellor . On 16 November Parliament elects Johann Ulrich Schiess as the first chancellor of the new federal state . The Federal Council and the Federal Chancellery are housed in the Erlacherhof in Bern , in which the Federal Chancellor\u2019s and Vice Chancellor\u2019s apartments are also situated . 1849 It was decreed in an ordinance that the Federal Gazette , containing all important official notices , is to be published weekly in German and French . 1850 Regulations on the Swiss Federal Chancellery are published , setting out its tasks . The following functions are mentioned : chancellor , vice chancellor , archivist , registrar , 2 secretaries , 3 translators , 5 copyists . Working hours are Monday to Saturday , 8am\u201312pm and 2pm\u20134pm . Employees also have to report to the Chancellery after church on Sunday mornings , \u201cunless granted leave by the Chancellor\u201d . 1857 Parliament and the Federal Administration moves to the newly constructed Bundesrathhaus , now the west wing of the Federal Palace . The building also houses the Chancellor\u2019s and Vice Chancellor\u2019s private apartments . 1866 14 . 01 . 1866 : nine proposals , eight of which the voters rejected The Federal Chancellery organises the first federal popular vote ( ) . 1885 The Federal Chancellery applies to the Federal Council for a typewriter , a request that is approved . The machine proved so useful that a second one was acquired in the same year . 1914 The Federal Act on the Organisation of the Federal Administration comes into force , the first comprehensive act relating to government organisation . The number of employees in central government ( not including customs , post and telegraph , railways and other state - owned entities ) has grown from 80 in 1848 to nearly 3 , 000 . 1918 Extracts from the Federal Gazette are published separately for the first time in Italian . 1934 Parliament elects George Bovet as the first French - speaking chancellor of the federal state . 1966 The Federal Chancellery begins forming the Classified Compilation of Federal Legislation ( SR ) , a loose - leaf collection . 1968 The Federal Council upgrades the Federal Chancellery to the status of staff office , and places it directly under the Federal Council collegium . The Chancellery thus plays a central role in coordinating and preparing government affairs and advising the government . The Federal Chancellor is now government chief of staff . He coordinates the joint reports procedure and is granted the right to make proposals to the Federal Council on matters relating to the Federal Chancellery . He is also permitted to present these proposals to Parliament . 1972 The Parliamentary Services are finally separated operationally from the Federal Chancellery , although they continue to be subordinate to the Chancellery on an administrative level . 1978 The Federal Act on Political Rights comes into force . This covers all political rights : voting rights , popular votes , referendums , popular initiatives , elections to the National Council and the appeals procedure . 1991 The Federal Council elects Hanna Muralt M\u00fcller as the first female vice chancellor . 1998 The Federal Chancellery introduces IT over the course of the 1990s . This means faster access to legal texts for the public , using CD - ROM or the internet . The Classified Compilation ( SR ) and the Official Compilation ( AS ) are available online from 1998 , the Federal Gazette from 1999 . 1999 The Federal Assembly elects Annemarie Huber - Hotz as the first female chancellor . 2000 The new Constitution clearly separates the Federal Chancellery and the Parliamentary Services . The Government and Administration Organisation Act establishes the new position of Federal Council spokesperson . The Federal Council appoints Vice Chancellor Achille Casanova as the first spokesperson . 2004 electronic voting system On 26 September 2004 the Canton of Geneva conducts the first test of the , Vote \u00e9lectronique , in a federal vote . The test is run in four communes , and is a success . 2014 Presidential Services Unit A number of amendments to the Government and Administration Organisation Act come into force . These strengthen the Federal Council as a collegial body and give the Federal Chancellery more authority and tasks . For example , the Federal Chancellor may now make proposals to the Federal Council on all items of business , and the Federal Chancellery now heads the and plays a role in crisis recognition and management . sentence2: L ' histoire de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale existe depuis 1803 . Ella a donc 45 ans de plus que l ' \u00c9tat f\u00e9d\u00e9ral moderne , qui a \u00e9t\u00e9 cr\u00e9\u00e9 en 1848 . \u00c0 ce jour , 15 hommes et 2 femmes ont \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e0 la t\u00eate de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale est la plus ancienne institution administrative de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Elle doit son statut d ' organe f\u00e9d\u00e9ral permanent \u00e0 Napol\u00e9on Bonaparte . L\u2019Acte de M\u00e9diation , que ce dernier a dict\u00e9 \u00e0 la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration en 1803 , fait \u00e9tat \u00e0 la fois d\u2019un chancelier et d\u2019un greffier . Jusqu\u2019\u00e0 la fondation de l\u2019\u00c9tat f\u00e9d\u00e9ral en 1848 , le chancelier et le greffier \u00e9taient \u00e0 peu pr\u00e8s les seules personnes au service permanent de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . \u00c9tat - major du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Avec la fondation de l\u2019\u00c9tat f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , la Chancellerie perdit d\u2019abord de son importance . Elle devint un service administratif du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et du Parlement , charg\u00e9 de r\u00e9diger les proc\u00e8s - verbaux de leurs s\u00e9ances . Elle publiait en outre les textes de loi et la Feuille f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , organisait des votations populaires et g\u00e9rait les Archives f\u00e9d\u00e9rales , avant qu\u2019elles soient s\u00e9par\u00e9es d\u2019elle en 1919 . Avec les r\u00e9formes administratives introduites dans les ann\u00e9es 1960 , la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale s\u2019est transform\u00e9e en service d\u2019\u00e9tat - major du gouvernement suisse . Depuis lors , le chancelier est le chef de l\u2019\u00e9tat - major du gouvernement . Il a le droit de faire des propositions au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Si ce droit \u00e9tait d\u2019abord limit\u00e9 aux affaires relevant de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , depuis 2014 il porte sur l\u2019ensemble des dossiers . En outre , le chancelier d\u00e9fend les dossiers de la Chancellerie devant le Parlement . L\u2019histoire de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale en bref 1803 L\u2019Acte de M\u00e9diation du 19 f\u00e9vrier 1803 fait \u00e9tat \u00e0 la fois d\u2019un chancelier et d\u2019un greffier . Leur salaire et leur h\u00e9bergement sont \u00e0 la charge du canton directeur . Comme la pr\u00e9sidence de la Di\u00e8te change \u00e0 la fin de chaque ann\u00e9e , la chancellerie doit se d\u00e9placer avec tout son \u00e9quipement et tous ses dossiers . Le 5 juillet , la Di\u00e8te nomme le premier chancelier f\u00e9d\u00e9ral en la personne de Jean Marc Samuel Isaac Mousson . 1848 L\u2019article 93 de la Constitution f\u00e9d\u00e9rale du 12 septembre d\u00e9finit la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et la fonction de chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Le 16 novembre , l\u2019Assembl\u00e9e f\u00e9d\u00e9rale \u00e9lit Johann Ulrich Schiess au poste de premier chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale r\u00e9sident \u00e0 l\u2019Erlacherhof \u00e0 Berne , qui abrite \u00e9galement les appartements du chancelier et du vice - chancelier . 1849 Une ordonnance dispose qu\u2019une Feuille f\u00e9d\u00e9rale para\u00eetra chaque semaine en allemand et en fran\u00e7ais . Toutes les communications officielles importantes devront y \u00eatre ins\u00e9r\u00e9es . 1850 Les t\u00e2ches de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sont d\u00e9finies par le \u00ab R\u00e8glement de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale suisse \u00bb , qui \u00e9num\u00e8re les fonctions suivantes : chancelier , vice - chancelier , archiviste , responsable de l\u2019enregistrement , 2 secr\u00e9taires de chancellerie , 3 traducteurs , 5 copistes . La dur\u00e9e quotidienne du travail ( du lundi au samedi ) s\u2019\u00e9tend de 8 h 00 \u00e0 12 h 00 et de 14 h 00 \u00e0 18 h 00 . Le r\u00e8glement pr\u00e9cise en outre que tous les employ\u00e9s doivent \u00e9galement \u00ab se pr\u00e9senter \u00e0 la chancellerie le dimanche matin apr\u00e8s la fin de l\u2019office divin , \u00e0 moins qu\u2019ils ne b\u00e9n\u00e9ficient d\u2019un cong\u00e9 particulier accord\u00e9 par le chancelier \u00bb . 1857 Le parlement et l\u2019administration emm\u00e9nagent dans un b\u00e2timent sp\u00e9cialement construit \u00e0 cet effet , l\u2019H\u00f4tel du gouvernement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , l\u2019actuelle aile ouest du Palais f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Les deux appartements du chancelier et du vice - chancelier y sont \u00e9galement install\u00e9s . 1866 14 . 01 . 1866 : 9 objets soumis au vote , dont 8 sont rejet\u00e9s par les \u00e9lecteurs . La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale organise la premi\u00e8re votation populaire f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . ( ) 1885 La Chancellerie fait la demande d\u2019une machine \u00e0 \u00e9crire . Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral donne son accord . Le succ\u00e8s est tel qu\u2019une deuxi\u00e8me machine est acquise la m\u00eame ann\u00e9e encore . 1914 Avec la loi f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sur l\u2019organisation de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , la premi\u00e8re loi globale d\u2019organisation administrative entre en vigueur . Depuis 1848 , le nombre d\u2019employ\u00e9s de l\u2019administration centrale ( \u00e0 l\u2019exclusion des douanes , des PTT , des CFF et des autres r\u00e9gies ) est pass\u00e9 de 80 \u00e0 pr\u00e8s de 3000 . 1918 Des extraits de la Feuille f\u00e9d\u00e9rale paraissent pour la premi\u00e8re fois comme publication ind\u00e9pendante en italien . 1934 George Bovet est le premier chancelier romand \u00e9lu par l\u2019Assembl\u00e9e f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . 1966 La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale entreprend de r\u00e9aliser le Recueil syst\u00e9matique ( RS ) sous forme de classeurs \u00e0 feuilles amovibles . 1968 La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale est promue au rang de service d\u2019\u00e9tat - major et directement subordonn\u00e9e au coll\u00e8ge gouvernemental . En assumant des t\u00e2ches de coordination , de pr\u00e9paration et de conseil , elle devient ainsi l\u2019instrument de direction du gouvernement . Le chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration est le chef de l\u2019\u00e9tat - major du gouvernement . Il est notamment charg\u00e9 de mener la proc\u00e9dure de co - rapport . Et , pour les affaires relevant de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , il se voit accorder le droit de faire des propositions au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Il peut en outre d\u00e9fendre seul ces dossiers devant les Chambres f\u00e9d\u00e9rales . 1972 Du point de vue fonctionnel , les Services du Parlement sont d\u00e9finitivement s\u00e9par\u00e9s de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , m\u00eame s\u2019ils continuent de lui \u00eatre subordonn\u00e9s administrativement . 1978 La loi f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sur les droits politiques entre en vigueur . Elle r\u00e8gle l\u2019ensemble des droits politiques ( droit de vote , votations populaires , r\u00e9f\u00e9rendums , initiatives populaires , \u00e9lection du Conseil national ainsi que proc\u00e9dures de recours ) . 1991 Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral nomme la premi\u00e8re vice - chanceli\u00e8re en la personne de Hanna Muralt M\u00fcller . 1998 Au cours des ann\u00e9es 90 , la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale passe \u00e0 la gestion \u00e9lectronique des donn\u00e9es , ce qui apporte au public des avantages en termes de rapidit\u00e9 d\u2019acc\u00e8s aux textes de loi sur CD - ROM ou sur Internet . Depuis 1998 , il est possible de consulter sur Internet le Recueil syst\u00e9matique ( RS ) et le Recueil officiel ( RO ) et , depuis 1999 , aussi la Feuille f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . 1999 L\u2019Assembl\u00e9e f\u00e9d\u00e9rale \u00e9lit la premi\u00e8re chanceli\u00e8re de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , Annemarie Huber - Hotz . 2000 La nouvelle Constitution consacre d\u00e9finitivement la s\u00e9paration de fait de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et des Services du Parlement . La loi sur l\u2019organisation du gouvernement et de l\u2019administration pr\u00e9voit dor\u00e9navant la fonction de porte - parole du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral nomme le vice - chancelier Achille Casanova \u00e0 ce poste . 2004 Le 26 septembre , le vote \u00e9lectronique fait l\u2019objet d\u2019un premier essai - r\u00e9ussi - dans quatre communes genevoises \u00e0 l\u2019occasion d\u2019un scrutin f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . 2023 Le 13 d\u00e9cembre , l\u2019Assembl\u00e9e f\u00e9d\u00e9rale \u00e9lit , en la personne de Viktor Rossi , le 17e chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration ( le 15e depuis la cr\u00e9ation de l\u2019\u00c9tat f\u00e9d\u00e9ral ) . Pour en savoir plus Liens utiles Documents \u00c0 l\u2019occasion du bicentenaire de la Chancellerie de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration suisse , Annemarie Huber - Hotz , chanceli\u00e8re de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration ( PDF , 103 kB , 05 . 05 . 2006 )

sentence1: Working at the Federal Chancellery The Federal Chancellery \u2013 the Federal Council\u2019s staff office Working for the Swiss government \u2013 at the heart of Swiss politics The core task of the Federal Chancellery is to support the government in its work . As the Federal Council\u2019s staff office , we assist and advise the president and members of the Federal Council , and carry out organisational and communication tasks . The Chancellery also publishes the Federal Council\u2019s decrees , and drafts the explanatory pamphlets that are sent out along with other voting documents for popular votes and referendums . We are also committed to defending the rights of the people . We work with the cantons to organise federal votes and elections and thereby work directly on behalf of the people of Switzerland . Film FCh 2 , 500 items of business per year \u2013 We support the government in the preparation , carrying out and the follow - up of Federal Council meetings . Continuity for the presidency \u2013 We support the president and his or her department in representing Switzerland\u2019s interests at the highest level of government . Looking to the future \u2013 We track national and international trends to see where political action is needed . Meticulously multilingual \u2013 We ensure that legislative texts are identical and intelligible in each language . Information across all channels \u2013 We coordinate the government\u2019s communications and ensure that information is presented to the public in a transparent way . Online over print \u2013 We publish all legislative texts online in the Federal Gazette and in the Official Compilation of Federal Legislation . Contact point for people\u2019s rights \u2013 We organise all federal popular votes and National Council elections , serve as the point of contact for initiative and referendum committees , and verify whether popular requests meet the necessary criteria . Digital Federal Administration \u2013 We support and coordinate the digital transformation process in the Federal Administration . In addition to exciting and varied work , the Chancellery also offers attractive working conditions , a transparent pay scale and good opportunities for continuing education and training . Working at the Swiss Government Many of the Chancellery\u2019s staff work in the West Wing of the Federal Palace in Bern . We also have further offices in the centre of Bern ( Gurtengasse , Feldeggweg and Monbijoustrasse ) , as well as in Bellinzona . Links www . stelle . admin . ch Specialist staff

sentence1: Light commercial vehicles Scope of application In accordance with the CO2 Act , carbon emission regulations for light commercial vehicles ( LCVs ) apply to all vans and light articulated vehicles that are registered in Switzerland for the first time . LCVs are classed as vehicles of vehicle type 30 or 38 with a maximum gross vehicle weight of 3 . 5 tonnes . The regulations also apply to vehicles with an emission - free drive system and a gross weight of between 3 . 5 and 4 . 25 tonnes which , apart from their weight , meet the definition of a van and whose weight in excess of 3 . 5 tonnes is caused solely by the additional weight of the emission - free drive . Vehicles that were previously registered in Switzerland are not subject to these provisions . Vehicles that were already registered abroad prior to their first registration in Switzerland fall within the scope of the carbon emission regulations if at the time of the customs declaration in Switzerland no more than twelve months have passed since the vehicle was first registered abroad . Vehicles which are declared to customs in Switzerland less than six months after their first registration abroad are always subject to the carbon emission regulations . Vehicles which are declared to customs between six and twelve months after their first registration abroad are divided into two categories depending on the total kilometres travelled at the time of customs clearance . These vehicles are subject to the regulations if the distance travelled is less than 5 , 000km at the time of customs declaration ( or , if not recorded at the time of customs declaration , at the time of initial registration in Switzerland ) . If the distance travelled is more than 5 , 000km at the time of customs declaration or if more than twelve months have elapsed between initial registration abroad and customs declaration in Switzerland , the vehicle is considered a second - hand vehicle and is not subject to the carbon emission regulations ( Art . 17d paras 3 and 4 CO2 Ordinance ) . Also exempt are LCVs with an unladen weight of more than 2 , 585kg measured in accordance with the measurement procedure for heavy vehicles in Regulation ( EC ) No 595 / 2009 , provided they are not exclusively electrically powered . Targets Importers are required to meet a specific carbon emission target for their new vehicle fleet ( in the case of small or private importers , the target applies to each individual vehicle ) . This target is usually calculated on the basis of the average target value , taking into account the unladen weight of the vehicle ( see FAQs ) . If the carbon emissions per kilometre exceed this target , a penalty is levied per excess gram and vehicle . Vehicle assignments An importer may agree with a large importer that the latter will take over vehicles from them ( called ' assignment ' under Art . 22a para . 1 CO2 Ordinance ) . The assignment must be reported to the SFOE before the vehicle is placed on the market for the first time in Switzerland ( Art . 22a para . 2 CO2 Ordinance ) . A vehicle can only be assigned to another importer once , and it is not possible to revoke the assignment ( Art . 22a para . 3 CO2 Ordinance ) . DETEC eGovernment portal In principle , assignments must be reported to the SFOE via the . In a few exceptional cases , assignments must be reported to the SFOE using a form ( see assignment process ) . Assignment procedures Further information on the assignments : Procedure for small importers FEDRO KDI portal DETEC eGovernment portal assignment procedures In a first step , the vehicle data should be entered in the FEDRO KDI portal under ' Vehicle import ' . Small importers must then apply for an attestation for their vehicle on the DETEC eGovernment portal , provided that the vehicle falls within the scope of the carbon emission regulations . Alternatively , small importers can also assign their vehicle to a large importer ( see the vehicle for more information ) . They must pay any penalty due before the vehicle is initally registered in Switzerland . Documents Enforcement results In 2017 the Federal Administrative Court decided that the public interest in results regarding the enforcement of regulations on CO2 emissions for vehicles outweighed data protection considerations ( Decision A - 6755 / 2016 of 23 October 2017 ) . Based on this decision the Federal Office of Energy publishes an annual overview of enforcement results .
