sentence1: Cloud The Federal Administration runs its applications in its own data centres , in private clouds and in public clouds drawing on several providers . It is the responsibility of the departments to select the right solution for each application . The DTI Sector provides legal clarifications , a tiered model and cloud principles centrally so that the administration can make decisions based on common principles . Cloud Strategy Bund Cloud Strategy Bund The framework for the use of cloud solutions in the Federal Administration is defined in the \u2018\u2019 ( available in german ) . The government is pursuing a hybrid multi - cloud strategy and is therefore continuing to rely primarily on its own data centres and services from federally owned private clouds . These are complemented by public cloud services ( hence hybrid ) , which are obtained from a number of public cloud providers ( hence multi ) . The federal government ' s \u2018Public Clouds Bund\u2019 project provides its administrative units with the possibility of obtaining public cloud services if required . The decision as to whether an application runs in a private or public cloud rests with the departments . However , the DTI Sector does provide recommendations and tools ( see below ) . The use of cloud services supports the digital transformation process in the Federal Administration . Cloud services enable the flexible use of the latest technologies . Capacity can be adjusted promptly to take account of fluctuating demand . The combination of private and public clouds allows optimal coverage of administration requirements ( e . g . in the area of IT security and data protection , resilience and innovative strength ) . Legal considerations Public Clouds Bund Information security and data protection play a central role in all Federal Administration applications . In the case of public cloud services , the administration must exercise additional care , as these run outside its own data centres . Considerations include , among other things , an examination of the legal requirements , the need for protection and the risks . Based on this , the administrative unit concerned must decide which cloud service to use to run a particular application and what precautionary measures to take . The Federal Administration can draw on established tools such as a protection requirement analysis and an information protection and data security concept . In addition , a report on the legal basis and the federal government ' s cloud principles are available as aids in choosing the appropriate cloud level . They are a central element of governance pertaining to \u2018\u2019 . The report on the legal basis provides an analysis of the legal basis for the use of cloud solutions with a focus on data protection and information protection law and professional secrecy . It also contains tools such as checklists to help administrative units with the clarifications they are obliged to make before using cloud services . Cloud Tier Model The following graphic shows the different cloud tiers that are available in the Federal Administration . The two upper tiers ( I and II ) are public clouds , tiers III and IV are private clouds in Federal Administration data centres . The various tiers differ not only in their functionalities , but also in the data held in them . Generally speaking , the higher the tier number , the higher the data protection level . So according to the tier model , particularly sensitive data is not stored in tier I as a matter of principle . The tiers are not entirely distinct . For example , a specialised application could run as a hybrid cloud spread over several tiers , to keep sensitive personal data in the private cloud and at the same time use cloud services in the public cloud for non - critical data . sentence2: Informatique en nuage Pour ses applications , l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale utilise ses propres centres de donn\u00e9es , des nuages priv\u00e9s et les nuages publics de plusieurs fournisseurs . Chaque d\u00e9partement doit choisir la solution qui convient le mieux \u00e0 chacune de ses applications . Afin que l\u2019administration puisse prendre des d\u00e9cisions selon les m\u00eames r\u00e8gles , le secteur TNI met \u00e0 la disposition de tous des clarifications juridiques , une classification et des principes relatifs \u00e0 l\u2019informatique en nuage . Strat\u00e9gie d\u2019informatique en nuage de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration strat\u00e9gie d\u2019informatique en nuage de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration La d\u00e9finit un cadre pour l\u2019utilisation de nuages informatiques dans l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . L\u2019administration mise sur une strat\u00e9gie de nuage hybride multi - cloud et donc principalement sur ses propres centres de donn\u00e9es et sur les nuages priv\u00e9s de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Cette offre est compl\u00e9t\u00e9e par les nuages publics ( d\u2019o\u00f9 le terme hybride ) de plusieurs fournisseurs ( d\u2019o\u00f9 le terme multi ) . La Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration a lanc\u00e9 le projet \u00ab Public Clouds Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration \u00bb pour permettre \u00e0 son administration d\u2019acheter des services issus de nuages publics en cas de besoin . Mais la d\u00e9cision d\u2019utiliser une application dans un nuage public ou priv\u00e9 appartient toujours aux d\u00e9partements . Le secteur TNI se contente de fournir des recommandations et des outils ( voir ci - dessous ) . L\u2019utilisation de l\u2019informatique en nuage contribue \u00e0 la transformation num\u00e9rique de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , car elle permet un meilleur usage des derni\u00e8res technologies . Elle permet aussi d\u2019adapter rapidement les capacit\u00e9s requises en cas de variation des besoins . La combinaison de nuages publics et priv\u00e9s couvre particuli\u00e8rement bien l\u2019ensemble des exigences de l\u2019administration , notamment pour ce qui est de la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 de l\u2019information , de la protection des donn\u00e9es , de la r\u00e9silience et de l\u2019innovation . Aspects juridiques Public Clouds Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration S\u00e9curit\u00e9 de l\u2019information et protection des donn\u00e9es jouent un r\u00f4le crucial dans toutes les applications de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Lorsque l\u2019administration travaille dans des nuages publics , elle doit \u00eatre particuli\u00e8rement attentive \u00e0 cet aspect , \u00e9tant donn\u00e9 que les services ne fonctionnent pas dans ses propres centres de donn\u00e9es . Elle doit notamment faire attention au cadre r\u00e9glementaire , au besoin de protection et aux risques encourus . Apr\u00e8s analyse de ces aspects , l\u2019unit\u00e9 administrative concern\u00e9e choisit l\u2019offre de nuage qu\u2019elle veut utiliser pour son application et d\u00e9finit les mesures \u00e0 prendre . Dans ce contexte , l\u2019administration peut recourir \u00e0 des outils \u00e9prouv\u00e9s tels que l\u2019analyse du besoin de protection et les plans de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 des donn\u00e9es et de protection de l\u2019information . Parmi les autres outils disponibles pour choisir un nuage du bon niveau , il y a aussi le rapport sur les bases juridiques et les principes de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration sur le sujet . Ces principes sont un \u00e9l\u00e9ment essentiel de la gouvernance relative au projet \u00ab \u00bb . Le rapport sur les bases juridiques analyse les bases sur lesquelles repose l\u2019utilisation des nuages informatiques principalement du point de vue de la protection des donn\u00e9es , de la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 de l\u2019information et du secret de fonction . Il contient aussi des outils tels que des listes de contr\u00f4le visant \u00e0 aider les unit\u00e9s administratives \u00e0 \u00e9valuer les conditions qu\u2019elles doivent respecter pour pouvoir utiliser de tels nuages . Niveaux de l\u2019informatique en nuage Le sch\u00e9ma ci - apr\u00e8s montre les diff\u00e9rents niveaux de l\u2019informatique en nuage propos\u00e9s dans l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Les niveaux I et II correspondent aux nuages publics et les niveaux III et IV aux nuages priv\u00e9s g\u00e9r\u00e9s dans les centres de donn\u00e9es de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Les diff\u00e9rents niveaux se distinguent non seulement par leurs fonctionnalit\u00e9s , mais aussi par le type de donn\u00e9es qu\u2019ils contiennent . En g\u00e9n\u00e9ral , plus le niveau est \u00e9lev\u00e9 , plus le besoin de protection des donn\u00e9es est important . Selon le mod\u00e8le propos\u00e9 , les donn\u00e9es particuli\u00e8rement sensibles ne sont ainsi en principe pas stock\u00e9es au niveau I . La limite entre les diff\u00e9rents niveaux n\u2019est cependant pas strictement d\u00e9finie . Il se peut par exemple qu\u2019une application fonctionne en mode hybride sur des nuages de diff\u00e9rents niveaux , avec des donn\u00e9es sensibles stock\u00e9es dans un nuage priv\u00e9 et des services qui utilisent des donn\u00e9es non critiques propos\u00e9s dans un nuage public . Swiss Government Cloud Swiss Government Cloud ( SGC ) De 2025 \u00e0 2032 , l\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l\u2019informatique et de la t\u00e9l\u00e9communication ( OFIT ) mettra en place le , une infrastructure en nuage capable de r\u00e9pondre aux exigences et aux besoins de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Ainsi que le pr\u00e9voit la strat\u00e9gie d\u2019informatique en nuage de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , cette infrastructure comprendra un nuage priv\u00e9 d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 en interne et un nuage public mis \u00e0 disposition par des fournisseurs externes . Le SGC couvrira les niveaux I \u00e0 III du mod\u00e8le d\u2019informatique en nuage . sentence1: The energy label for range hoods This label provides information about the energy efficiency of the declared appliances . When we buy a new small air conditioner , it is not only the purchase price that counts , but also the associated long - term electricity costs . With this label it is possible to identify the most energy - efficient models at a glance . In addition to the values for the energy efficiency category ( A - G ) and the annual energy consumption , which are simple to note , further data on luminous efficacy and sound power level , among others , simplify the choice of the most suitable appliance . sentence1: Elegant setting for state guests and formal events The Von Wattenwyl House , the Bellevue Palace Hotel and the Lohn country residence are three elegant and dignified settings in which the Federal Council can receive guests of state and hold formal events . All three properties were donated to the state . Lohn country residence Built in 1782 - 83 , the Lohn is situated in the village of Kehrsatz south - east of Bern . The last private owner was Helene Welti - Kammerer , the daughter - in - law of former federal councillor Emil Welti . In 1942 she bequeathed the property to the Confederation , expressing the wish that the federal councillors should be able to spend holidays at the house , with its beautiful view over the expansive Aare valley . However , the Federal Council does not use the villa as a holiday home , but primarily to house its guests . Numerous heads of state , including Queen Elizabeth II , have been received there . Since 1994 guests now stay at another federal property , the Bellevue Palace Hotel , rather than at the Lohn . Beatrice von Wattenwyl House Situated in the historic centre of Bern , the Beatrice von Wattenwyl House has its origins as far back as 1446 . In 1934 Emanuel von Wattenwyl bequeathed this patrician\u2019s residence to the Swiss Confederation on behalf of his wife Beatrice , who had died five years previously . The Federal Council receives guests , signs agreements and holds discussions in the house . It is known for the \u201cVon Wattenwyl talks\u201d , which take place between the Federal Council and the heads of the various political parties before the start of each parliamentary session . Bellevue Palace Hotel For many years , the Parliament Building was flanked to the east and west by elegant hotels , the Bernerhof and the Bellevue Palace . Following the foundation of the federal state , canny hoteliers realized that rooms would be needed in Bern to house members of parliament and visiting guests of state . Having fallen into decline after the First World War , the Bernerhof was sold to the Confederation in 1924 and now houses the Federal Department of Finance . The Bellevue , on the other hand , still operates in its original function . In 1976 the Swiss National Bank acquired a majority stake in the hotel . In 1994 it donated its shares to the Confederation , which renovated and modernised the building . The hotel is leased and run by a private company , which also has other renowned Swiss hotels in its portfolio . Hotel Bellevue Palace Von Wattenwyl House : Virtual Tour Access The Lohn and Von Wattenwyl House can only be used by members of the Federal Council and by the Federal Chancellor . They are open to the public four times a year , including on Museums Night in Bern . Several federal agencies are responsible for running the two properties : The Bellevue Palace Hotel is , of course , open all year round , and welcomes over 40 , 000 overnight guests each year . Several hundred thousand meals are served in its restaurants . Last modification 03 . 05 . 2018
sentence2: Un cadre \u00e9l\u00e9gant pour accueillir les chefs d\u2019\u00c9tat et pour les r\u00e9ceptions officielles Am\u00e9nag\u00e9s avec go\u00fbt , le domaine du Lohn , la Maison de Watteville et l\u2018h\u00f4tel Bellevue Palace permettent au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de recevoir dignement ses h\u00f4tes dans un cadre id\u00e9al pour les manifestations officielles . Les trois r\u00e9sidences ont \u00e9t\u00e9 offertes \u00e0 la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Domaine du Lohn Construit en 1782 / 83 , le manoir du Lohn se trouve \u00e0 Kehrsatz , commune situ\u00e9e au sud - est de Berne . Sa derni\u00e8re propri\u00e9taire priv\u00e9e fut Helene Welti - Kammerer , belle - fille de l\u2019ancien conseiller f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Emil Welti ( en fonction de 1866 \u00e0 1891 ) . Elle l\u00e9gua la propri\u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e0 la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration en 1942 en souhaitant qu\u2019elle serve de lieu de vill\u00e9giature aux conseillers f\u00e9d\u00e9raux pour qu\u2019ils profitent de la vue splendide sur la vall\u00e9e de l\u2019Aar . Si le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral ne passe pas ses vacances au manoir , il y accueille ses h\u00f4tes . De nombreux chefs d\u2019\u00e9tat y ont r\u00e9sid\u00e9 , dont la reine Elisabeth II d\u2019Angleterre . Depuis 1994 cependant , les h\u00f4tes ne sont plus log\u00e9s au Lohn , ils s\u00e9journent \u00e0 l\u2019h\u00f4tel Bellevue Palace , qui appartient \u00e9galement \u00e0 la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . La Maison B\u00e9atrice de Watteville \u00c9rig\u00e9e en 1446 , la Maison B\u00e9atrice de Wattewille se trouve dans la vieille ville de Berne . En 1934 , Emanuel de Wattewille a l\u00e9gu\u00e9 la maison patricienne \u00e0 la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration suisse au nom de son \u00e9pouse B\u00e9atrice disparue en 1929 . Aujourd\u2019hui , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral y re\u00e7oit ses h\u00f4tes . La demeure sert aussi de cadre \u00e0 la signature d\u2019accords et \u00e0 des entretiens politiques . C\u2019est l\u00e0 que se d\u00e9roulent , avant chaque session parlementaire , les fameux \u00ab entretiens de la Maison de Watteville \u00bb du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral avec les chefs des partis gouvernementaux . L\u2019h\u00f4tel Bellevue Palace Pendant longtemps , le Palais f\u00e9d\u00e9ral \u00e9tait entour\u00e9 , \u00e0 l\u2019est et l\u2019ouest , d\u2019h\u00f4tels chics : le Bernerhof et le Bellevue Palace . Apr\u00e8s la fondation de l\u2019\u00e9tat f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , des h\u00f4teliers qui avaient le sens des affaires ont anticip\u00e9 les besoins des d\u00e9put\u00e9s et des h\u00f4tes officiels . Suite au d\u00e9clin \u00e9conomique caus\u00e9 par la guerre , la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration a achet\u00e9 , en 1924 , le Bernerhof et en a fait le si\u00e8ge du D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral des finances . Le Bellevue est quant \u00e0 lui rest\u00e9 un h\u00f4tel jusqu\u2019\u00e0 aujourd\u2019hui . En 1976 , la Banque nationale suisse a acquis la majorit\u00e9 des actions de l\u2019\u00e9tablissement . En 1994 , elle les a offertes \u00e0 la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , qui a alors r\u00e9nov\u00e9 l\u2019h\u00f4tel . Un bail a \u00e9t\u00e9 sign\u00e9 avec une soci\u00e9t\u00e9 priv\u00e9e qui en assure l\u2019exploitation , soci\u00e9t\u00e9 qui d\u00e9tient dans son portefeuille d\u2019autres h\u00f4tels suisses renomm\u00e9s . Visite virtuelle de la Maison de Watteville Acc\u00e8s aux r\u00e9sidences Le domaine du Lohn et la Maison de Watteville sont r\u00e9serv\u00e9s au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et au chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . L\u2019acc\u00e8s est public quatre fois par an , notamment durant la Nuit des mus\u00e9es de Berne . Visites Du point de vue administratif , les t\u00e2ches ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9parties de la mani\u00e8re suivante : L\u2018h\u00f4tel Bellevue Palace est bien entendu ouvert toute l\u2019ann\u00e9e . Chaque ann\u00e9e , plus de 40 000 personnes y s\u00e9journent ; plusieurs centaines de milliers d\u2018h\u00f4tes y fr\u00e9quentent un restaurant . Derni\u00e8re modification 24 . 03 . 2022

sentence1: Penalty calculation for heavy - duty vehicles Penalty calculation for heavy - duty vehicles Under the CO2 Act , CO2 targets apply to heavy - duty vehicles ( HDVs ) as of 1 January 2025 . These are defined as a percentage reduction against the reference values of the relevant EU regulation . Vehicle importers are given an individual target each year based on the target value and the properties of their registered vehicles . If the new vehicle fleet or an importer ' s vehicle does not meet the target , a penalty is payable for each vehicle based on the amount by which the target is exceeded . Individual targets The method for calculating the target for HDVs is based on EU provisions which categorise vehicles into nine subgroups according to their technical characteristics or intended use . The reference values for calculating targets in grams of CO2 per tonne - kilometre are defined industry - wide for each subgroup . The target for fleets of new vehicles is calculated on this basis as a single figure for each im - porter using the sub - group ' s share of its own fleet of new vehicles in the respective year and fixed mileage and payload weighting factors in accord - ance with Regulation ( EU ) 2019 / 1242 . Reference values per sub - group The reference values for calculating individual targets are those set out in the table published in Implementing Decision ( EU ) 2021 / 781 . Heavy - duty vehicle CO2 emissions The CO2 emissions of a heavy - duty vehicle are determined using the VEC - TO simulation tool . The emission value relevant for penalties is calculated taking into account the mileage and payload weighting factor and the syn - thetic fuels that count . For new vehicle fleets with several vehicles , the aver - age of the CO2 emissions is used ; additionally , relief applies if the new vehicle fleet exceeds the threshold values for electric vehicles under Article 26c of the CO2 Ordinance . Calculating penalties If the average CO2 emissions of a large - scale importer ' s newly registered HDV fleet ( at least six new registrations per year ) exceed the individually specified target , a penalty must be paid based on the extent of the excess and the number of vehicles . Vehicle assignments HDV importers must pay any CO2 penalty after the end of the respective reference year . A penalty is due for vehicles that exceed the CO2 emissions target . If a vehicle ' s emissions are below the specified target , no penalty applies . However , no bonus is paid out in this case either . Importers have the option of assigning their vehicles to a large - scale importer . This may reduce the penalty for a high - emission vehicle or a bonus may be paid out for an efficient vehicle . The assigning importer and the large - scale importer draw up an agreement under private law to this effect . Assignments must be reported to the SFOE on the DETEC eGovernment portal before the vehicle is first registered in Switzerland . Documents Links DETEC eGovernment portal Specialist staff Last modification 28 . 11 . 2024
sentence2: Calcul de la sanction pour les v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds Calcul de la sanction pour les v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds Conform\u00e9ment \u00e0 la loi sur le CO2 , des valeurs cibles de CO2 s\u2019appliqueront aux v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds \u00e0 partir du 1er janvier 2025 . Celles - ci sont d\u00e9finies sous la forme d\u2019une r\u00e9duction en pour - cent par rapport aux valeurs de base indiqu\u00e9es dans la r\u00e9glementation de l\u2019UE . Chaque ann\u00e9e , les importateurs de v\u00e9hicules se voient attribuer une valeur cible sp\u00e9cifique qui d\u00e9coule de la valeur cible vis\u00e9e dans la loi sur le CO2 et des caract\u00e9ristiques de leurs v\u00e9hicules admis \u00e0 la circulation . Lorsque la flotte de v\u00e9hicules neufs ou le v\u00e9hicule d\u2019un importateur ne respecte pas la valeur cible sp\u00e9cifique , une sanction d\u00e9pendant du d\u00e9passement est due pour chaque v\u00e9hicule . Valeur cible sp\u00e9cifique La formule de calcul de la valeur cible pour les v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds est conforme aux dispositions de l\u2019UE , qui r\u00e9partit les v\u00e9hicules en neuf sous - groupes en fonction de leurs caract\u00e9ristiques techniques ou de leur utilisation . Les valeurs de base pour calculer la valeur cible en grammes de CO2 par tonne - kilom\u00e8tre sont d\u00e9finies par branche et par sous - groupe . La valeur cible des flottes de v\u00e9hicules neufs est calcul\u00e9e sur cette base en tant que chiffre individuel pour chaque importateur , en tenant compte de la part des sous - groupes dans sa propre flotte de v\u00e9hicules neufs pour l\u2019ann\u00e9e concern\u00e9e et des facteurs de pond\u00e9ration fixes pour le kilom\u00e9trage et la charge utile qui figurent dans le r\u00e8glement ( UE ) 2019 / 1242 . Valeurs de base de chaque sous - groupe Les valeurs de base pour calculer la valeur cible sp\u00e9cifique sont celles indiqu\u00e9es dans la r\u00e9glementation de l\u2019UE , publi\u00e9e dans la d\u00e9cision d\u2019ex\u00e9cution ( UE ) 2021 / 781 . \u00c9missions de CO2 des v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds Les \u00e9missions de CO2 d\u2019un v\u00e9hicule utilitaire lourd sont obtenues au moyen de la proc\u00e9dure de simulation \u00abVECTO\u00bb . La valeur d\u2019\u00e9mission pertinente pour la sanction est calcul\u00e9e en tenant compte du facteur de pond\u00e9ration pour le kilom\u00e9trage et la charge utile et des carburants synth\u00e9tiques imputables . Pour les parcs de v\u00e9hicules neufs comptant plusieurs v\u00e9hicules , c\u2019est la moyenne des \u00e9missions de CO2 qui s\u2019applique . De plus , un all\u00e8gement est accord\u00e9 ici si le parc de v\u00e9hicules neufs d\u00e9passe les valeurs seuils fix\u00e9es pour les v\u00e9hicules \u00e9lectriques selon l\u2019article 26c . Calcul de la sanction Si les \u00e9missions moyennes de CO2 du parc de v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds nouvellement immatricul\u00e9s d\u2019un grand importateur ( au moins deux immatriculations par an ) exc\u00e8dent sa valeur cible sp\u00e9cifique , celui - ci doit s\u2019acquitter d\u2019une sanction en fonction du d\u00e9passement et du nombre de v\u00e9hicules . Cession de v\u00e9hicules Les importateurs de v\u00e9hicules utilitaires lourds doivent s\u2019acquitter d\u2019une \u00e9ventuelle sanction en mati\u00e8re de CO2 apr\u00e8s la fin de l\u2019ann\u00e9e de r\u00e9f\u00e9rence concern\u00e9e . Une sanction est applicable pour les v\u00e9hicules qui exc\u00e8dent la valeur cible fix\u00e9e en mati\u00e8re d\u2019\u00e9missions de CO2 . Si un v\u00e9hicule n\u2019atteint pas la valeur cible , aucune sanction n\u2019est appliqu\u00e9e . Dans ce cas , il n\u2019y a pas non plus de versement d\u2019un bonus . Les importateurs ont la possibilit\u00e9 de c\u00e9der leurs v\u00e9hicules \u00e0 un grand importateur . Il peut ainsi arriver que la sanction pour un v\u00e9hicule \u00e0 fortes \u00e9missions soit r\u00e9duite ou qu\u2019un bonus soit vers\u00e9 pour un v\u00e9hicule \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiquement efficace . Ces conditions s\u2019apparentent \u00e0 un accord de droit priv\u00e9 entre l\u2019importateur c\u00e9dant et l\u2019importateur cessionnaire . La cession doit \u00eatre annonc\u00e9e \u00e0 l\u2019OFEN avant la premi\u00e8re immatriculation en Suisse des v\u00e9hicules concern\u00e9s par le biais du portail eGovernment DETEC . Documents Liens Portail eGovernment DETEC Contact sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9 Derni\u00e8re modification 28 . 11 . 2024

sentence1: Safe , quiet and energy - efficient tyres Tyres account for around 20 percent of a vehicle ' s fuel consumption . The main factor here is rolling resistance . Lower rolling resistance reduces fuel consumption as well as CO2 emissions . The energy label is intended to help people choose the best tyres , i . e . those that save energy and are also safe and quiet . Use of the energy label for tyres has been mandatory in Switzerland since 1 August 2014 . It indicates the energy efficiency ( rolling resistance ) and classifies the degree of grip on wet roads as well as the noise level . In addition , the label contains information on the snow and ice grip of the corresponding tyre . The design of the label is regulated in Appendix 4 . 2 of the Federal Energy Efficiency Ordinance , which is harmonised with Regulation ( EC ) 2020 / 740 . sentence2: Des pneus s\u00fbrs , silencieux et \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiquement efficaces Les pneus comptent pour pr\u00e8s de 20 % de la consommation de carburant d ' un v\u00e9hicule et ce , principalement en raison de la r\u00e9sistance au roulement . Am\u00e9liorer la r\u00e9sistance au roulement r\u00e9duit la consommation de carburant et les \u00e9missions de CO2 . Le probl\u00e8me pour les automobilistes est de savoir comment se procurer des pneus s\u00fbrs , silencieux et efficaces \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiquement . L ' \u00e9tiquette pour les pneus , obligatoire en Suisse depuis le 1er ao\u00fbt 2014 , leur offre la solution . L ' \u00e9tiquette pour les pneus prend en compte trois param\u00e8tres : l ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique ( r\u00e9sistance au roulement ) , l ' adh\u00e9rence sur sol mouill\u00e9 et le bruit de roulement . Le label renseigne \u00e9galement sur l\u2019adh\u00e9rence du pneu en question sur la neige et le verglas . Elle est d\u00e9crite \u00e0 l ' annexe 4 . 2 de l ' ordonnance sur les exigences relatives \u00e0 l ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique qui s ' appuie sur le r\u00e8glement ( CE ) n\u00b0 2020 / 740 de l ' UE . Documents Liens TCS - Tests de pneus Pour acheter un appareil adapt\u00e9 \u00e0 ses besoins et l\u2019utiliser de fa\u00e7on optimale , consulter le site de SuisseEnergie Droit Ordonnance sur les exigences relatives \u00e0 l\u2019efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique ( OEEE ) , appendice 4 . 2 R\u00e8glement ( CE ) No 1222 / 2009 du 25 novembre 2009 sur l\u2019\u00e9tiquetage des pneumatiques en relation avec l\u2019efficacit\u00e9 en carburant et d\u2019autres param\u00e8tres essentiels Derni\u00e8re modification 08 . 12 . 2020

sentence1: Energy policy The Energy Article in the Federal Constitution , the Federal Energy Act , the Federal CO2 Act , the Federal Nuclear Energy Act , the Federal Electricity Supply Act and the Federal Water Use Act are the legislative instruments for securing a sustainable and modern Swiss energy policy . In addition , the energy policies of the federal government and the cantons encompass the preparation of energy perspectives , plus strategies , implementation programmes and the evaluation of energy policy measures at the municipal , cantonal and federal levels . Energy policy was only incorporated into the Federal Constitution in 1990 . Article 89 ( Energy Article ) stipulates that , within the framework of their responsibilities , the federal government and the cantons must establish the necessary prerequisites for securing an adequate , comprehensive , safe , economical and ecological energy supply , and for ensuring efficient and economical energy use . As of 1990 , all the cantons had introduced their own energy legislation and energy policy regulations . The first Federal Energy Act entered into force on 1 January 1999 . In the wake of the reactor disaster in Fukushima in 2011 , the Federal Council announced a new energy policy ( Energy Strategy 2050 ) , which included the call for a total revision of the Federal Energy Act . The revised Act entered into force on 1 January 2018 after it had been accepted by a clear majority of voters in a referendum held in 2017 . In June 2021 , the Federal Council has adopted the Federal Act on a Secure Electricity Supply with Renewable Energies . The draft act includes a revision of the Federal Energy Act and the Federal Electricity Supply Act . The aim is to strengthen the growth of domestic renewable energies and of Switzerland ' s supply security , particularly during winter . sentence2: Politique \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique L\u2019article constitutionnel sur l ' \u00e9nergie , la loi sur l ' \u00e9nergie , la loi sur le CO2 , la loi sur l ' \u00e9nergie nucl\u00e9aire , la loi sur l ' approvisionnement en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 et la loi sur les forces hydrauliques sont les volets d ' une politique \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique suisse et moderne s ' inscrivant dans la dur\u00e9e . La politique \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration et des cantons consiste non seulement \u00e0 cr\u00e9er des bases l\u00e9gales mais \u00e9galement \u00e0 \u00e9laborer des perspectives , des strat\u00e9gies , des programmes de mise en \u0153uvre et une \u00e9valuation des mesures prises aux \u00e9chelons communal , cantonal et f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Il a fallu attendre 1990 pour que la politique \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique soit ancr\u00e9e dans la Constitution f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Dans son article 89 , consacr\u00e9 \u00e0 la politique \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique , celle - ci dispose que \u00abdans les limites de leurs comp\u00e9tences respectives , la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration et les cantons s\u2019emploient \u00e0 promouvoir un approvisionnement \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique suffisant , diversifi\u00e9 , s\u00fbr , \u00e9conomiquement optimal et respectueux de l\u2019environnement , ainsi qu\u2019une consommation \u00e9conome et rationnelle de l\u2019\u00e9nergie\u00bb . Depuis 1990 , tous les cantons ont adopt\u00e9 leurs propres lois et directives en mati\u00e8re de politique \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique . La premi\u00e8re loi f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sur l\u2019\u00e9nergie est entr\u00e9e en vigueur le 1er janvier 1999 . Apr\u00e8s la catastrophe de Fukushima survenue en 2011 , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a \u00e9labor\u00e9 la Strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique 2050 , qui comprenait notamment la r\u00e9vision totale de la loi sur l\u2019\u00e9nergie . Largement accept\u00e9e par le peuple lors d\u2019une votation en 2017 , la nouvelle mouture de cette loi est entr\u00e9e en vigueur le 1er janvier 2018 . En juin 2021 , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a adopt\u00e9 la loi f\u00e9d\u00e9rale relative \u00e0 un approvisionnement en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 s\u00fbr reposant sur des \u00e9nergies renouvelables . Avec ce projet , qui comprend une r\u00e9vision de la loi sur l\u2019\u00e9nergie et de la loi sur l\u2019approvisionnement en \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 , il entend renforcer le d\u00e9veloppement des \u00e9nergies renouvelables indig\u00e8nes ainsi que la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 de l\u2019approvisionnement de la Suisse , en particulier durant l\u2019hiver . sentence1: Mutual recognition with the EEA / EFTA states and Turkey EFTA Convention , Annex I MRA Switzerland - EU Apart from the MRA with the EU , Switzerland also has an MRA with the EEA / EFTA states ( EFTA Convention , Annex I ) . The provisions are the same as those of the , with uniform arrangements between Switzerland and the entire EEA ( i . e . the EU plus Iceland , Liechtenstein and Norway ) . EFTA - Turkey free trade agreement : Annex V The mutual recognition of conformity assessments has also been extended to Turkey . The EFTA\u2013Turkey FTA was supplemented in 2009 by Protocol E , governing the mutual recognition of conformity assessments . Protocol E was subsequently replaced by Annex V as part of the modernised FTA in 2021 . The EU has a customs union with Turkey , under which Turkey undertakes to adopt the EU ' s technical regulations . At the same time , there are also contractual relationships between Switzerland and the EU under the MRA and between the EU and the EEA / EFTA states under the EEA Agreement , both of which require extensive harmonisation of the technical regulations for those sectors covered by the agreements . As a result of the harmonisation of Turkish product regulations with those of the EU ( customs union ) and the simultaneous harmonisation of Swiss product regulations with those of the EU ( MRA ) , the same product regulations now apply in Switzerland and Turkey for products that are covered by both the customs union and the MRA . This makes for simplified trading conditions . Annex V The requires Turkey and the EFTA states to mutually accept the results of conformity assessment procedures carried out by conformity assessment bodies which have been notified and accepted under the EEA Agreement , the MRA or the EU\u2013Turkey customs union . This means that for products that are exported to Turkey and for which the same regulations apply in Switzerland and Turkey , conformity assessments can be issued by the designated conformity assessment bodies in Switzerland and must then be recognised by Turkey . This further simplifies trading conditions . Annex V aims to enable Swiss businesses to export products to Turkey under conditions equivalent to those in the EU ( for products that fall under both the MRA and the EU\u2013Turkey customs union ) . . List of conformity assessment bodies List Here you will find the of notified and accepted conformity assessment bodies . Specialist staff Last modification 03 . 01 . 2024
sentence2: Reconnaissance mutuelle avec les Etats de l ' EEE / AELE et la Turquie Convention AELE , Annexe I Convention instituant l\u2019AELE , Annexe I l\u2019ARM conclu entre la Suisse et l\u2019UE Parall\u00e8lement \u00e0 l\u2019ARM avec l\u2019UE , un ARM a \u00e9galement \u00e9t\u00e9 conclu avec les Etats de l\u2019EEE / AELE ( Convention instituant l\u2019AELE , Annexe I ) . Les dispositions correspondent \u00e0 celles de , ce qui a permis de mettre en place un cadre r\u00e9glementaire uniforme pour la Suisse et tout l\u2019EEE ( c . - \u00e0 - d . l\u2019UE , l\u2019Islande , le Liechtenstein et la Norv\u00e8ge ) . Accord de libre - \u00e9change AELE - Turquie : Annexe V La reconnaissance mutuelle des \u00e9valuations de conformit\u00e9 a \u00e9galement pu \u00eatre \u00e9tendue \u00e0 la Turquie . L\u2019Accord de libre - \u00e9change entre les Etats de l\u2019AELE et la Turquie a \u00e9t\u00e9 compl\u00e9t\u00e9 en 2009 par un Protocole E r\u00e9glant la reconnaissance mutuelle des \u00e9valuations de la conformit\u00e9 . En 2021 , l ' Accord de libre - \u00e9change a \u00e9t\u00e9 modernis\u00e9 et le Protocole E a \u00e9t\u00e9 remplac\u00e9 par une Annexe V . L\u2019UE dispose d\u2019une Union douani\u00e8re avec la Turquie , \u00e0 l\u2019int\u00e9rieur de laquelle la Turquie s\u2019engage \u00e0 reprendre les prescriptions techniques de l\u2019UE . Parall\u00e8lement , il existe entre la Suisse et l\u2019UE ( par le biais de l\u2019ARM ) et entre les Etats de l\u2019EEE / AELE et l\u2019UE ( en vertu de l\u2019Accord EEE ) des relations contractuelles qui impliquent une harmonisation pouss\u00e9e des prescriptions techniques applicables aux secteurs couverts par les accords en question . Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 l\u2019harmonisation des prescriptions techniques entre la Turquie et l\u2019UE ( Union douani\u00e8re ) d\u2019un c\u00f4t\u00e9 , et entre la Suisse et l\u2019UE ( ARM ) de l\u2019autre , les produits couverts \u00e0 la fois par l\u2019Union douani\u00e8re et par l\u2019ARM sont soumis aux m\u00eames prescriptions techniques en Suisse et en Turquie , ce qui facilite les \u00e9changes commerciaux . Annexe V L\u2019 oblige la Turquie et les Etats de l\u2019AELE \u00e0 reconna\u00eetre mutuellement les \u00e9valuations de la conformit\u00e9 effectu\u00e9es par des organismes d\u2019\u00e9valuation de la conformit\u00e9 ( OEC ) notifi\u00e9s et d\u00e9sign\u00e9s dans le cadre de l\u2019Accord EEE , de l\u2019ARM ou de l\u2019Union douani\u00e8re entre l\u2019UE et la Turquie . Par cons\u00e9quent , les OEC suisses d\u00e9sign\u00e9s peuvent \u00e9tablir des \u00e9valuations de la conformit\u00e9 pour les produits export\u00e9s en Turquie qui r\u00e9pondent aux m\u00eames prescriptions techniques dans les deux pays , \u00e9valuations que la Turquie est tenue de reconna\u00eetre . Cette reconnaissance facilite \u00e9galement le commerce . L\u2019Annexe V doit permettre \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9conomie suisse de pouvoir exporter des produits vers la Turquie aux m\u00eames conditions que l\u2019UE ( pour les produits qui sont couverts aussi bien par l\u2019ARM que par l\u2019Union douani\u00e8re entre l\u2019UE et la Turquie ) . sentence2: Accompagnement l\u00e9gislatif La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale assure un accompagnement l\u00e9gislatif au sein de l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sur le double plan juridique et linguistique . Au cours de l\u2019accompagnement l\u00e9gislatif , la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale examine les actes du point de vue formel ( technique l\u00e9gislative ) et assure la qualit\u00e9 sur le plan linguistique en coop\u00e9ration avec l\u2019Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de la justice dans le cadre de la Commission interne de r\u00e9daction . sentence1: Hydropower Thanks to its topography and high levels of annual rainfall , Switzerland has ideal conditions for the utilisation of hydropower . Towards the end of the nineteenth century , hydropower underwent an initial period of expansion , and between 1945 and 1970 it experienced a genuine boom during which numerous new power plants were opened in the lowlands , together with large - scale storage plants . Based on the estimated mean production level , hydropower still accounted for almost 90 % of domestic electricity production at the beginning of the 1970s , but this figure fell to around 60 % by 1985 following the commissioning of Switzerland ' s nuclear power plants , and is now around 57 . 6 % . Hydropower therefore remains Switzerland ' s most important domestic source of renewable energy . Today ( 12 . 31 . 2023 ) there are 705 hydropower plants in Switzerland that each have a capacity of at least 300 kilowatts , and these produce an average of around 37 , 171 gigawatt hours ( GWh / y ) per annum , 48 . 6 % of which is produced in run - of - river power plants , 47 . 2 % in storage power plants and approximately 4 . 2 % in pumped storage power plants . Roughly 63 % of hydroelectricity are generated in the mountain cantons of Uri , Grisons , Ticino and Valais , while Aargau and Bern also generate significant quantities . Roughly 11 % of Switzerland ' s hydropower generation comes from facilities situated on bodies of water along the country ' s borders . The hydropower market is worth around 1 , 8 billion Swiss francs ( basis = delivery from power plant at 5 cents per kilowatt hour ) , and is therefore an important segment of Switzerland ' s energy industry . With the Energy Strategy 2050 , the federal government aims to increase the average annual production of electricity from hydropower to 39 , 200 gigawatt hours ( GWh ) by 2050 ( to 37 , 900 GWh by 2035 ) . In order to use the realisable potential , existing plants should be renovated and expanded and the construction of new hydropower plants is needed , taking ecological requirements into account . The federal government wants to promote the utilisation of hydropower with various measures . The instruments for this are investment contributions for new plants and significant renovations / expansions of hydropower plants and the market premium for plants that have to sell on the market at prices below the production costs . In addition , thanks to the so called Mantelerlass , various measures are planned , which will improve the framework conditions for hydropower ( simpler authorisation procedures , project planning contributions , target for storage expansion ) . The Swiss Federal Office of Energy deals with policy - related aspects of hydropower ( promotion , strategies , perspectives ) as well as technical and safety aspects , while the Swiss Federal Office for the Environment is responsible for environmental aspects ( residual water , protection of bodies of water ) . sentence2: Force hydraulique Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 sa topographie favorable et \u00e0 son niveau de pr\u00e9cipitations moyen important , la Suisse rassemble les conditions id\u00e9ales pour exploiter la force hydraulique . Cette source \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique , dont l ' exploitation a commenc\u00e9 \u00e0 la fin du XIXe si\u00e8cle , a connu un v\u00e9ritable \u00e2ge d ' or entre 1945 et 1970 , lorsque de nombreuses centrales au fil de l ' eau on vu le jour en plaine , et que les plus grands ouvrages d ' accumulation ont \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9rig\u00e9s . Jusqu ' au d\u00e9but des ann\u00e9es 1970 , pr\u00e8s de 90 % de l ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 produite en Suisse provenait de la force hydraulique ( base : production moyenne escompt\u00e9e ) . La mise en service des centrales nucl\u00e9aires suisses a fait baisser cette part \u00e0 60 % en 1985 , un pourcentage qui se monte aujourd ' hui \u00e0 57 , 6 % . La force hydraulique est donc rest\u00e9e la principale source d ' \u00e9nergie renouvelable de notre pays . A l ' heure actuelle ( 31 . 12 . 2023 ) , la Suisse poss\u00e8de 705 centrales d ' une puissance \u00e9gale ou sup\u00e9rieure \u00e0 300 kW , qui produisent annuellement une moyenne de 37 ' 171 gigawattheures ( GWh / a ) d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 . Environ 48 , 6 % sont g\u00e9n\u00e9r\u00e9s par des centrales au fil de l ' eau , 47 , 2 % par des centrales \u00e0 accumulation , et 4 , 2 % par des centrales \u00e0 pompage - turbinage . Environ 63 % de la production totale proviennent des cantons alpins ( Uri , Grisons , Tessin et Valais ) , mais les cantons d ' Argovie et de Berne fournissent \u00e9galement des quantit\u00e9s consid\u00e9rables d ' \u00e9nergie hydro\u00e9lectrique . Quant aux centrales internationales situ\u00e9es le long de cours d ' eau frontaliers , elles repr\u00e9sentent 11 % de la production totale suisse . Avec un volume de plus de 1 , 8 milliard de francs ( calcul bas\u00e9 sur un prix de 5 ct . / kWh d\u00e9part centrale ) , la force hydraulique occupe une place importante sur le march\u00e9 suisse de l ' \u00e9nergie . Avec la strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique 2050 , la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration veut augmenter la production annuelle moyenne d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 d ' origine hydraulique \u00e0 39 200 gigawattheures ( GWh ) jusqu\u2019en 2050 ( contre 37 900 GWh en 2035 ) . Afin d ' utiliser le potentiel r\u00e9alisable , les centrales existantes doivent \u00eatre r\u00e9nov\u00e9es et agrandies , et la construction de nouvelles centrales hydro\u00e9lectriques est n\u00e9cessaire , en tenant compte des exigences \u00e9cologiques . La Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration souhaite promouvoir l ' utilisation de l ' \u00e9nergie hydraulique avec diff\u00e9rentes methodes . Les instruments utilis\u00e9s sont les contributions \u00e0 l ' investissement pour les nouvelles centrales et les r\u00e9novations / agrandissements notables de centrales hydro\u00e9lectriques , ainsi que la prime de march\u00e9 pour les centrales qui doivent vendre sur le march\u00e9 \u00e0 des prix inf\u00e9rieurs aux co\u00fbts de production . En outre , gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 ce que l ' on appelle le Mantelerlass , diverses mesures sont pr\u00e9vues pour am\u00e9liorer les conditions - cadres de l ' \u00e9nergie hydraulique ( proc\u00e9dures d ' autorisation plus simples , contributions \u00e0 la planification de projets , objectif d ' expansion du stockage ) . L ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie s ' occupe des aspects politiques de l ' \u00e9nergie hydraulique ( promotion , strat\u00e9gies , perspectives ) ainsi que des aspects techniques et de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 , tandis que l ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' environnement est responsable des aspects environnementaux ( eaux r\u00e9siduelles , protection des masses d ' eau ) . sentence1: Winners of the 2010 Watt d ' Or awards The winners of the 2010 Watt d ' Or awards have been chosen ! This year ' s trophies were presented to the winners on the occasion of the Swiss Federal Office of Energy ' s New Year ' s event that was held on 7 January 2010 in Bern . The following projects were chosen to receive the various awards ( all of which are of equal value ) : \u201cSociety\u201d category \u201cGordola \u2013 sustainable water supply\u201d , Azienda Acqua Potabile Comunale , Gordola ( canton of Ticino ) Saving water means saving energy . Instead of pumping several million Swiss francs into an overdimensioned project for a new drinking water supply network , the town of Gordola in the canton of Ticino decided to simply repair the leaks in the existing supply network and reduce the peak consumption levels . The amount of electricity thus saved would be enough to supply 200 households for an entire year . \u201cEnergy technologies\u201d categories \u201cElectricity production using a gas pressure reduction generator\u201d , Gasverbund Mittelland AG , Arlesheim An innovative type of power plant is currently being constructed in Oberbuchsiten ( canton of Solothurn ) . It is being equipped with a gas pressure reduction generator that utilises the energy that is produced when gas is transferred from the high - pressure pipeline to the low - pressure network for supply to consumers . In this way , the plant in Oberbuchsiten will use this low - CO2 energy source , which otherwise simply evaporates , to produce electricity for 1 , 200 households . \u201cRenewable energies\u201d categories \u201cSwissFarmerPower\u201d , SwissFarmerPower Inwil AG , Lucerne Switzerland ' s largest biogas facility is located in Inwil ( canton of Lucerne ) . Since 2008 it has been converting biogenic waste to biogas , which can be used as a CO2 - neutral motor fuel for gas - powered vehicles . A total of 72 farmers are involved in the operation of this plant , which cost 22 million Swiss francs to construct . \u201cMobility\u201d category \u201cPneumatic hybrid motor\u201d , Institute for Dynamic Systems and Control , Federal Institute of Technology Zurich The team headed by Professor Lino Guzzella at the Federal Institute of Technology in Zurich has developed the world ' s first low - cost pneumatic hybrid motor . It only costs 20 percent more than conventional motors , but consumes up to 30 percent less energy . \u201cBuildings\u201d category \u201cTransformation of Feldbergstrasse 4 & 6 apartment buildings into an energy surplus house\u201d , Virid\u00e9n + Partner AG , Zurich At first glance , the apartment house located at Feldbergstrasse 4 & 6 in Basel does not give the impression of being far ahead of its time . But these comprehensively modernised and joined buildings dating from 1896 will set a new standard for the future in that they produce more energy than they consume for heating throughout the year . sentence2: Laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2010 Les laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2010 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9compens\u00e9s ! Les laur\u00e9ats du concours de cette ann\u00e9e se sont vu remettre leur troph\u00e9e \u00e0 l ' occasion de l ' ap\u00e9ritif du Nouvel An organis\u00e9 par l ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie , le 7 janvier 2010 \u00e0 Berne . Les projets suivants ont tous re\u00e7u le m\u00eame prix : Cat\u00e9gorie Soci\u00e9t\u00e9 Projet \u00abGordola \u2013 approvisionnement durable en eau\u00bb , Azienda Acqua Potabile Comunale Gordola Economiser de l ' eau , c ' est \u00e9conomiser de l ' \u00e9nergie . Au lieu d ' investir plusieurs millions de francs dans un projet surdimensionn\u00e9 de nouveau r\u00e9seau d ' eau potable , la commune tessinoise de Gordola a pr\u00e9f\u00e9r\u00e9 r\u00e9duire les fuites dans le r\u00e9seau existant et lisser les pics de consommation . L ' eau ainsi \u00e9conomis\u00e9e \u00e9quivaut \u00e0 une \u00e9conomie d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 \u2013 pour le pompage et le chauffage \u2013 repr\u00e9sentant la consommation annuelle de 200 m\u00e9nages . Cat\u00e9gorie Technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques \u00abProduction d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 par d\u00e9tente de gaz dans une turbine\u00bb , Gasverbund Mittelland AG , ArlesheimOberbuchsiten ( SO ) s ' est \u00e9quip\u00e9 d ' une centrale \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique d ' un genre particulier . Un turbod\u00e9tenteur r\u00e9cup\u00e8re l ' \u00e9nergie lib\u00e9r\u00e9e lors de la d\u00e9compression du gaz achemin\u00e9 \u00e0 haute pression dans les gazoducs pour alimenter le r\u00e9seau basse pression desservant les consommateurs . Avec cette \u00e9nergie produite presque sans \u00e9mission de CO2 et qui serait autrement perdue , Oberbuchsiten produit de l ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 pour 1200 m\u00e9nages . Cat\u00e9gorie Energies renouvelables \u00abSwissFarmerPower\u00bb , SwissFarmerPower Inwil AG , LucerneLa plus grande installation suisse de biogaz se trouve \u00e0 Inwil ( LU ) . Depuis octobre 2008 , elle transforme les d\u00e9chets biog\u00e8nes en biogaz utilis\u00e9 comme carburant neutre en CO2 pour les v\u00e9hicules \u00e0 gaz naturel . 72 agriculteurs ont particip\u00e9 \u00e0 l ' investissement dans cette installation de 22 millions . Cat\u00e9gorie Mobilit\u00e9 \u00abMoteur hybride pneumatique\u00bb , Institut des syst\u00e8mes dynamiques et du contr\u00f4le , EPF ZurichL ' \u00e9quipe du professeur Lino Guzzella , de l ' EPF de Zurich , a mis au point en premi\u00e8re mondiale un moteur hybride pneumatique bon march\u00e9 capable d ' \u00e9conomiser jusqu ' \u00e0 30 % d ' \u00e9nergie par rapport \u00e0 un moteur traditionnel pour un surco\u00fbt de seulement 20 % . Cat\u00e9gorie B\u00e2timents \u00abTransformation des immeubles Feldbergstrasse 4 + 6 en b\u00e2timent \u00e0 \u00e9nergie positive\u00bb , Virid\u00e9n + Partner AG , ZurichRien n ' indique \u00e0 premi\u00e8re vue que le b\u00e2timent Feldbergstrasse 4 + 6 \u00e0 B\u00e2le est tr\u00e8s en avance sur son temps . Et pourtant les deux immeubles datant de 1896 , modernis\u00e9s de fond en comble et r\u00e9unis en un seul , sont aujourd ' hui \u00e0 la pointe du progr\u00e8s , car ils produisent en une ann\u00e9e plus d ' \u00e9nergie thermique qu ' ils n ' en consomment . sentence1: Research programmes The SFOE provides subsidiary support for research projects that correspond to the priorities of its current energy research concept ( 2021 to 2024 ) . The main focus is on application - oriented and development - related research projects . It is advisable for applicants to contact the head of the research programme ( relevant SFOE contact ) before they submit an application for support . The research programmes of SFOE cover a wide range of energy research topics . The SFOE runs specific technology oriented research programmes in the areas of renewable energies and energy efficiency , complemented by a cross - cutting socio - economic programme . Buildings and Cities Mobility Electricity Heat Pump and Refrigeration Technologies Combustion Based Energy Systems Fuel Cells Industrial Processes Batteries Solar Heat and Heat Storage Photovoltaics Solar Energy at High Temperature Hydrogen Bioenergy Hydropower Geoenergy Wind Energy Dam Safety Energy \u2013 Economy \u2013 Society ( EES ) The SFOE does not run any own research programmes on nuclear energy . sentence1: Overhead lines versus underground cables The question of whether transmission lines for network level 1 ( 220 kV and 380kV ) are to be constructed overhead or placed underground has to be decided on a case - by - case basis and in accordance with objective criteria . For this purpose the Swiss Federal Office of Energy has developed a transmission lines evaluation model . The main objective of the new model is to evaluate various options in order to define the most suitable corridor for transmission lines . This procedure facilitates the process of making an objective decision concerning this question and accelerating the licensing procedure . The model comprises four pillars , each of which contains three to four groups of criteria ( spatial development , technology , environment and the economy ) . Projects are examined on the basis of the criteria . To determine whether a high - voltage transmission line project is to be carried out with overhead lines or underground cabling for voltage levels 3 to 7 ( < 220 kV ) , the additional cost factor has to be calculated in accordance with the provisions of the Transmission Lines Ordinance . To determine this factor , the Swiss Federal Office of Energy has prepared a set of guidelines in an Excel file which must be used for each project concerned . sentence2: Lignes a\u00e9riennes ou souterraines La question de savoir s ' il faut pour le niveau de r\u00e9seau 1 ( NR1 , 220kV et 380kV ) enterrer les lignes \u00e0 tr\u00e8s haute tension ou r\u00e9aliser des lignes a\u00e9riennes doit \u00eatre tranch\u00e9e au cas par cas sur la base de crit\u00e8res objectifs . L ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie a d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 \u00e0 cette fin un syst\u00e8me d ' \u00e9valuation pour les lignes de transport d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 . L ' objectif principal de ce syst\u00e8me est d ' analyser les diff\u00e9rents corridors potentiels et de d\u00e9finir la variante la plus appropri\u00e9e . Ce proc\u00e9d\u00e9 permet de prendre une d\u00e9cision objective et d ' acc\u00e9l\u00e9rer les proc\u00e9dures d ' autorisation . Le syst\u00e8me se compose de quatre volets comportant chacun trois \u00e0 quatre groupes de crit\u00e8res ( d\u00e9veloppement du territoire , technique , environnement et \u00e9conomie ) selon lesquels les projets sont analys\u00e9s et \u00e9valu\u00e9s . Pour d\u00e9terminer si un projet de ligne \u00e9lectrique doit \u00eatre r\u00e9alis\u00e9 sous forme de ligne a\u00e9rienne ou souterraine pour les niveaux de tension 3 \u00e0 7 ( < 220 kV ) le facteur de surcout doit \u00eatre calcul\u00e9 conform\u00e9ment \u00e0 l\u2019OLEl . Pour d\u00e9terminer ce facteur , l ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie a d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 une directive et un fichier Excel qui doivent \u00eatre utilis\u00e9s pour chaque projet concern\u00e9 . sentence1: Winners of the 2020 Watt d ' Or awards The winners of the 2020 Watt d ' Or awards have been chosen ! This year ' s trophies were presented to the winners on the occasion of the Swiss Federal Office of Energy ' s New Year ' s event that was held on 9 January 2020 in Bern . The following projects were chosen to receive the various awards ( all of which are of equal value ) : \u201cEnergy technologies\u201d category ZHAW - IEFE , Schmid Hutter AG Winterthur , Meyer Orchideen AG : A Thermochemical energy network in a greenhouse Since almost 10 years , the greenhouse of Meyer Orchideen AG in Wangen near D\u00fcbendorf has been producing orchids in a climate - neutral way . There could not be a more suitable location to test the innovative novel technology of thermochemical networks , which are studied in the framework of the European research project H - DisNet . These networks can store energy in the form of chemical potential in a saline solution for any length of time without any energy loss . In the orchid greenhouse , the Institute for Energy Systems and Fluid Engineering ( IEFE ) of the University of Applied Sciences Zurich ( ZHAW ) has set up an application of a thermochemical network in collaboration with the air conditioning and ventilation specialist Schmid Hutter AG Winterthur . Here the new technology is being used to reduce energy consumption for air conditioning by up to 50 % . In the future , however , the focus will be on the application of the technology in smart local and regional energy networks as a storage solution . \u201cRenewable energy\u201d category Regio Energie Solothurn : Biological methanation with archaea in a hybrid plant What is the link between flatulence and renewable energy ? The answer is Archie , the farting archaeobacteria in the service of Regio Energie Solothurn in Zuchwil , Solothurn , and of the European research project STORE & GO . Archie ingests hydrogen and CO2 and converts them into biomethane , which is then fed into the natural gas grid . This biological methanation takes place in the Regio Energie Solothurn hybrid plant . In operation since 2015 , this plant is equipped with an electrolyser , which produces solar hydrogen , a hydrogen storage tank and a cogeneration unit . Archie fits in logically with this innovative overall concept , and helps the public better understand the complex technical processes . \u201cEnergy - efficient mobility\u201d category Viktor Meili AG : Municipal e - vehicles by Victor Meili AG They are part of the scene in every town and village : municipal vehicles . The small vehicles sweep the streets , clear away branches , leaves and rubbish or keep paths free from snow and ice . As they do so , they usually cause a lot of noise and emit stinking clouds of diesel fumes . That now no longer needs to be the case because the electric municipal vehicles developed by the Swiss family firm Viktor Meili AG in Sch\u00fcbelbach over the last 10 years are on the starting grid . They are at least as powerful as their diesel equivalents , and have a long period of use per battery charge . They are also very quiet , emit no CO2 and save around CHF 100 000 in fuel and maintenance costs over their lifetime . Designwerk Products AG : The 26 - ton Futuricum Collect 26E electric truck by Designwerk Garbage trucks must be strong and durable . They stop - and - go through the streets to pick up everything we want to get rid of . But they are very noisy and have an unpleasant diesel perfume . The Designwerk company from Winterthur has recognized that garbage trucks are an ideal application for electric propulsion . In a three - year lighthouse project , they developed the 26 - ton Futuricum Collect 26E electric truck . It is currently proving its worth on a daily basis in Thun , Murten , Lausanne and Neuch\u00e2tel , quietly and CO2 - free in its daily employment . It is certainly still about twice as expensive to buy as diesel models , but its operating costs are about 80 % lower . Designwerk Products AG is now starting series production at its Winterthur site , and intends to develop further applications for heavy electric commercial vehicles in the future . \u201cBuildings and space\u201d category ETH Zurich : The anergy grid at the ETH Zurich Campus H\u00f6nggerberg More than 12\u2019000 students and staff populate the H\u00f6nggerberg campus of ETH Zurich every day , consuming as much energy as a small town . A good enough reason for ETH Zurich to pursue a consistent energy strategy : By 2040 it wants to reduce its CO2 emissions by 80 % despite the planned expansion of the campus . Part of this strategy is the renewable heating supply of the H\u00f6nggerberg campus . Since 2012 , several 200 - metre - deep geothermal probe fields store waste heat underground in summer and release it again for heating in winter . An anergy grid , a low - temperature distribution system , transports the energy . Depending on the heating requirements of the buildings , five energy distribution centres extract or pump water from or into the anergy loop . A continuous operational monitoring ensures the ongoing optimization of the system , and also provides data for the future expansion of the campus . sentence2: Laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2020 Les laur\u00e9ats du Watt d ' Or 2020 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9compens\u00e9s ! Les laur\u00e9ats du concours de cette ann\u00e9e se sont vu remettre leur troph\u00e9e \u00e0 l ' occasion de l ' ap\u00e9ritif du Nouvel An organis\u00e9 par l ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' \u00e9nergie , le 9 janvier 2020 \u00e0 Berne . Les projets suivants ont tous re\u00e7u le m\u00eame prix : Cat\u00e9gorie Technologies \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques ZHAW - IEFE , Schmid Hutter AG Winterthur , Meyer Orchideen AG : Un r\u00e9seau d\u2019approvisionnement en \u00e9nergie thermochimique pour les serres Depuis pr\u00e8s de 10 ans , des orchid\u00e9es sont produites de mani\u00e8re climatiquement neutre dans la serre de Meyer Orchideen AG \u00e0 Wangen pr\u00e8s de D\u00fcbendorf . C\u2019est un endroit id\u00e9al pour tester une technologie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique tr\u00e8s innovante . Il s\u2019agit de r\u00e9seaux thermochimiques \u00e9tudi\u00e9s dans le cadre du projet de recherche europ\u00e9en H - DisNet . Ces r\u00e9seaux peuvent stocker l\u2019\u00e9nergie sous forme de potentiel chimique dans une solution saline pendant une dur\u00e9e ind\u00e9termin\u00e9e , sans pertes d\u2019\u00e9nergie . Dans la serre d\u2019orchid\u00e9es , l\u2019Institut des syst\u00e8mes \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques et de l\u2019ing\u00e9nierie des fluides ( IEFE ) de l\u2019Universit\u00e9 des sciences appliqu\u00e9es de Zurich ( ZHAW ) a mis en place , en collaboration avec le producteur de syst\u00e8mes de climatisation et de ventilation Schmid Hutter AG Winterthur , un r\u00e9seau thermochimique . Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 ce r\u00e9seau , la diminution de la consommation d\u2019\u00e9nergie pour la climatisation peut atteindre 50 % . \u00c0 l\u2019avenir , cependant , c\u2019est l\u2019application dans le cadre de r\u00e9seaux d\u2019\u00e9nergie intelligents en tant que solution de stockage au niveau local et r\u00e9gional qui figurera au premier plan . Cat\u00e9gorie Energies renouvelables Regio Energie Solothurn : M\u00e9thanisation biologique au moyen d\u2019arch\u00e9es dans une usine hybride Quel peut bien \u00eatre le lien entre des flatulences et les \u00e9nergies renouvelables ? Voici la r\u00e9ponse avec Archie , une arch\u00e9obact\u00e9rie exploit\u00e9e par l\u2019entreprise de services industriels Regio Energie Solothurn , \u00e0 Zuchwil , dans le canton de Soleure , dans le cadre du projet de recherche europ\u00e9en STORE & GO . Archie ingurgite de l\u2019hydrog\u00e8ne et du CO2 et les transforme en biom\u00e9thane , qui est ensuite inject\u00e9 dans le r\u00e9seau de gaz naturel . Cette m\u00e9thanisation biologique a lieu dans l\u2019usine hybride de Regio Energie Solothurn . En service depuis 2015 , cette usine est \u00e9quip\u00e9e d\u2019un \u00e9lectrolyseur , qui produit de l\u2019hydrog\u00e8ne solaire , d\u2019un r\u00e9servoir d\u2019hydrog\u00e8ne et d\u2019un syst\u00e8me de couplage chaleur - force . Archie s\u2019int\u00e8gre logiquement dans ce concept global innovant et favorise par ailleurs la vulgarisation de processus techniques complexes . Cat\u00e9gorie Mobilit\u00e9 \u00e9conome en \u00e9nergie Viktor Meili AG : V\u00e9hicules communaux \u00e9lectriques de Viktor Meili AG Dans les villes et les villages , les petits v\u00e9hicules communaux font partie du paysage . Ils balayent les rues , enl\u00e8vent les branchages et les feuilles , r\u00e9coltent les ordures et d\u00e9neigent les trottoirs et les chauss\u00e9es . La plupart du temps , ils s\u2019accompagnent cependant d\u2019un vacarme assourdissant et d\u2019\u00e9manations de diesel malodorantes . Ces inconv\u00e9nients sont sur le point de dispara\u00eetre gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 l\u2019arriv\u00e9e des v\u00e9hicules communaux \u00e9lectriques d\u00e9velopp\u00e9s au cours des 10 derni\u00e8res ann\u00e9es par l\u2019entreprise familiale suisse Viktor Meili AG de Sch\u00fcbelbach ( SZ ) . Aussi performants que leurs cousins fonctionnant au diesel , ces v\u00e9hicules disposent d\u2019une longue autonomie . De plus , ils sont tr\u00e8s silencieux , n\u2019\u00e9mettent pas de CO2 et permettent d\u2019\u00e9conomiser environ 100 000 francs en frais d\u2019exploitation et de maintenance sur leur dur\u00e9e de vie . Designwerk Products AG : Le camion \u00e9lectrique de 26 tonnes Futuricum Collect 26E Les camions - poubelle doivent \u00eatre solides et durables . Ils parcourent les rues en stop - and - go pour ramasser nos d\u00e9chets . Mais ils sont tr\u00e8s bruyants et d\u00e9gagent une odeur de diesel d\u00e9sagr\u00e9able . Du point de vue de la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 Designwerk de Winterthour , les camions \u00e0 ordures constituent une application id\u00e9ale pour la propulsion \u00e9lectrique . Dans le cadre d\u2019un projet phare de trois ans , elle a mis au point le camion \u00e9lectrique Futuricum Collect 26E de 26 tonnes . Celui - ci fait actuellement ses preuves au quotidien \u00e0 Thoune , \u00e0 Morat , \u00e0 Lausanne et \u00e0 Neuch\u00e2tel , sans faire de bruit et sans \u00e9mettre de CO2 . Il est certes environ deux fois plus cher \u00e0 l\u2019achat que les mod\u00e8les diesel , mais ses co\u00fbts d\u2019exploitation sont inf\u00e9rieurs d\u2019environ 80 % . Designwerk Products AG d\u00e9marre la production en s\u00e9rie sur son site de Winterthour . Elle pr\u00e9voit de d\u00e9velopper d\u2019autres applications pour les v\u00e9hicules \u00e9lectriques lourds . Cat\u00e9gorie B\u00e2timents et espace \u00c9cole polytechnique f\u00e9d\u00e9rale de Zurich EPFZ : Le r\u00e9seau d\u2019anergie du campus H\u00f6nggerberg de l\u2019EPFZ Le campus H\u00f6nggerberg de l\u2019EPFZ accueille tous les jours plus de 12 000 personnes . Elles y \u00e9tudient ou y travaillent et consomment autant d\u2019\u00e9nergie qu\u2019une petite ville . Raison suffisante pour que l\u2019EPFZ poursuive une strat\u00e9gie \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique coh\u00e9rente . D\u2019ici 2040 , elle veut en effet r\u00e9duire ses \u00e9missions de CO2 de 80 % malgr\u00e9 la croissance pr\u00e9vue . L\u2019approvisionnement en chaleur renouvelable du campus H\u00f6nggerberg fait partie de cette strat\u00e9gie . Il est assur\u00e9 depuis 2012 par plusieurs champs de sondes sis \u00e0 200 m\u00e8tres sous terre . Les rejets de chaleur sont stock\u00e9s dans ces champs en \u00e9t\u00e9 et peuvent \u00eatre utilis\u00e9s pour le chauffage en hiver . L\u2019\u00e9nergie est transport\u00e9e via un \u00abr\u00e9seau d\u2019anergie\u00bb , un syst\u00e8me de distribution \u00e0 basse temp\u00e9rature . Cinq centrales de distribution puisent ou injectent de l\u2019eau dans le r\u00e9seau d\u2019anergie en fonction des besoins de chauffage des b\u00e2timents . Un monitoring en continu permet d\u2019exploiter directement l\u2019exp\u00e9rience acquise \u00e0 des fins d\u2019optimisation et dans la perspective de l\u2019agrandissement du campus de H\u00f6nggerberg . sentence1: The Federal Department of Defence , Civil Protection and Sport ( DDPS ) The Federal Department of Defence , Civil Protection and Sport ( DDPS ) is responsible for the security of the country and its population . The department has been headed by Viola Amherd since the beginning of 2019 . Federal Councillor Viola Amherd Viola Amherd was born in 1962 and grew up in Brig - Glis . She attended baccalaureate school in Brig before studying law at the University of Fribourg . In 1991 she passed the bar exam to practise law in the canton of Valais and had her own law practice in Brig - Glis . Viola Amherd is not married . Viola Amherd began her political career in 1992 as a member of Brig - Glis town council . She was mayor of Brig between 2000 and 2012 . In 2005 she was elected to the National Council . She was vice president of the CVP parliamentary group from 2011 to the moment she was elected to the Federal Council . Viola Amherd has also sat on the boards of various companies and been active in clubs and associations . Election to the Federal Council The United Federal Assembly elected Viola Amherd to the Federal Council on 5 December 2018 . She has been head of the Federal Department of Defence , Civil Protection and Sport DDPS since January 2019 . She was President of the Swiss Confederation in 2024 . The Federal Department of Defence , Civil Protection and Sport ( DDPS ) A lot of people associate the DDPS just with the armed forces . However , the department also performs many important civilian tasks . The DDPS includes the areas of civil protection , the Federal Intelligence Service , as well as the Federal Office of Topography swisstopo , and armasuisse , the federal government ' s competence centre for the procurement of complex technology . Promoting popular and elite sport is also among the broad range of tasks covered by the DDPS . DDPS facts and figures Staff ( full - time positions / 2021 ) : 12 , 128 Expenses 2021 : CHF 8 . 24 billion Last modification 12 . 12 . 2024
sentence2: Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de la d\u00e9fense , de la protection de la population et des sports ( DDPS ) Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de la d\u00e9fense , de la protection de la population et des sports ( DDPS ) est charg\u00e9 de la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 de la Suisse et de sa population . Il est dirig\u00e9 depuis d\u00e9but 2019 par Viola Amherd . La conseill\u00e8re f\u00e9d\u00e9rale Viola Amherd Viola Amherd est n\u00e9e en 1962 et a grandi \u00e0 Brigue - Glis . Elle a fr\u00e9quent\u00e9 le coll\u00e8ge de Brigue et a \u00e9tudi\u00e9 le droit \u00e0 l ' universit\u00e9 de Fribourg . En 1991 , elle a obtenu le brevet d ' avocat du canton du Valais . Depuis lors , elle est avocate et notaire ind\u00e9pendante \u00e0 Brigue - Glis . Viola Amherd n ' est pas mari\u00e9e . Viola Amherd a commenc\u00e9 sa carri\u00e8re politique en 1992 dans l ' ex\u00e9cutif de Brigue - Glis . De 2000 \u00e0 2012 , elle a \u00e9t\u00e9 pr\u00e9sidente de Brigue . En 2005 , elle a \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9lue au Conseil national . De 2011 \u00e0 son \u00e9lection au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , elle a \u00e9t\u00e9 vice - pr\u00e9sidente du groupe PDC au Parlement . Viola Amherd a occup\u00e9 divers postes dans des conseils d\u2019administration et a \u00e9t\u00e9 active dans des associations et organisations . \u00c9lection au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Le 5 d\u00e9cembre 2018 , l ' Assembl\u00e9e f\u00e9d\u00e9rale a \u00e9lu Viola Amherd au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Depuis le 1er janvier 2019 , elle est cheffe du D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de la d\u00e9fense , de la protection de la population et des sports ( DDPS ) . En 2024 , elle \u00e9tait pr\u00e9sidente de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de la d\u00e9fense , de la protection de la population et des sports ( DDPS ) Qui pense DDPS pense d ' abord arm\u00e9e . Le D\u00e9partement a toutefois aussi dans le domaine civil des t\u00e2ches importantes pour la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 de la Suisse et de sa population . Incombent \u00e9galement au DDPS la protection de la population , le Service de renseignement de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , l ' Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de topographie swisstopo , ainsi qu ' armasuisse , le centre de comp\u00e9tences de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration pour l ' acquisition de technologies complexes . L ' encouragement du sport d ' \u00e9lite et du sport populaire compl\u00e8tent la large palette du d\u00e9partement . sentence1: Inclusion of the scientific community Independent scientific expertise can make an important contribution to crisis management . In a crisis , the Federal Chancellery coordinates the involvement of scientific experts to advise the national government . It supports the exchange between the federal government and the scientific community even before a crisis occurs to ensure the best possible cooperation in the event of a crisis . 20 . 3280 Michel 20 . 3542 De Quattro Link The COVID - 19 pandemic demonstrated the importance of consulting scientific experts early on in crisis management . In the wake of the pandemic and as part of its response to Postulates 20 . 3280 Michel and 20 . 3542 De Quattro , the Federal Council decided on 23 November 2022 to activate scientific expertise during crises through the creation of ad - hoc advisory groups and to define corresponding processes ( ) . On 8 December 2023 , the Federal Council adopted a corresponding implementation proposal . An ad - hoc scientific advisory body makes it possible to respond to the requirements of the crisis with the most suitable experts . As these experts are not employed by the Federal Administration , they are not bound by instructions and are therefore more independent . Scientific advisory body in a crisis If the Federal Council sets up an interdepartmental crisis management task force , it will examine whether the involvement of an ad hoc scientific advisory body is appropriate . If so , the Federal Council will decide on its appointment . The experts who sit on this committee are proposed jointly by Switzerland ' s six major scientific institutions : swissuniversities ETH Board Swiss National Science Foundation Swiss Academies of Arts and Sciences Swiss Science Council Innosuisse \u2022 swissuniversities \u2022 ETH Board \u2022 Swiss National Science Foundation \u2022 Swiss Academies of Arts and Sciences \u2022 Swiss Science Council \u2022 The proposed experts are confirmed by the Federal Administration prior to their participation in the Scientific Advisory Board . swissuniversities acts as the single point of contact for the Confederation . For its part , the Federal Chancellery serves as the point of contact for the scientific community . Together with the State Secretariat for Education , Research and Innovation ( SERI ) and the department in charge of the crisis , the Federal Chancellery also coordinates the process of setting up an advisory body . cooperation agreement The Federal Chancellery , SERI and the participating scientific institutions signed a for this purpose on 8 December 2023 . The establishment of a scientific advisory body is based on Article 57 of the Government and Administration Organisation Act ( GAOA , SR 172 . 010 ) . Article 57 GAOA stipulates that the Federal Council and the departments may consult organisations and persons which are not part of the Federal Administration . The consultation requires justification and must be limited in time . The involvement of organisations and persons from outside the Federal Administration is particularly necessary and justified when specialist areas are involved in which the required expertise is not available within the Federal Administration or the necessary personnel resources are lacking . Code of practice code of practice The above - mentioned scientific institutions and the Confederation have drawn up a defining the tasks and responsibilities of scientific experts . The states that experts are to advise policymakers about the current state of certainty and uncertainty in their area of expertise , develop realistic scenarios , and outline different policy options , explaining their respective risks and benefits . The code also states that scientific evidence alone is never sufficient for decision - making , as other aspects must be taken into account , in particular societal values and interests . At the same time , the code stipulates that the independence of scientific advice must be guaranteed at all times . Clusters to prepare and build trust In the run - up to a crisis , scientific organisations form clusters for certain crisis - relevant topics so that experts can be recruited more quickly . These theme - based clusters also offer the opportunity to facilitate exchange among the Federal Council , the Federal Administration and , if necessary , Parliament and the cantons on specific subject areas during normal times . The Federal Council has proposed the following topics for 2024 : \u2022 Public health \u2022 Cybersecurity \u2022 International challenges The topics for 2025 will be determined in the current year .
