Switzerland\u2019s ERI institutions are to jointly propose experts for the groups . The ERI institutions and the Confederation have drawn up a Code of Practice for participants in the Swiss National Science Advice Network .
sentence2: Implication des milieux scientifiques L\u2019expertise scientifique ind\u00e9pendante peut apporter une plus - value importante \u00e0 la gestion des crises . En cas de crise , la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale coordonne le recours \u00e0 des scientifiques pour conseiller le gouvernement national . Elle soutient les \u00e9changes entre l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et les milieux scientifiques en situation normale afin que cette collaboration fonctionne de mani\u00e8re optimale en cas de crise . 20 . 3280 Michel 20 . 3542 de Quattro lien La pand\u00e9mie de COVID - 19 a montr\u00e9 \u00e0 quel point il \u00e9tait important que les milieux scientifiques soient pr\u00e9cocement et pleinement int\u00e9gr\u00e9s dans le dispositif de gestion des crises de l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Tirant les enseignements de la pand\u00e9mie de COVID - 19 et dans le cadre de l\u2019ex\u00e9cution des postulats 20 . 3280 Michel et 20 . 3542 de Quattro , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a d\u00e9cid\u00e9 le 23 novembre 2022 d\u2019associer les milieux scientifiques \u00e0 la gestion des crises au moyen d\u2019organes ad hoc et de d\u00e9finir les processus ad\u00e9quats ( ) . Il a approuv\u00e9 une proposition de mise en \u0153uvre concernant l\u2019implication d\u2019organes scientifiques consultatifs ad hoc en cas de crise le 8 d\u00e9cembre 2023 . Un organe scientifique consultatif ad hoc , compos\u00e9 des experts ad\u00e9quats , permet de r\u00e9agir au mieux \u00e0 une situation de crise . Ces consultants , externes \u00e0 l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , ne sont pas li\u00e9s par des instructions et sont donc plus ind\u00e9pendants . Organe scientifique consultatif en cas de crise Lorsque le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral met en place une organisation de crise interd\u00e9partementale , il examine s\u2019il est opportun d\u2019y associer un organe scientifique consultatif ad hoc . Si tel est le cas , il d\u00e9cide de son institution et les six grandes organisations scientifiques de Suisse proposeront ensemble les experts qui y participeront . Se prononceront : Avant de participer \u00e0 l\u2019organe consultatif , les experts propos\u00e9s devront \u00eatre confirm\u00e9s par l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Les contacts avec l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale se feront par l\u2019interm\u00e9diaire de swissuniversities ( single point of contact ) . La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sera quant \u00e0 elle l\u2019interlocutrice des milieux scientifiques . Elle coordonnera en outre , avec le Secr\u00e9tariat d\u2019\u00c9tat \u00e0 la formation , \u00e0 la recherche et \u00e0 l\u2019innovation ( SEFRI ) et le d\u00e9partement responsable de la gestion de la crise , la proc\u00e9dure d\u2019institution de l\u2019organe consultatif . convention de collaboration La Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , le SEFRI et les organisations scientifiques concern\u00e9es ont sign\u00e9 une \u00e0 cet effet le 8 d\u00e9cembre 20203 . L\u2019institution d\u2019un organe scientifique consultatif se fonde sur l\u2019art . 57 de la loi sur l\u2019organisation du gouvernement et de l\u2019administration ( LOGA , RS 172 . 010 ) . Cette disposition pr\u00e9voit que le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et les d\u00e9partements peuvent consulter des organisations et des personnes ext\u00e9rieures \u00e0 l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale . Le recours \u00e0 ces externes doit \u00eatre motiv\u00e9 et de dur\u00e9e limit\u00e9e . Le recours \u00e0 des organisations et des personnes ext\u00e9rieures \u00e0 l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale est n\u00e9cessaire et justifi\u00e9 notamment lorsque l\u2019administration ne dispose pas des connaissances techniques dans un domaine particulier ou manque de personnel . Code applicable aux experts de l\u2019organe consultatif code Les organisations scientifiques et l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale ont \u00e9labor\u00e9 ensemble un d\u00e9finissant les t\u00e2ches et les responsabilit\u00e9s des experts . Selon celui - ci , les experts ont la mission d\u2019informer les d\u00e9cideurs politiques de l\u2019\u00e9tat actuel des connaissances et des incertitudes dans leur domaine de sp\u00e9cialit\u00e9 . Ils doivent en outre \u00e9laborer des sc\u00e9narios , esquisser des possibilit\u00e9s d\u2019action et expliquer les risques et les avantages qui y sont li\u00e9s . Le pr\u00e9cise que les connaissances scientifiques ne sauraient \u00eatre les seules bases d\u00e9cisionnelles \u00e0 prendre en compte , car d\u2019autres aspects ont leur importance , comme les valeurs et les int\u00e9r\u00eats de la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 . Le pr\u00e9voit \u00e9galement que l\u2019ind\u00e9pendance des conseils scientifiques doit \u00eatre garantie \u00e0 tout moment . Groupes th\u00e9matiques pour la pr\u00e9paration aux crises et l\u2019\u00e9tablissement de la confiance Avant m\u00eame qu\u2019une crise ne survienne , les organisations scientifiques forment des groupes consacr\u00e9s aux diff\u00e9rents th\u00e8mes importants en cas de crise , afin de pouvoir recruter plus rapidement des experts . Ces groupes permettent en outre de renforcer , en temps normal , les \u00e9changes sur certains th\u00e8mes avec l\u2019administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale et , le cas \u00e9ch\u00e9ant , avec le Parlement et les cantons . Les clusters suivants sont actuellement en construction : Informations compl\u00e9mentaires Documents Mettre \u00e0 profit le potentiel scientifique en p\u00e9riode de crise . Rapport du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral en ex\u00e9cution des postulats Michel 20 . 3280 du 5 mai 2020 et De Quattro 20 . 3542 du 8 juin 2020 ( PDF , 261 kB , 18 . 11 . 2022 ) Code de bonnes pratiques \u00e0 lusage des participants du R\u00e9seau national suisse de conseil scientifique . pdf ( PDF , 470 kB , 02 . 07 . 2024 ) Les documents suivants sont disponibles en allemand uniquement : Optionen wissenschaftlicher Politikberatung im Hinblick auf Krise . Grundlagebericht f\u00fcr die Beantwortung des Postulats Michel 20 . 3280 zuhanden der Bundeskanzlei ( PDF , 1 MB , 18 . 11 . 2022 ) Zusammenarbeitsvereinbarung betreffend Organisation wissenschaftlicher Beratung der Bundesverwaltung in Krisenf\u00e4llen ( PDF , 338 kB , 12 . 12 . 2023 ) Communiqu\u00e9s de presse Consultation des milieux scientifiques en cas de crise Lors de sa s\u00e9ance du 8 d\u00e9cembre 2023 , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a approuv\u00e9 une proposition de mise en \u0153uvre concernant l\u2019implication d\u2019organes scientifiques consultatifs ad hoc en cas de crise . Le cas \u00e9ch\u00e9ant , les grandes organisations scientifiques de Suisse proposeraient conjointement les experts qui y participeraient . Les organisations scientifiques et la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration ont en outre \u00e9labor\u00e9 un code applicable \u00e0 ces organes . Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral entend mieux utiliser le potentiel scientifique en p\u00e9riode de crise Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a adopt\u00e9 le 23 novembre 2022 le rapport \u00ab Mettre \u00e0 profit le potentiel scientifique en p\u00e9riode de crise \u00bb , \u00e9tabli en ex\u00e9cution des postulats Michel 20 . 3280 et de Quattro 20 . 3542 , et examin\u00e9 plusieurs mani\u00e8res de mieux associer les milieux scientifiques \u00e0 la gestion de crise . Il estime , au m\u00eame titre que des repr\u00e9sentants de ces milieux , que la proposition la plus adapt\u00e9e pour recourir \u00e0 leur expertise est l\u2019institution d\u2019organes ad hoc . Il a charg\u00e9 la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale , en collaboration avec le DEFR , d\u2019\u00e9laborer une proposition de mise en \u0153uvre d\u2019ici \u00e0 la fin 2023 . sentence1: The energy label for lamps Lighting accounts for around 10 percent of Switzerland ' s electricity consumption . Since 2012 , minimum requirements for the energy efficiency of light sources and control gears have been in force . In the course of the gradual tightening of these minimum requirements , almost all incandescent , halogen and integral compact fluorescent lamps have disappeared from the market today . Since 1 September 2021 , light sources must be declared with the new energy label . In addition to the energy efficiency class , the label also shows the power consumption per 1000 operating hours . Initially , there are still hardly any products with an A - class rating . This \u00abempty\u00bb class leaves room for the development of future efficient products . Since 2023 , important new requirements apply on mercury in lamps for general lighting , in addition to the efficiency requirements : since 24 February 2023 , compact fluorescent lamps , among others , can no longer be placed on the market , and since 24 August 2023 , neither can T8 fluorescent tubes in all lengths ( 26 mm diameter linear fluorescent lamps ) and T5 fluorescent tubes ( 16 mm diameter ) . Switzerland adopted these requirements identically to the EU , based on Directive 2011 / 65 / EU on the restriction of the use of certain hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment ( \u201cRoHS\u201d ) . The Federal Office for the Environment is in charge of this . Depuis 2012 , des exigences minimales relatives \u00e0 l ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique des sources lumineuses et des appareillages de commande sont en vigueur . Dans le cadre du renforcement progressif de ces exigences minimales , presque toutes les lampes \u00e0 incandescence , halog\u00e8nes et \u00e0 \u00e9conomie d ' \u00e9nergie ont aujourd ' hui disparu du march\u00e9 . Depuis le 1er septembre 2021 , les sources lumineuses doivent \u00eatre d\u00e9clar\u00e9es avec la nouvelle \u00e9tiquette - \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique . En plus de la classe d ' efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique , l ' \u00e9tiquette indique \u00e9galement la consommation d ' \u00e9nergie pour 1000 heures de fonctionnement . Dans un premier temps , il n ' y a encore pratiquement aucun produit class\u00e9 dans la classe A . Cette classe \u00abvide\u00bb laisse de la place pour le d\u00e9veloppement de futurs produits plus efficaces . Depuis 2023 , d\u2019importantes nouvelles exigences relatives \u00e0 la pr\u00e9sence de mercure dans les lampes destin\u00e9es \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9clairage g\u00e9n\u00e9ral s\u2019appliquent en compl\u00e9ment aux exigences d ' efficacit\u00e9 . Depuis le 24 f\u00e9vrier 2023 , il n\u2019est notamment plus admis de mettre en circulation les lampes fluorescentes compactes . Depuis le 24 ao\u00fbt 2023 , la m\u00eame interdiction s\u2019applique aux tubes fluorescents T8 de 26 mm de diam\u00e8tre et de toutes longueurs , ainsi qu\u2019aux tubes fluorescents T5 de 16 mm de diam\u00e8tre . La Suisse reprend \u00e0 l ' identique les exigences de l ' UE , selon la directive 2011 / 65 / UE relative \u00e0 la limitation de l\u2019utilisation de certaines substances dangereuses dans les \u00e9quipements \u00e9lectriques et \u00e9lectroniques ( \u00abRoHS\u00bb ) . L\u2019\u00e9tat - major du chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration est charg\u00e9 de soutenir le chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration et les vice - chanceliers pour toutes les questions d\u2019ordre organisationnel ou administratif . Il est responsable \u00e0 ce titre de la pr\u00e9paration et du suivi des s\u00e9ances du Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et de la Direction sur le plan mat\u00e9riel , ainsi que des relations avec le Parlement pour les affaires parlementaires et des autres affaires ayant une grande port\u00e9e politique . sentence1: Professional Education The extensive training needed to handle challenging technical and managerial tasks associated with a given profession is provided by the Swiss professional education sector , which ensures that qualified specialists can be found on the Swiss labour market . Each year , around 27 , 500 people obtain a professional qualification . Professional education comprises : The professional education sector , together with the universities and universities of applied sciences , form the tertiary level of the Swiss education system . The Swiss professional education sector offers holders of a Federal VET Diploma , or an equivalent upper - secondary level qualification , the opportunity to acquire more specialised and extensive professional expertise in their field as well as business management skills . The training provided within the Swiss professional education sector builds on a person\u2019s previous and current work experience . Classroom instruction and the person\u2019s existing employment complement each other in a way that closely resembles the dual - track approach found in the Swiss VET sector . Training content is designed to develop specific professional competences that are in demand on the labour market : emphasis is placed on readily applicable knowledge and skills , rapid introduction of the latest developments in a given professional field and fast - paced innovation . In this manner , the Swiss professional education sector ensures that qualified specialists can be found on the Swiss labour market . NET Call 2024 Battery storage is playing an increasingly important role , both at the stationary level ( renewable energy ) and in the field of e - mobility . In view of the huge importance of storage technology in the context of the expansion of renewable energy capacities in order to reduce levels of greenhouse gas emissions , major efforts to develop new batteries are being made throughout the world , and rapid progress is being achieved . Today the battery cell market is dominated by Asian manufacturers ( with a share of more than 90 % ) , but initiatives have also recently been launched in Europe ( e . g . European Battery Alliance ) aimed at speeding up expertise and manufacture here . Swiss players are focusing on a variety of areas of battery research , including low temperature , high temperature ( salt ) and redox flow batteries . sentence1: Personal details Albert R\u00f6sti was elected to the Federal Council on 7 December 2022 . He holds a doctorate in technical sciences and a Master ' s degree in agricultural engineering , and also earned an MBA through study in Bern and Rochester , New York . Prior to his election to the Federal Council , he owned a company active in public affairs and project management . Director of Swiss Milk Producers from 2007\u20132013 , Dr R\u00f6sti had previously held various positions in the Bern cantonal government , including a period as secretary general of the Department of Economic Affairs from 2003\u20132006 . Over the years he has also held a number of association and club roles . In 2011 Dr R\u00f6sti was elected to the Swiss Parliament , where he was a member of the Environment , Spatial Planning and Energy Committee for 11 years and presided over the National Council ' s Social Security and Health Committee in 2022 . He was president of the Swiss People ' s Party ( SVP ) from 2016\u20132019 . Dr R\u00f6sti is married with two adult children . He was born on 7 August 1967 in Frutigen , where he is also a citizen .
sentence2: Notice biographique Albert R\u00f6sti a \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9lu au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral le 7 d\u00e9cembre 2022 . Il est docteur en sciences techniques et ing\u00e9nieur agronome . Dans le cadre de ses \u00e9tudes \u00e0 Berne et \u00e0 Rochester ( New York ) , il a obtenu un Master of Business Administration ( MBA ) . Avant d\u2019\u00eatre \u00e9lu au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral , il d\u00e9tenait un bureau actif dans les domaines des affaires publiques et de la gestion de projets . De 2007 \u00e0 2013 , il a \u00e9t\u00e9 directeur de la F\u00e9d\u00e9ration des Producteurs Suisses de Lait . Auparavant , il a exerc\u00e9 diverses fonctions pour le canton de Berne , occupant notamment le poste de secr\u00e9taire g\u00e9n\u00e9ral de la Direction de l\u2019\u00e9conomie de 2003 \u00e0 2006 . Il a par ailleurs effectu\u00e9 des mandats dans plusieurs associations . Albert R\u00f6sti a \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9lu au Conseil national en 2011 . Il y a notamment si\u00e9g\u00e9 \u00e0 la Commission de l\u2019environnement , de l\u2019am\u00e9nagement du territoire et de l\u2019\u00e9nergie pendant onze ans et il a pr\u00e9sid\u00e9 la Commission de la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 sociale et de la sant\u00e9 publique en 2022 . De 2016 \u00e0 2019 , il a \u00e9t\u00e9 pr\u00e9sident de l\u2019Union d\u00e9mocratique du centre ( UDC ) . Albert R\u00f6sti est mari\u00e9 et p\u00e8re de deux enfants adultes . Il est n\u00e9 le 7 ao\u00fbt 1967 \u00e0 Frutigen et est originaire du m\u00eame lieu .

sentence1: Terminology The quality of the terminology used in a specialist text determines to a large extent on the quality of the text itself , whether it be the original or a translation . Terminology is therefore essential for effective communication and knowledge transfer . What is terminology ? Terminology is first and foremost the specialist vocabulary used in a specific field , e . g . medicine , law or spatial planning . Terminological work involves compiling , processing and publishing this specialist vocabulary . This can be done on an ad hoc basis , for example when working on a translation , or systematically , to compile a comprehensive terminological collection in a specific field . Writers , translators , interpreters , lawyers , communication specialists , scientists , technicians etc . all deal with terminology in their daily work . The role of terminology The quality of the terminology used in a specialist text determines to a large extent the quality of the text itself , whether it be the original or a translation , as the correct use of terminology helps to make a text clear and comprehensible . Terminology is therefore very important for effective communication and knowledge transfer . Terminology in the Federal Administration The Federal Administration operates multilingually , but there is no centralised coordination of this work . In order to avoid the same work being done twice , and to ensure unity and quality , terminology work in the four national languages and English needs to be well coordinated and access provided to the relevant information . The Terminology Section in the Federal Chancellery assumes this role , compiling terminology and making it publicly available in TERMDAT , the federal terminology database . Training courses Each year , the Terminology Section runs courses on the methodology of terminology work and on how to search for and record entries in TERMDAT in several languages . Further information Dokument Search in TERMDAT TERMDAT - Kurzanleitung ( in German ) ( PDF , 1 MB , 26 . 03 . 2025 ) TERMDAT classification ( PDF , 195 kB , 09 . 07 . 2024 ) Terminology collections TERMDAT ( PDF , 409 kB , 19 . 01 . 2023 ) TERMDAT - Leitfaden ( in German ) ( PDF , 2 MB , 07 . 03 . 2018 ) Central Language Services , Terminology Section Legal basis
sentence2: La terminologie De la qualit\u00e9 de la terminologie d\u00e9pend en grande partie la qualit\u00e9 d\u2019un texte sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9 , qu\u2019il s\u2019agisse d\u2019un texte original ou d\u2019une traduction . La terminologie est essentielle comme outil de communication et de transfert des connaissances . Qu ' est - ce que la terminologie ? Lorsqu ' on parle de terminologie , on entend tout d ' abord l\u2019ensemble des termes utilis\u00e9s dans un domaine sp\u00e9cifique , p . ex . la terminologie de la m\u00e9decine , du droit ou de l ' am\u00e9nagement du territoire . La terminologie , c\u2019est aussi l\u2019activit\u00e9 qui recense , met en forme et diffuse le vocabulaire sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9 . Cette activit\u00e9 peut s\u2019effectuer ponctuellement , dans le cas de glossaires \u00e9labor\u00e9s pour une traduction p . ex . , ou syst\u00e9matiquement , c\u2019est - \u00e0 - dire en couvrant un domaine sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9 de fa\u00e7on aussi exhaustive et globale que possible dans le cadre d\u2019une collection terminologique . Tout r\u00e9dacteur , traducteur , interpr\u00e8te , juriste , sp\u00e9cialiste en communication , technicien ou scientifique est confront\u00e9 quotidiennement \u00e0 la terminologie . Le r\u00f4le de la terminologie De la qualit\u00e9 de la terminologie d\u00e9pend en grande partie la qualit\u00e9 d\u2019un texte sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9 , qu\u2019il s\u2019agisse d\u2019un texte original ou d\u2019une traduction . La terminologie employ\u00e9e en garantit la clart\u00e9 et par cons\u00e9quent l\u2019intelligibilit\u00e9 . La terminologie est donc essentielle comme outil de communication et de transfert des connaissances . La terminologie dans l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale La d\u00e9centralisation des activit\u00e9s li\u00e9es au plurilinguisme au sein de l ' administration f\u00e9d\u00e9rale suisse requiert une coordination des travaux de terminologie et un acc\u00e8s rapide \u00e0 l ' information , de mani\u00e8re \u00e0 \u00e9viter toute duplication des efforts et le gaspillage de temps qui en r\u00e9sulte . Cette coordination permet aussi de garantir un niveau de qualit\u00e9 uniforme . La Section de terminologie de la Chancellerie f\u00e9d\u00e9rale assure cette coordination en proposant une gamme \u00e9tendue de services dans les langues officielles et en anglais . Elle rend le fruit de ses travaux accessible \u00e0 tous via TERMDAT , la banque de donn\u00e9es terminologique de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . La terminologie contribue ainsi largement \u00e0 une communication et \u00e0 une information d\u2019excellente qualit\u00e9 en plusieurs langues . Formation La Section de terminologie organise chaque ann\u00e9e des cours de m\u00e9thodologie de la terminologie et des cours d\u2019initiation \u00e0 l\u2019interrogation et \u00e0 l\u2019alimentation de TERMDAT en plusieurs langues . sentence1: The Federal Department of the Environment , Transport , Energy and Communications ( DETEC ) The Federal Department of the Environment , Transport , Energy and Communications ( DETEC ) is the department for federal infrastructure and environmental matters . Albert R\u00f6sti has headed it since January 2023 . Federal Councillor Albert R\u00f6sti Albert R\u00f6sti was born in 1967 and grew up in Kandersteg in the canton of Bern . He attended upper - secondary school in Thun and studied agronomy at ETH Zurich , attaining a PhD in 1997 . In 2001 and 2002 he completed an MBA at the University of Rochester in the USA . During his professional career , Albert R\u00f6sti has been a teacher of agricultural studies , secretary general of the Department of Economic Affairs of the Canton of Bern , and director of Swissmilk . In 2013 he set up his own consultancy business , providing services for the private and public sector . He has also sat on a number of governing boards and been an active member of various associations . Albert R\u00f6sti is married and has two grown - up children . Albert R\u00f6sti began his political career in 2008 when he became a member of Uetendorf Communal Council , serving as the town\u2019s mayor from 2014 . He was elected to the National Council in 2011 and was president of the Swiss People\u2019s Party ( SVP ) from 2016 to 2020 . Election to the Federal Council The United Federal Assembly elected Albert R\u00f6sti to the Federal Council on 7 December 2022 . He took over as head of the Federal Department of the Environment , Transport , Energy and Communications ( DETEC ) in January 2023 . The Federal Department of the Environment , Transport , Energy and Communications ( DETEC ) DETEC deals with infrastructure and environmental matters . Modern transport routes , communication networks and the power grid all fall under its remit . However , DETEC also deals with issues relating to the environment and health and safety . This concentration of user interests and protection interests under one roof can often create conflicting objectives . Decisions must therefore often be very carefully prepared . DETEC facts and figures Staff ( full - time positions / 2022 ) : 2 , 474 Expenses 2022 : CHF 13 . 93 billion Last modification 29 . 12 . 2023
sentence2: Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' environnement , des transports , de l ' \u00e9nergie et de la communication ( DETEC ) Le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' environnement , des transports , de l ' \u00e9nergie et de la communication ( DETEC ) est le d\u00e9partement de l ' infrastructure et de l ' environnement . Il est dirig\u00e9 depuis janvier 2023 par Albert R\u00f6sti . Le conseiller f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Albert R\u00f6sti N\u00e9 en 1967 , Albert R\u00f6sti a grandi \u00e0 Kandersteg ( BE ) . Apr\u00e8s des \u00e9tudes gymnasiales \u00e0 Thoune , il a \u00e9tudi\u00e9 l\u2019agronomie \u00e0 l\u2019\u00c9cole polytechnique f\u00e9d\u00e9rale de Zurich , obtenant le titre de docteur en 1997 . En 2001 et en 2002 , il a fait des \u00e9tudes \u00e0 l\u2019Universit\u00e9 de Rochester , aux \u00c9tats - Unis , couronn\u00e9es par un Master of Business Administration ( MBA ) . Il a d\u00e9but\u00e9 sa carri\u00e8re professionnelle en \u00e9tant tour \u00e0 tour professeur d\u2019agriculture , secr\u00e9taire g\u00e9n\u00e9ral de la Direction de l\u2019\u00e9conomie du canton de Berne et directeur des Producteurs suisses de lait . A partir de 2013 , il a dirig\u00e9 le \u00ab B\u00fcro Dr . R\u00f6sti \u00bb , qui proposait des services de conseils aux milieux \u00e9conomiques et politiques . Il a si\u00e9g\u00e9 par ailleurs dans une s\u00e9rie de conseils d\u2019administration tout en \u0153uvrant dans diverses associations . Albert R\u00f6sti est mari\u00e9 et p\u00e8re de deux enfants adultes . Albert R\u00f6sti a d\u00e9but\u00e9 sa carri\u00e8re politique en 2008 \u00e0 l\u2019ex\u00e9cutif de la commune d\u2019Uetendorf ( BE ) , qu\u2019il a pr\u00e9sid\u00e9 \u00e0 partir de 2014 . \u00c9lu au Conseil national en 2011 , il a \u00e9t\u00e9 pr\u00e9sident de l\u2019UDC suisse de 2016 \u00e0 2020 . \u00c9lection au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Le 7 d\u00e9cembre 2022 , l ' Assembl\u00e9e f\u00e9d\u00e9rale a \u00e9lu l ' UDC Albert R\u00f6sti au Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral . Depuis janvier 2023 , il dirige le DETEC . D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' environnement , des transports , de l ' \u00e9nergie et de la communication ( DETEC ) Le DETEC s ' occupe aussi bien d ' infrastructure ( voies de circulation modernes , r\u00e9seaux d ' \u00e9lectricit\u00e9 et de communication ) que d ' environnement . Il doit n\u00e9anmoins aussi tenir compte des aspects li\u00e9s \u00e0 la sant\u00e9 et \u00e0 la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 . Il n ' est cependant pas rare que cette combinaison d ' int\u00e9r\u00eats relatifs \u00e0 l ' utilisation et \u00e0 la protection entra\u00eene des conflits en termes d ' objectifs . Les d\u00e9cisions doivent donc \u00eatre pr\u00e9par\u00e9es avec un soin tout particulier . sentence1: The energy label for electronic displays It is now possible to identify the energy consumption of an electronic display at a glance : the energy label contains a scale indicating the efficiency categories , green = highest efficiency , red = lowest efficiency . In Switzerland , all electronic displays for sale are required to display this label . In addition to the energy consumption in kilowatt - hours during 1000 hours , this label also declares the screen diagonal as well as the efficiency class and the energy consumption when reproducing High Dynamic Range content . In addition , specific requirements apply to power consumption in standby and off mode . sentence1: Drones and model aircraft Drones are remote - controlled , usually small aircraft . Legally they are equivalent to model aircraft and are considered to be radio equipment . The number of drones operated commercially and privately in Switzerland is continuously increasing . The Federal Office of Civil Aviation ( FOCA ) is responsible for the development of aviation and the supervision of civil aviation in Switzerland : FOCA Homepage Drones fall within OFCOM\u2019s area of responsibility with regard to regulation of the frequency spectrum and of radio equipment if they contain a radio transmitter and or receiver Specialist contact for frequencies and radio licenses : kf - fk @ bakom . admin . ch Compliance of drones here A drone \u2013 provided that it contains a radio transmitter and / or receiver - is a radio equipment . The legal requirements for market access ( e . g . offering , selling , hiring , placing on the market ) and the conformity of radio equipment are described . here Information on buying radio equipment abroad for personal use or resale in Switzerland can be found . Technical contact for market access and conformity : ra - mk @ bakom . admin . ch Use of frequency resources Frequencies are required for command and control applications and for the transmission of user data as well as for traffic information and collision avoidance systems The available frequencies usually have to be shared with other users . Since no dedicated frequency resources are currently available for drones , interference - free operation cannot be guaranteed . Work is currently underway at the international level to resolve this issue . Frequency resources for control and communication ( command and control ) and for the transmission of payload data Various frequency ranges are available for command and control applications and for user data transmission ( ground - to - air / air - to - ground ) . Their use is subject to specific regulatory framework requirements ( radio interface regulations ( RIR ) ) : No license , prior notification or certificate of proficiency is required for the above frequency usage . Frequency resources for traffic information and collision avoidance The frequencies used for this purpose are subject to certain regulatory framework requirements ( radio interface regulations ( RIR ) ) : No license , prior notification or certificate of proficiency is required for the above frequency usage . Directive on the use of transponders and ADS - B for drones and model aircraft rpas @ bazl . admin . ch Operational Authorization based on SORA Applicants are requested to contact FOCA rpas @ bazl . admin . ch with a request for transponder and ADS - B use on a drone . For more information on the FOCA website : \ Transponder ( Info ) \ Notify radio equipment in an aircraft - Detailed information | eGovernment DETEC Once FOCA has authorized the use of the transponder and ADS - B on the drone ( by allocating the 24 - bit address ( ICAO code ) ) , the applicant has to apply for the notification of the radio equipment at : . The frequency used for this purpose are subject to certain regulatory framework requirements ( radio interface regulations ( RIR ) ) : kf - fk @ bakom . admin . ch For questions about the use of the eGovernment portal , you can you also contact OFCOM directly Frequency resources for detection No frequencies are currently available in Switzerland for the detection of drones . However , work is underway to identify frequencies for this application . As soon as these have been completed , the regulatory framework ( radio interface regulations ( RIR ) ) will be defined . Use of mobile radio frequencies ECC Report 309 ECC Report 348 ECC Decision ( 22 ) 07 In principle , the use of mobile radio spectrum is limited to terrestrial applications . Investigations have been undertaken at European level to allow the operation of aerial user equipment ( UE ) either on board an unmanned aircraft ( e . g . , drones ) or on board a manned aircraft ( e . g . , helicopters ) , mainly for professional purposes . The results were published by the Electronic Communications Committee ( ECC ) in two reports : in ECC Report 309 and ECC Report 348 . The findings of the reports were used to develop the , which outlines the technical requirements for using aerial UE for communication based on Long Term Evolution ( LTE ) and 5G New Radio ( 5G NR ) in specific frequency bands for mobile / fixed communications networks ( MFCN ) . The decision still requires further studies and procedures for implementation at the national level . OFCOM is currently analysing and discussing the implications of implementing the ECC Decision ( 22 ) 07 in Switzerland . Until the decision is not implemented into the national framework ( namely NaFZ ) , the use of MFCN frequencies for aerial UE is not permitted in Switzerland . Nevertheless , a trial licence can be requested to OFCOM for trials with aerial UE at MFCN frequencies . Please be advised that there is no entitlement to the granting of such a licence . International bodies ECC - Groups - ECC - ECC PT1 - News ( cept . org ) ECC Project Team 1 - The Project Team is examining , among other things , the issues due to usage of aerial UE in border areas . As well as preparing a response to the European Commission Mandate regarding harmonised technical and operational conditions for the usage of non - active antenna systems with aerial terminal stations in harmonised MFCN bands . sentence2: Drones et mod\u00e8les r\u00e9duits d ' avion Les drones sont des appareils t\u00e9l\u00e9command\u00e9s , g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement de petite taille . L\u00e9galement , ils sont assimil\u00e9s \u00e0 des mod\u00e8les r\u00e9duits d ' avion et consid\u00e9r\u00e9s comme des installations de radiocommunication . Le nombre de drones exploit\u00e9s \u00e0 titre commercial et priv\u00e9 en Suisse est en constante augmentation . sentence1: OFCOM is committed to the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development On 25 September 2015 , the United Nations unanimously adopted the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development , which forms the global frame of reference for sustainable development until 2030 . Switzerland is committed to implementing the 2030 Agenda at both the national and international level . OFCOM ' s activities also help to achieve these objectives : Goal 5 : Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls National human resources strategy The Federal Administration supports women\u2019s participation in social , economic , political and public life at all decision - making levels . Being a major employer , it has a responsibility to serve as a role model . In its , the Federal Administration has established various targets to ensure that an adequate proportion of women hold middle and senior management positions . OFCOM ' s senior management team adopts annual diversity objectives and corresponding measures . An internal committee is responsible for implementation . In 2019 - 2020 , OFCOM focussed on \u2018gender\u2019 , \u2018multilingualism\u2019 , \u2018people with disabilities\u2019 and \u2018generations\u2019 . Among other things , the proportion of female employees is to be increased and more information about technical professions is to be provided to girls and women . In addition , current efforts to strike the right balance between \u2018family AND career\u2019 are to be continued . Equal opportunities for all ( admin . ch ) International https : / / equals - eu . org / OFCOM supports the activities of the UN and other international organisations aimed at stimulating young women ' s interest in professions relating to science , technology , engineering and mathematics ( STEM professions ) . It also promotes projects that take greater account of the perspectives and needs of women in the development of new technologies . This is the case , for example , within the framework of the EQUALS initiative ( ) . Goal 9 : Build resilient infrastructure , promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation National OFCOM establishes the general conditions for effective competition and ensures universal needs - based access to services . It does this so that the population and economic players have secure , modern communications infrastructures and a wide range of different , affordable and competitive telecommunications and postal services . In the telecommunications sector , OFCOM allocates radio frequencies and addresses resources , ensures interference - free radio traffic , regulates market access for telecommunications installations and electrical equipment and promotes the efficient use of frequencies as well as the implementation of technical innovations . It also works to reduce the digital divide between and within countries . Furthermore , in the area of global digital governance , it supports efforts at the international level to ensure that \u2018weaker\u2019 and smaller actors , in particular governments , business and civil society representatives from developing countries , can also identify and articulate their needs and concerns . sentence2: L ' OFCOM s ' engage en faveur de l ' Agenda 2030 pour un d\u00e9veloppement durable Le 25 septembre 2015 , les Nations Unies ont adopt\u00e9 \u00e0 l ' unanimit\u00e9 l ' Agenda 2030 pour un d\u00e9veloppement durable , qui forme le cadre de r\u00e9f\u00e9rence mondiale en mati\u00e8re de d\u00e9veloppement durable jusqu ' en 2030 . La Suisse s ' engage au niveau national et international pour la mise en \u0153uvre de l ' Agenda 2030 . Les activit\u00e9s de l ' OFCOM contribuent \u00e0 la r\u00e9alisation des objectifs suivants : Objectif 5 : Parvenir \u00e0 l ' \u00e9galit\u00e9 des sexes et autonomiser toutes les femmes et les filles National Strat\u00e9gie concernant le personnel La Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration encourage la participation des femmes \u00e0 tous les niveaux de d\u00e9cision de la vie sociale , \u00e9conomique , politique et publique . En tant que grand employeur , l ' administration publique a une fonction de mod\u00e8le . Dans sa , la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration a fix\u00e9 des valeurs de r\u00e9f\u00e9rence pour la repr\u00e9sentation des femmes aux postes de cadres moyens et sup\u00e9rieurs . La direction de l ' OFCOM approuve chaque ann\u00e9e des objectifs en mati\u00e8re de diversit\u00e9 et des mesures y relatives . Une commission interne est charg\u00e9e de la mise en \u0153uvre . En 2019 - 2020 , l ' OFCOM s ' est concentr\u00e9 sur les champs d ' action Genre , Multilinguisme , Personnes handicap\u00e9es et G\u00e9n\u00e9rations . Le but est notamment d ' augmenter la proportion des femmes dans le personnel , de rapprocher les filles et les femmes des m\u00e9tiers techniques ainsi que de renouveler le label \ Famille & Profession \ . \u00c9galit\u00e9 des chances pour tous ( admin . ch ) International https : / / equals - eu . org / L ' OFCOM soutient les activit\u00e9s de l ' ONU et d ' autres organisations internationales qui visent \u00e0 \u00e9veiller l ' int\u00e9r\u00eat des jeunes femmes pour les professions dans les domaines des math\u00e9matiques , de l ' informatique , des sciences naturelles et de la technique ( professions MINT ) . Il encourage \u00e9galement des projets qui prennent davantage en compte les points de vue et les besoins des femmes dans le d\u00e9veloppement de nouvelles technologies , par exemple dans le cadre de l ' initiative EQUALS ( ) Objectif 9 : B\u00e2tir une infrastructure r\u00e9siliente , promouvoir une industrialisation durable qui profite \u00e0 tous et encourager l ' innovation National L ' OFCOM garantit les conditions cadres pour assurer une concurrence efficace et un service universel adapt\u00e9 aux besoins , afin que la population et l ' \u00e9conomie disposent d ' infrastructures de communication s\u00fbres et modernes ainsi que de services postaux et de t\u00e9l\u00e9communication vari\u00e9s , avantageux et concurrentiels . Dans le domaine des t\u00e9l\u00e9communications , l ' OFCOM garantit l ' allocation en fr\u00e9quences et en ressources d ' adressage , assure des radiocommunications sans perturbations , r\u00e9glemente l ' acc\u00e8s au march\u00e9 des installations de t\u00e9l\u00e9communication et des appareils \u00e9lectriques et soutient une utilisation efficace des fr\u00e9quences ainsi que l ' impl\u00e9mentation d ' innovations techniques . Service universel en mati\u00e8re de t\u00e9l\u00e9communications ( admin . ch ) Service universel en mati\u00e8re de services de paiement ( admin . ch ) Num\u00e9rotation et t\u00e9l\u00e9phonie ( admin . ch ) Noms de domaine Internet ( admin . ch ) Service universel en mati\u00e8re de t\u00e9l\u00e9communications ( admin . ch ) Service universel en mati\u00e8re de services de paiement ( admin . ch ) Num\u00e9rotation et t\u00e9l\u00e9phonie ( admin . ch ) International L ' OFCOM encourage \u00e9galement au niveau international l\u2019acc\u00e8s aux technologies de l\u2019information et de la communication ainsi qu ' \u00e0 l ' internet , notamment en renfor\u00e7ant un cadre institutionnel et r\u00e9glementaire appropri\u00e9 et en d\u00e9veloppant les capacit\u00e9s et les comp\u00e9tences correspondantes via les organisations et processus internationaux bas\u00e9s \u00e0 Gen\u00e8ve . Il s ' engage en outre pour une r\u00e9duction de la fracture num\u00e9rique entre les pays industriels , \u00e9mergents et en d\u00e9veloppement . Par ailleurs , dans le domaine de la gouvernance num\u00e9rique mondiale , il soutient les efforts d\u00e9ploy\u00e9s au niveau international pour que les petits acteurs \ plus faibles \ , en particulier les gouvernements ainsi que les repr\u00e9sentants de l ' \u00e9conomie et de la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 civile des pays en d\u00e9veloppement , puissent \u00e9galement identifier et formuler leurs besoins et leurs pr\u00e9occupations . Cet engagement comprend notamment : Activit\u00e9s internationales ( admin . ch ) Une politique \u00e9trang\u00e8re coh\u00e9rente dans l\u2019espace num\u00e9rique ( admin . ch ) Activit\u00e9s internationales ( admin . ch ) Objectif 16 : Promouvoir l ' av\u00e8nement de soci\u00e9t\u00e9s pacifiques et ouvertes aux fins du d\u00e9veloppement durable National L ' OFCOM garantit les conditions cadres pour renforcer un syst\u00e8me des m\u00e9dias vari\u00e9 contribuant \u00e0 la formation d\u00e9mocratique de l ' opinion et de la volont\u00e9 . Ce faisant , il tient compte des habitudes d ' utilisation en constante \u00e9volution des personnes en Suisse ainsi que des processus de transformation techniques et \u00e9conomiques . L ' OFCOM met en place les conditions n\u00e9cessaires \u00e0 un service public identitaire au niveau national , r\u00e9gional linguistique et r\u00e9gional dans le domaine des m\u00e9dias \u00e9lectroniques et cr\u00e9e les bases d ' une aide aux m\u00e9dias moderne . sentence1: Press releases 30 . 04 . 2025 Support for the media : Federal Council welcomes measures that can be implemented quickly Independent and diversified media play a key role in a democratic society . The Federal Council therefore welcomes the targeted increase in support for electronic media as proposed by the Council of States Transport and Telecommunications Committee . At its meeting on 30 April , the Federal Council adopted its opinion on the committee report in which it requests Parliament to approve the Committee ' s draft bill . 16 . 04 . 2025 Consultation on the partial revision of the Postal Services Ordinance In future , Swiss Post is to be given more flexibility in the home delivery of letters , parcels and daily newspapers . Universal service should also take greater account of the high level of digitalisation among the public and businesses and so be expanded to include digital offerings . The Federal Council put a corresponding revision of the Postal Services Ordinance out to consultation on 16 April 2025 . 04 . 04 . 2025 DETEC awards TV licence in Biel / Bienne to Canal B On 3 April 2025 , the Federal Department of the Environment , Transport , Energy and Communications ( DETEC ) has again awarded the licence for regional television in the Biel / Bienne coverage area to Canal B . 26 . 03 . 2025 Switzerland signs Council of Europe Convention on Artificial Intelligence On 27 March Federal Councillor Albert R\u00f6sti will sign the Council of Europe Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights , Democracy and the Rule of Law in Strasbourg on Switzerland\u2019s behalf . By signing the agreement , Switzerland is reaffirming its commitment to the responsible use of AI technologies in accordance with fundamental rights . 14 . 03 . 2025 Consultation launched on programme to expand high - speed internet throughout Switzerland The Federal Council\u2019s gigabit strategy aims to provide access to high - speed internet throughout Switzerland . A temporary funding programme will drive forward the expansion of broadband via fibre optic and wireless infrastructure . At its meeting on 14 March 2025 , the Federal Council opened the consultation on the new Broadband Promotion Act . 17 . 02 . 2025 Publication of report on EU data policy monitoring The digital policy activities of the EU ( European Union ) can also impact Switzerland under certain circumstances . Swiss companies nevertheless do not face significant risks regarding the EU\u2019s access to the single market at this time , according to a report published by the Federal Administration on 17 February 2025 analysing the impact of EU digital policy on Switzerland . 12 . 02 . 2025 AI regulation : Federal Council to ratify Council of Europe Convention Switzerland intends to ratify the Council of Europe Convention on Artificial Intelligence ( AI ) and to make the necessary amendments to Swiss law . Work will also continue on the regulation of AI in specific sectors such as healthcare and transport . The Federal Council spoke out in favour of this approach at its meeting on 12 February . 11 . 02 . 2025 Federal Councillor Albert R\u00f6sti at the Artificial Intelligence Action Summit in Paris At the Artificial Intelligence Action Summit in Paris on 10 and 11 February , Federal Councillor Albert R\u00f6sti highlighted the opportunities that AI offers to society and the economy . In particular , he stressed the need to adopt an inclusive approach in the global debate on AI . Switzerland has also expressed an interest in hosting the next AI Action Summit . He also signed two memorandums of understanding with French Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot aimed at developing cross - border rail traffic between Switzerland and France . 29 . 01 . 2025 Negotiating mandate for recognition of electronic signatures Electronic signatures on documents should be recognised in Switzerland and in the European Union ( EU ) . At its meeting on 29 January 2025 , the Federal Council instructed the Federal Department of the Environment , Transport , Energy and Communications ( DETEC ) to draw up a corresponding mandate for negotiating with the EU , in collaboration with the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs ( FDFA ) . 15 . 01 . 2025 Swiss data ecosystem : Contact point becomes operational At its meeting on 15 January , the Federal Council was informed that the Swiss data ecosystem contact point has commenced work . The contact point supports public authorities , businesses and organisations in establishing trusted data spaces . Its groundwork contributes to better exploiting the potential of data in Switzerland , thus creating additional value for society , the economy and research . 06 . 01 . 2025 Network security and cybersecurity : OFCOM strengthens its commitment Since 1 January 2025 , the Federal Office of Communications ( OFCOM ) has two units specialising in cybersecurity and the security of telecommunications networks . The Market Access and Cybersecurity Section ( MC ) is responsible in particular for verifying that radiocommunications equipment complies with privacy and personal data protection requirements . The aim of the Networks and Services Security Section ( SND ) is to maintain and improve the security and availability of telecommunications networks and services . 13 . 12 . 2024 Increase in delivery discounts for newspapers and magazines in 2025 In 2025 , local and regional daily and weekly publications benefitting from indirect support for print media will receive a discount of 28 centimes per copy distributed by Swiss Post , 3 centimes more than in 2024 . Titles published by associations and foundations will benefit from a support of 22 centimes per copy , an increase of 2 centimes compared to this year . The Federal Council set these amounts at its meeting on 13 December 2024 . 26 . 09 . 2024 Matthias H\u00fcrlimann appointed head of OFCOM ' s Telecom Services and Post Division Federal Councillor Albert R\u00f6sti has appointed Matthias H\u00fcrlimann as vice - director of the Federal Office of Communications and head of the Telecom Services and Post Division . The 51 - year - old lawyer will take up his new position on 1 November 2024 . 20 . 09 . 2024 World Radiocommunication Conference : Ratification of the Final Acts At its meeting on 20 September 2024 , the Federal Council ratified the Final Acts of the World Radiocommunication Conference 2023 ( WRC - 23 ) . This lays down the formal framework for the future use of frequencies in Switzerland . It guarantees that the information and communication sector will have access to the frequencies it needs at national level . The country ' s military security interests are also protected . 16 . 09 . 2024 SERAFE AG to remain the collection agency for the radio and television fee SERAFE AG will continue to collect the household radio and television fee for the federal government after 2025 . On 14 September 2024 , the Federal Department of the Environment , Transport , Energy and Communications ( DETEC ) awarded SERAFE AG the mandate for the period 2026 to 2034 following an open tender process . Their bid offered the best price - performance ratio . 11 . 09 . 2024 Digital Switzerland advisory committee : Exchange on the regulation of artificial intelligence At the Digital Switzerland advisory board meeting on 11 September 2024 , participants discussed possible approaches to regulating artificial intelligence ( AI ) . They agreed that the opportunities offered by AI should be exploited while seeking to minimise the risks for society . Federal Councillor Albert R\u00f6sti chaired the meeting , which was also attended by Federal Chancellor Viktor Rossi . 04 . 09 . 2024 Indirect support for print media : Federal Council rejects fixed - term increase in contributions At its meeting on 4 September 2024 , the Federal Council adopted its opinion on the report of the National Council Transport and Telecommunications Committee ( TTC - N ) on the parliamentary initiative aimed at increasing indirect financial support to assure an independent press ( 22 . 423 ) . Out of media policy and financial policy considerations , it is requesting Parliament not to approve the introduction of the committee ' s proposal . Should Parliament nevertheless approve the introduction of the bill , the Federal Council proposes a smaller increase in press subsidies and a subsequent return to the current level . 09 . 07 . 2024 Preparation for the next award of mobile telephony licences The Federal Communications Commission ( ComCom ) has instructed the Federal Office of Communications ( OFCOM ) to prepare for awarding the mobile radio frequencies that will become available in 2029 . In the interests of competition and transparency , ComCom is planning a public tender for these frequencies , probably in 2026 . Frequency bands will be allocated by means of an auction if there is a shortage of frequencies . 19 . 06 . 2024 Federal Council rejects SRG SSR initiative and proposes reducing fee to CHF 300 instead SRG SSR requires sufficient financial resources to be able to provide equivalent journalistic services in all language regions . The Federal Council therefore rejects the federal popular initiative ' 200 francs is enough ! ( SRG SSR Initiative ) ' . It approved the dispatch on this issue on 19 June 2024 . However , the Federal Council wants to ease the financial burden on households and businesses . It has therefore decided to gradually reduce the radio and television licence fee for households to CHF 300 per year by 2029 . The Federal Council will not grant SRG SSR a new licence until the vote on the SRG SSR initiative has been held . It is therefore extending the current SRG SSR licence until the end of 2028 . 14 . 06 . 2024 Postal service : Modernisation and financial stabilisation of universal services Universal postal and payment transaction services are to be expanded to include digital offerings and placed on a financially viable footing . At its meeting on 14 June 2024 , the Federal Council defined the outlines of a draft consultation on the revision of the Postal Services Ordinance . Specialist staff

L\u2019OCI est charg\u00e9 d\u2019assurer la l\u00e9galit\u00e9 et la proportionnalit\u00e9 des activit\u00e9s de renseignement li\u00e9es \u00e0 l\u2019exploration radio et \u00e0 l\u2019exploration du r\u00e9seau c\u00e2bl\u00e9 . 16 . 04 . 2025 Consultation sur la r\u00e9vision partielle de l ' ordonnance sur la poste La Poste doit disposer d ' une plus grande flexibilit\u00e9 pour la distribution \u00e0 domicile des lettres , des colis et des quotidiens . Le service universel doit aussi davantage tenir compte du degr\u00e9 \u00e9lev\u00e9 de num\u00e9risation dans la population et les entreprises et \u00eatre \u00e9tendu aux offres num\u00e9riques . Actuellement , il n ' existe pas de risques majeurs quant \u00e0 l ' acc\u00e8s au march\u00e9 int\u00e9rieur europ\u00e9en pour les entreprises suisses . Il faut en outre poursuivre les activit\u00e9s de r\u00e9glementation de l ' IA dans diff\u00e9rents secteurs , tels que la sant\u00e9 ou les transports . Il a notamment insist\u00e9 sur la n\u00e9cessit\u00e9 d\u2019adopter une approche inclusive dans le d\u00e9bat mondial sur l\u2019IA . La Suisse a \u00e9galement fait part de son int\u00e9r\u00eat \u00e0 accueillir le Sommet pour l\u2019action sur l\u2019IA . De plus , il a sign\u00e9 deux d\u00e9clarations d\u2019intention avec le Ministre fran\u00e7ais charg\u00e9 des Transports Philippe Tabarot , l\u2019objectif \u00e9tant de d\u00e9velopper le trafic ferroviaire transfrontalier entre la Suisse et la France . 07 . 02 . 2025 Le conseiller f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Albert R\u00f6sti au Sommet pour l\u2019action sur l\u2019intelligence artificielle \u00e0 Paris Les 10 et 11 f\u00e9vrier 2025 , le conseiller f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Albert R\u00f6sti participera au Sommet pour l\u2019action sur l\u2019intelligence artificielle ( IA ) \u00e0 Paris . Par sa participation , le conseiller f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Albert R\u00f6sti souligne l\u2019engagement de la Suisse en faveur d\u2019une gouvernance de l\u2019IA qui r\u00e9ponde aux besoins et aux attentes des citoyens et de l\u2019industrie . \u00c0 cette occasion , il verra le Pr\u00e9sident de la R\u00e9publique fran\u00e7aise Emmanuel Macron et rencontrera le Ministre fran\u00e7ais charg\u00e9 des Transports , Philippe Tabarot . 29 . 01 . 2025 Mandat de n\u00e9gociation pour la reconnaissance des signatures \u00e9lectroniques Une signature \u00e9lectronique sur un document devrait \u00eatre reconnue aussi bien en Suisse que dans l ' Union europ\u00e9enne ( UE ) . Dans sa s\u00e9ance du 29 janvier 2025 , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a charg\u00e9 le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' environnement , des transports , de l ' \u00e9nergie et de la communication DETEC d ' \u00e9laborer un mandat de n\u00e9gociation avec l ' UE , en collaboration avec le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral des affaires \u00e9trang\u00e8res DFAE . 15 . 01 . 2025 \u00c9cosyst\u00e8me de donn\u00e9es suisse : le point de contact est op\u00e9rationnel Lors de sa s\u00e9ance du 15 janvier 2025 , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a \u00e9t\u00e9 inform\u00e9 que le point de contact pour l\u2019\u00e9cosyst\u00e8me de donn\u00e9es suisse est d\u00e9sormais op\u00e9rationnel . La section \ Acc\u00e8s au march\u00e9 et cybers\u00e9curit\u00e9 \ ( MC ) se charge notamment de v\u00e9rifier que les \u00e9quipements de radiocommunication respectent les exigences en mati\u00e8re de protection de la vie priv\u00e9e et des donn\u00e9es personnelles . Quant \u00e0 la section \ S\u00e9curit\u00e9 r\u00e9seaux et services \ ( SND ) , elle vise \u00e0 maintenir et renforcer la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 et la disponibilit\u00e9 des r\u00e9seaux et services de t\u00e9l\u00e9communications . 13 . 12 . 2024 Hausse du rabais pour la distribution des journaux et p\u00e9riodiques en 2025 En 2025 , les quotidiens et hebdomadaires de la presse locale et r\u00e9gionale soutenus par l ' aide indirecte \u00e0 la presse b\u00e9n\u00e9ficieront d ' un rabais de 28 centimes pour chaque exemplaire distribu\u00e9 par la Poste , soit 3 centimes de plus qu\u2019en 2024 . Les titres de la presse associative et des fondations profiteront d\u2019un soutien de 22 centimes par exemplaire , soit une hausse de 2 centimes par rapport \u00e0 cette ann\u00e9e . Cet avocat de 51 ans prendra ses nouvelles fonctions le 1er novembre 2024 . 20 . 09 . 2024 Conf\u00e9rence mondiale des radiocommunications : ratification des Actes finals Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a ratifi\u00e9 , lors de sa s\u00e9ance du 20 septembre 2024 , les Actes finals de la Conf\u00e9rence mondiale des radiocommunications 2023 . Le cadre formel pour l ' utilisation future des fr\u00e9quences en Suisse est ainsi pos\u00e9 . Les int\u00e9r\u00eats du pays en mati\u00e8re de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 militaire sont aussi pr\u00e9serv\u00e9s . 16 . 09 . 2024 SERAFE AG reste l ' organe de perception de la redevance de radio - t\u00e9l\u00e9vision SERAFE AG continuera \u00e0 percevoir la redevance de radio - t\u00e9l\u00e9vision aupr\u00e8s des m\u00e9nages pour la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration apr\u00e8s 2025 . Le 14 septembre 2024 , dans le cadre d\u2019une proc\u00e9dure d\u2019appel d\u2019offres public , le D\u00e9partement f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de l ' environnement , des transports , de l ' \u00e9nergie et de la communication ( DETEC ) a octroy\u00e9 \u00e0 SERAFE AG le mandat pour la p\u00e9riode 2026 - 2034 . Son offre pr\u00e9sentait le meilleur rapport qualit\u00e9 - prix . 11 . 09 . 2024 Comit\u00e9 consultatif Suisse num\u00e9rique : \u00e9change sur la r\u00e9glementation de l ' intelligence artificielle Lors de la r\u00e9union du comit\u00e9 consultatif Suisse num\u00e9rique le 11 septembre 2024 , les participants et participants ont discut\u00e9 des approches possibles concernant la r\u00e9glementation de l ' intelligence artificielle ( IA ) . Le conseiller f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Albert R\u00f6sti a conduit cette r\u00e9union , \u00e0 laquelle participait aussi le chancelier de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , Viktor Rossi . 04 . 09 . 2024 Aide indirecte \u00e0 la presse : le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral rejette une extension temporaire Dans sa s\u00e9ance du 4 septembre 2024 , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a adopt\u00e9 son avis sur le rapport de la Commission des transports et des t\u00e9l\u00e9communications du Conseil national ( CTT - N ) relatif \u00e0 l\u2019initiative parlementaire \ Pour une presse \u00e9crite ind\u00e9pendante , il faut adapter les montants de l\u2019aide indirecte \ ( 22 . 423 ) . Pour des raisons de politique des m\u00e9dias et de politique financi\u00e8re , il demande au Parlement de ne pas entrer en mati\u00e8re sur le projet de la commission . Au cas o\u00f9 le Parlement d\u00e9cide toutefois d\u2019entrer en mati\u00e8re , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral propose d\u2019augmenter l\u2019aide \u00e0 la presse dans une moindre mesure , puis de la ramener ensuite \u00e0 son niveau actuel . sentence1: In general General information and news in the field of telecommunications equipment . New economic operators in e - commerce From mid - July 2021 on , any online retailer wishing to sell radio equipment or electrical appliances to customers in Switzerland must have an intermediary located in Switzerland . Also , online marketplaces or platforms will be required to cooperate with OFCOM in relation to market surveillance . Please do not disturb Internet and stores abroad are full of interesting offers for wireless devices ( drones , remote controlled toys , telephones , . . . ) . All are using frequencies to communicate with each other or with their base . If they operate on frequencies which are not assigned to them , they can cause disturbances . Before a purchase , watch OFCOM ' s video , you will find the points you should keep in mind . Users of radiocommunications equipment better informed If you place radiocommunications equipment which does not use frequencies harmonised at the European level on the market , you must ensure that the user has the necessary information on the conditions of use . From 9 August , 2018 , manufacturers must specify on the packaging the countries for which a restriction on use exists . The nature of the restriction must be included in the instructions . Warning , interfering DECT equipment on the rise ! Interference on UMTS mobile telephone networks ( Universal Mobile Telecommunications System ) has been increasing over recent months . Such interference is generated by DECT cordless phones ( Digital Enhanced Cordless Telecommunications ) purchased outside Europe \u2013 for example in the US , South America , Canada or Asia \u2013 or on the internet . OFCOM has not excluded the possibility of billing those responsible for importing and operating such cordless phones for the cost of identifying and rectifying the source of interference . Beware of non - compliant remote controlled toys Cars , robots , helicopters or even animals : numerous remote controlled toys are available on the Swiss market . Unfortunately , frequently their wireless remote control does not comply with the requirements . OFCOM , which is responsible for market surveillance , has taken binding measures against market players , but also wishes to make purchasers and users of such toys more aware of this . Specialist staff Last modification 01 . 06 . 2021
sentence2: G\u00e9n\u00e9ralit\u00e9s Informations g\u00e9n\u00e9rales et actualit\u00e9s dans le domaine des installations de t\u00e9l\u00e9communication . Nouveaux acteurs \u00e9conomiques dans le domaine du eCommerce Si un site internet \u00e9tranger veut vendre une installation de radiocommunication ou un appareil \u00e9lectrique \u00e0 un client en Suisse , il devra d\u00e8s mi - juillet 2021 disposer d ' un interm\u00e9diaire dans notre pays . De plus les plateformes de vente en ligne devront collaborer avec l ' OFCOM dans le cadre de la surveillance de march\u00e9 . Des services d ' appel d ' urgence plus performants A partir de 17 mars 2022 , la localisation d\u2019un appel d\u2019urgence \u00e0 partir d\u2019un smartphone sera plus pr\u00e9cise . En \u00e9tablissant l\u2019appel d\u2019urgence , le smartphone transmettra automatiquement sa position . En effet , personne n\u2019est \u00e0 l\u2019abri de se retrouver un jour victime d\u2019un accident , d\u2019une agression ou dans toute autre mauvaise situation . Dans ces cas , il est imp\u00e9ratif que les secours puissent intervenir le plus rapidement possible et , pour cela , il est n\u00e9cessaire qu\u2019ils sachent avec pr\u00e9cision \u00e0 quel endroit se rendre . Ne pas perturber L ' internet et les magasins \u00e0 l ' \u00e9tranger regorgent d ' offres all\u00e9chantes pour des appareils sans fil ( drones , jouets t\u00e9l\u00e9command\u00e9s , t\u00e9l\u00e9phones , \u2026 ) . Tous utilisent des fr\u00e9quences pour communiquer entre eux ou avec leur base . S ' ils exploitent des fr\u00e9quences qui ne leur sont pas attribu\u00e9es , ils peuvent provoquer des perturbations . Avant un achat , regardez la vid\u00e9o de l ' OFCOM , vous y trouverez les points auxquels il faut faire attention . Les utilisateurs d ' appareils de radiocommunication mieux inform\u00e9s Si vous mettez sur le march\u00e9 un appareil de radiocommunication qui n ' utilise pas des fr\u00e9quences harmonis\u00e9es au niveau europ\u00e9en , vous devez veiller \u00e0 ce que l ' utilisateur dispose des informations n\u00e9cessaires sur les conditions d ' utilisation . D\u00e8s le 9 ao\u00fbt 2018 , les fabricants doivent pr\u00e9ciser sur l ' emballage dans les pays pour lesquels il existe une restriction d ' utilisation . La nature de la restriction doit \u00eatre pr\u00e9sente dans le mode d ' emploi . Attention , un DECT peut en cacher un autre ! Les perturbations des r\u00e9seaux de t\u00e9l\u00e9phonie mobile UMTS ( Universal Mobile Telecommunications System ) sont en constante augmentation depuis quelques mois . Elles sont provoqu\u00e9es par des t\u00e9l\u00e9phones sans fil DECT ( Digital Enhanced Cordless Telecommunications ) achet\u00e9s hors Europe , par exemple aux Etats - Unis , en Am\u00e9rique du sud , au Canada ainsi qu ' en Asie ou par l ' internet . L ' OFCOM n ' exclut pas de faire payer les co\u00fbts de recherche et de suppression des perturbations aux personnes qui ont import\u00e9 et utilis\u00e9 ces t\u00e9l\u00e9phones sans fil . Attention aux jouets t\u00e9l\u00e9command\u00e9s non conformes Voitures , robots , h\u00e9licopt\u00e8res ou m\u00eame animaux : de nombreux jouets t\u00e9l\u00e9command\u00e9s sont disponibles sur le march\u00e9 suisse . Malheureusement , souvent leur t\u00e9l\u00e9commande sans fil n ' est pas conforme aux exigences . L ' OFCOM , charg\u00e9 de surveiller le march\u00e9 , a pris des mesures contraignantes \u00e0 l ' encontre des acteurs du march\u00e9 , mais souhaite aussi sensibiliser les acqu\u00e9reurs et utilisateurs de tels jouets . Contact sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9 Derni\u00e8re modification 01 . 06 . 2021

sentence1: Surveillance and Checks Radio frequency spectrum is a limited natural resource . OFCOM ensures that users have access to this asset without any interference . Electrical devices and telecommunications equipment can have an unwanted impact on the frequency spectrum and impair communication . A radio can transmit on frequencies that are allocated to security services , for example , or a licensee might be using more equipment than they have reported , which can increase radio traffic considerably . In order to prevent these or other types of interferences , regulations are in place regarding the authorisation to install and operate radio equipment and radio networks for mobile terrestrial radio , maritime radio , aeronautical radio and amateur radio . OFCOM grants licences , call signs and permits that regulate frequencies and other parameters such as the number of devices , transmitted power and bandwidth occupied . Programmable radio equipment must only be programmed to the frequencies described in the licence . Any changes must be communicated to OFCOM . OFCOM exercises surveillance over the frequency spectrum and radiocommunications licences . It conducts spot checks every year , which examine whether : Art . 52 TCA The frequency spectrum can be used freely in compliance with the law . However , offences against the Telecommunications Act are punishable by a fine ( see ) . A product check may be carried out if there is a suspicion that non - compliant radio equipment is being used . Further information Frequency use with or without licences National Frequency Allocation Plan Disturbances Non - compliant equipment Legal framework Telecommunications Act ( TCA ) Ordinance on Telecommunications Installations ( FAV ) Ordinance on the Use of the Radio Frequency Spectrum ( RFSO ) Specialist staff Last modification 18 . 09 . 2023
sentence2: Surveillance & contr\u00f4les Le spectre des fr\u00e9quences est un bien naturel rare . L ' OFCOM assure aux utilisateurs un acc\u00e8s sans perturbations \u00e0 ce bien . Des appareils \u00e9lectriques et des installations de t\u00e9l\u00e9communication peuvent avoir des effets ind\u00e9sirables sur le spectre des fr\u00e9quences et emp\u00eacher la communication . Un appareil radio peut par exemple \u00e9mettre sur des fr\u00e9quences r\u00e9serv\u00e9es aux services de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 , ou alors un concessionnaire utilise un nombre sup\u00e9rieur d ' appareils autoris\u00e9 par sa concession , et de ce fait , surcharge le trafic radio . Afin d ' \u00e9viter ce genre et d ' autres types de perturbations , l ' autorisation pour la mise en service et l ' exploitation d ' installations et de r\u00e9seaux de radiocommunication dans le domaine de la radiocommunication terrestre , maritime , a\u00e9rienne ou amateur est r\u00e9glement\u00e9e . L ' OFCOM octroie des concessions , des indicatifs d ' appel et des autorisations , dans lesquels sont fix\u00e9es les fr\u00e9quences , ainsi que d ' autres param\u00e8tres comme le nombre d ' installations , la puissance d ' \u00e9mission et la largeur de bande occup\u00e9e . Les installations de radiocommunication programmables ne doivent l ' \u00eatre qu ' avec les fr\u00e9quences d\u00e9crites dans la concession . Toute modification doit \u00eatre annonc\u00e9e \u00e0 l ' OFCOM . L ' OFCOM est charg\u00e9 de la surveillance du spectre des fr\u00e9quences et des concessions de radiocommunication . Il r\u00e9alise chaque ann\u00e9e des contr\u00f4les ponctuels , o\u00f9 il v\u00e9rifie si : art . 52 LTC Dans le respect des bases l\u00e9gales , le spectre des fr\u00e9quences peut \u00eatre utilis\u00e9 librement . Les infractions \u00e0 la loi sur les t\u00e9l\u00e9communications sont toutefois punies d ' une amende ( voir ) . En cas de suspicion d ' utilisation d ' installations de radiocommunication non conformes , un contr\u00f4le de produit peut \u00eatre effectu\u00e9 . sentence1: International activities Globalisation has long been a reality in telecommunications and the electronic media . This is why OFCOM is pursuing major activities abroad : it is active in more than twenty international institutions or organisations and more than a hundred groups of experts . These international bodies and working groups operate in the areas for which OFCOM is responsible \u2013 telecommunications , the audiovisual sector , frequency management , standardisation and the placing of new technologies on the market . OFCOM represents Switzerland and assumes the role of ambassador and defender of national interests . It promotes an exchange of experience with its international partners and ensures respect for the specific political and legal features of the Swiss federal system . Several of these organisations have a global dimension and , like the ITU for example , are integrated in the UN system . Others have a European or continental vocation : this is the case of the European Union , the CEPT or the ETSI . Finally , others cover more specific activities and forms of cooperation , such as the OECD , TV5 or FRATEL . The contacts made at the multilateral level are complemented by regular bilateral consultations , notably with each of Switzerland ' s five neighbouring countries . This strong international involvement is not only useful for the orientations adopted by national policy and regulations , it also promotes the search for constructive solutions , especially when negotiations take place . OFCOM also acts regularly in coordination with the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs ( FDFA ) and other offices or departments . Further information FDFA : Federal Department of Foreign Affairs Specialist staff
sentence2: Activit\u00e9s internationales La globalisation est depuis longtemps une r\u00e9alit\u00e9 des t\u00e9l\u00e9communications et des m\u00e9dias \u00e9lectroniques . C ' est pourquoi l ' OFCOM d\u00e9veloppe une importante activit\u00e9 \u00e0 l ' \u00e9tranger : il est actif dans plus de vingt institutions ou organisations internationales et plus d ' une centaine de groupes d ' experts . Ces organismes et groupes de travail internationaux op\u00e8rent dans les domaines de comp\u00e9tence de l ' OFCOM , soit les t\u00e9l\u00e9communications , l ' audiovisuel , la gestion des fr\u00e9quences , la normalisation et la mise sur le march\u00e9 de nouvelles technologies . L ' OFCOM y repr\u00e9sente la Suisse , endossant un r\u00f4le d ' ambassadeur et de d\u00e9fenseur des int\u00e9r\u00eats nationaux . Il favorise l ' \u00e9change d ' exp\u00e9rience avec ses partenaires internationaux et fait valoir les sp\u00e9cificit\u00e9s politiques et juridiques propres au syst\u00e8me f\u00e9d\u00e9ral helv\u00e9tique . Plusieurs de ces organisations ont une dimension mondiale et s ' int\u00e8grent , comme l ' UIT par exemple , dans le syst\u00e8me onusien . D ' autres ont une vocation europ\u00e9enne ou continentale : c ' est le cas de l ' Union europ\u00e9enne , de la CEPT ou d ' ETSI . Certaines enfin couvrent des activit\u00e9s et des coop\u00e9rations plus sp\u00e9cifiques , comme l ' OCDE , TV5 ou FRATEL . Aux contacts nou\u00e9s au plan multilat\u00e9ral s ' ajoutent des consultations bilat\u00e9rales r\u00e9guli\u00e8res , notamment avec chacun des cinq pays voisins de la Suisse . Cette forte implication internationale est non seulement utile \u00e0 l ' orientation de la politique et de la r\u00e9glementation nationales , mais elle favorise aussi la recherche de solutions constructives , en particulier lorsque des n\u00e9gociations sont engag\u00e9es . L ' OFCOM agit d ' ailleurs r\u00e9guli\u00e8rement en coordination avec le DFAE et d ' autres offices ou d\u00e9partements . sentence1: European Qualifications Framework for Lifelong Learning The European Qualifications Framework ( EQF ) is the basis for Switzerland\u2019s own National Qualifications Framework for Vocational and Professional Qualifications ( NQF VPQ ) as well as for national qualification frameworks in other European countries . It serves as a frame of reference for all European countries and makes it possible to compare qualifications within Europe . Recommendation of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 April 2008 on the establishment of the European Qualifications Framework for lifelong learning The EQF - LLL was developed by the European Union . It is based on the . EQF - LLL website The EQF - LLL is comprised of eight reference levels . Each of these eight levels is defined by a set of descriptors indicating the learning outcomes for qualifications at the given level in any system of qualifications . Learning outcomes are defined in terms of \u2018Knowledge\u2019 , \u2018Skills\u2019 and \u2018Competence\u2019 . The latter is understood as the ability to take responsibility and to work independently . Many European countries have used the EQF - LLL as the basis for development of their own NQFs . An up - to - date overview can be found on the . In order to enable comparison of qualifications referenced to different NQFs ( i . e . because not all NQFs have the same number of reference levels ) , each NQF is referenced to the EQF - LLL . Here , European countries use pre - established criteria to determine which NQF reference level corresponds to which EQF reference level . This mapping of national qualification frameworks to the European one is facilitated by a document referred to as an EQF referencing report , which is presented to the EU\u2019s EQF Advisory Group . Switzerland successfully completed the process of referencing its NQF VPQ to the EQF - LLL when it presented its EQF Referencing Report in 2015 . The eight levels of the NQF VPQ are perfectly aligned with all eight levels of the EQF - LLL . Therefore , the NQF VPQ reference level indicated in each certificate supplement for upper - secondary level vocational qualifications and each diploma supplement for tertiary - level professional qualifications matches to the corresponding level in the EQF - LLL . sentence2: Cadre europ\u00e9en des certifications Le cadre europ\u00e9en des certifications ( CEC ) sert de base au cadre national des certifications ( CNC ) de la Suisse et aux CNC des autres \u00c9tats europ\u00e9ens . Il constitue l\u2019instrument de r\u00e9f\u00e9rence pour l\u2019ensemble des pays europ\u00e9ens et rend comparables les dipl\u00f4mes \u00e0 l\u2019int\u00e9rieur de l\u2019Europe . recommandation du Parlement europ\u00e9en et du Conseil du 23 avril 2008 relative \u00e0 l\u2019apprentissage tout au long de la vie Le CEC a \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9labor\u00e9 par l\u2019UE . Il se fonde sur la . portail EQF Le CEC comprend huit niveaux . Les acquis de l\u2019\u00e9ducation et de la formation sont d\u00e9crits selon trois cat\u00e9gories : le savoir , les aptitudes et les comp\u00e9tences . Celles - ci se con\u00e7oivent en termes de prise de responsabilit\u00e9s et d\u2019autonomie . De nombreux \u00c9tats europ\u00e9ens ont \u00e9labor\u00e9 des cadres nationaux des certifications \u00e0 partir du CEC . Le ( European Qualifications Framework ) ( en anglais ) fournit une vue d\u2019ensemble des cadres nationaux des certifications . Les CNC , qui ne comprennent par exemple pas tous le m\u00eame nombre de niveaux , sont attribu\u00e9s au CEC afin d\u2019assurer leur comparabilit\u00e9 . \u00c0 cette fin , chaque pays europ\u00e9en d\u00e9finit sur la base de crit\u00e8res pr\u00e9d\u00e9finis quels niveaux de son CNC correspondent au CEC . Cette harmonisation s\u2019effectue sur la base d\u2019un rapport de r\u00e9f\u00e9rencement au CEC , lequel doit \u00eatre soumis au groupe d\u2019experts de l\u2019UE ( EQF Advisory Group ) . Le rapport de r\u00e9f\u00e9rencement au CEC a \u00e9t\u00e9 pr\u00e9sent\u00e9 par la Suisse en 2015 et le r\u00e9f\u00e9rencement des dipl\u00f4mes du CNC formation professionnelle a \u00e9t\u00e9 men\u00e9 \u00e0 bien sur cette base . Les huit niveaux de ce CNC ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9f\u00e9renc\u00e9s int\u00e9gralement par rapport \u00e0 ceux du CEC . De ce fait , le niveau du CNC formation professionnelle et celui du CEC sont mentionn\u00e9s dans les suppl\u00e9ments descriptifs des certificats et les suppl\u00e9ments aux dipl\u00f4mes .
