sentence1: Space Science Since the 1960s , space research discoveries have considerably broadened our understanding of the universe . Through the achievements of ESA ' s scientific programme , Europe now plays a major role in infrared astronomy , x - ray astronomy and astrometry as well as in solar system research and observation of the Sun . In its long - term programme Cosmic Vision 2030 , ESA established an objective of maintaining , or even strengthening , Europe ' s key role in space research . Swiss contributions to ESA science missions The Swiss scientific community is deeply involved in the definition of ESA\u2019s science programme . Working with Swiss industry , Swiss scientists contribute significantly to the design and development of complex payloads for major space research missions . Such space projects not only push the envelope of physics and astronomy , but also inspire the next generation of scientists and engineers . INTEGRAL Science Data Centre World Radiation Center International Space Science Institute The missions in the ESA science programmes are selected based on scientific excellence . While the spacecraft development and operations as well as the launch services are funded by ESA , the scientific payloads ( instruments ) are typically under the responsibility of the ESA Member States . Researchers from Switzerland have contributed to and led many instruments , starting from the Giotto mission in the 1980s to missions like Rosetta , BepiColombo , or Solar Orbiter . One example is the BepiColombo Laser Altimeter BELA , which will investigate the global Topology of the planet Mercury . Switzerland is also well represented in future missions such as JUICE , Euclid or Comet Interceptor . Important infrastructure such as the INTEGRAL Science Data Centre ( ISDC ) and the University of Geneva or the World Radiation Center at the Physikalsich - meteorlogisches Observatorium Davos ( PMOD ) are also located in Switzerland . The in Bern also plays a central role at the international level in the area of data analysis and the definition of new missions . Internationally competitive , Swiss industry holds a solid position in the technologies required in numerous projects to develop science satellites and space probes , ensuring a strong position of Switzerland in such projects . With CHEOPS Switzerland is for the first time in the driver seat for a space based science mission . The mission was launched in December 2019 and has recently started its scientific operations , which are planned for 3 . 5 years . Swiss Committee on Space Research Swiss Academy of Sciences A complete overview of over 60 Swiss space research activities can be found in the publications of the Swiss Committee on Space Research ( CSR ) and the ( SCNAT ) . sentence2: Sciences spatiales Les d\u00e9couvertes de la recherche spatiale n\u2019ont cess\u00e9 d\u2019\u00e9largir notre compr\u00e9hension de l\u2019univers depuis les ann\u00e9es 1960 . Les r\u00e9alisations du programme scientifique de l\u2019Agence spatiale europ\u00e9enne ( ESA ) permettent \u00e0 l\u2019Europe de jouer un r\u00f4le majeur dans l\u2019astronomie infrarouge , l\u2019astronomie des rayons X et l\u2019astrom\u00e9trie , mais aussi dans la recherche sur le syst\u00e8me solaire et l\u2019observation du Soleil . Dans son programme de long terme intitul\u00e9 Cosmic Vision 2030 , l\u2019ESA s\u2019est fix\u00e9 pour objectif de maintenir , voire de renforcer la position cl\u00e9 de l\u2019Europe dans le domaine de la recherche spatiale . Contributions suisses aux missions scientifiques de l ' ESA La communaut\u00e9 scientifique suisse prend activement part \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9laboration du programme scientifique de l\u2019ESA . En collaboration avec l\u2019industrie suisse , les scientifiques suisses contribuent de mani\u00e8re d\u00e9cisive \u00e0 la conception et au d\u00e9veloppement de charges utiles complexes dans les grandes missions de recherche spatiale . Ces projets repoussent les limites des connaissances en physique et en astronomie , mais sont aussi source d\u2019inspiration pour les prochaines g\u00e9n\u00e9rations de scientifiques et d\u2019ing\u00e9nieurs . INTEGRAL Science Data Centre World Radiation Center L\u2019International Space Science Institute Les missions des programmes scientifiques de l\u2019ESA sont s\u00e9lectionn\u00e9es en fonction de leur excellence . Tandis que l\u2019ESA finance le d\u00e9veloppement des vaisseaux spatiaux , les op\u00e9rations connexes et les services de lancement , les charges utiles scientifiques ( \u00e0 savoir les instruments ) sont en g\u00e9n\u00e9ral sous la responsabilit\u00e9 de ses \u00c9tats membres . Les scientifiques op\u00e9rant en Suisse ont particip\u00e9 \u00e0 la construction de plusieurs sondes spatiales , de la mission Giotto dans les ann\u00e9es 80 \u00e0 des missions comme Rosetta , BepiColombo et Solar Orbiter . Par ailleurs , la Suisse est bien repr\u00e9sent\u00e9e dans des missions d\u2019avenir telles que JUICE , Euclid ou Comet Interceptor . Des infrastructures importantes sont en outre situ\u00e9es en Suisse , comme le INTEGRAL Science Data Centre de l\u2019Universit\u00e9 de Gen\u00e8ve ou le World Radiation Center de l\u2019observatoire de physique et de m\u00e9t\u00e9orologie de Davos . de Berne joue lui aussi un r\u00f4le central \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9chelon international dans le domaine de l\u2019analyse de donn\u00e9es et de la mise en place de nouvelles missions . L\u2019industrie suisse , comp\u00e9titive sur le plan international , est solidement positionn\u00e9e dans le domaine des technologies n\u00e9cessaires aux projets de d\u00e9veloppement de satellites scientifiques et de sondes spatiales , ce qui conf\u00e8re \u00e0 la Suisse une base solide pour participer \u00e0 de tels projets . Avec CHEOPS , la Suisse est pour la premi\u00e8re fois \u00e0 la t\u00eate d\u2019une mission scientifique dans le domaine spatial . CHEOPS a \u00e9t\u00e9 lanc\u00e9e en d\u00e9cembre 2019 . Elle a r\u00e9cemment d\u00e9but\u00e9 ses premi\u00e8res op\u00e9rations scientifiques , qui devraient durer 3 ann\u00e9es et demi . sentence1: Space Space activities occupy an important place in our society . Beyond their scientific contribution to exploring the Earth and the universe , they have become an integral part of our daily lives . We rely on them for so many things : satellite - based global telecommunication services , road , maritime and air navigation systems , and Earth observation for more reliable weather forecasts and a better understanding of climate change . Switzerland has been actively involved in this field since the early days . It is a competitive and reliable partner in the space sector , both within Europe and across the globe . Thanks to its innovative strength and precision technology , Switzerland has gained a solid and acknowledged position in strategically significant fields Space contributes to a flourishing economy and a prosperous society . It is also crucial to Switzerland\u2019s position as a centre of research and to its security . Moreover , it generates value - added activities for the benefit of current and future generations . For a highly developed country such as Switzerland , a strong commitment to space activities is vital Switzerland does not have its own national space agency . It does most of its research and development within the framework of the European Space Agency\u2019s activities and programmes . The Swiss Space Office , which is the SERI division responsible for space matters , performs the following tasks Documentation COSPAR 2020\u20132022 Report Brochure NCCR PlanetS COSPAR 2018\u20132020 Report ( PDF , 7 MB , 15 . 01 . 2021 ) Roadmap Space Science in Switzerland 2019 ( PDF , 833 kB , 15 . 01 . 2021 ) COSPAR 2016 - 2018 Report ( PDF , 11 MB , 10 . 07 . 2018 ) Switzerland in space - Cutting - edge research and high - tech solutions \u2013 for everyday life ( PDF , 3 MB , 19 . 12 . 2016 ) 2016 COSPAR Bericht ( PDF , 11 MB , 03 . 08 . 2016 ) 30 years of PRODEX \u2013 PROgramme de D\u00e9veloppement d\u2018EXp\u00e9riences scientifiques ( PDF , 7 MB , 19 . 10 . 2015 ) Laying of the Cornerstone \u2013 Speech Secretary Mauro Dell\u2019Ambrogio \u2013 2nd September 2014 - RUAG Emme ( PDF , 213 kB , 08 . 09 . 2014 ) Factsheet : Rosetta , the comet - chaser arrives at destination ( PDF , 263 kB , 10 . 11 . 2014 ) Copernicus , Europe ' s Global Monitoring for Environment and Security system : first satellite now in orbit Report of the Swiss Delegation on the ESA Ministerial Council meeting of 20 / 21 November 2012 ( PDF , 24 kB , 17 . 01 . 2013 ) Euronews : The Minister of Space
sentence2: Affaires spatiales Les activit\u00e9s spatiales occupent une place importante dans notre soci\u00e9t\u00e9 . Au - del\u00e0 de leur apport scientifique \u00e0 l\u2019exploration de la plan\u00e8te Terre et de l\u2019Univers , elles font partie du quotidien de tout un chacun \u00e0 travers les services de t\u00e9l\u00e9communication par satellite pour une connexion en temps r\u00e9el au niveau mondial , la navigation routi\u00e8re , maritime et a\u00e9rienne par satellite et l\u2019observation satellitaire de la Terre au service de pr\u00e9visions m\u00e9t\u00e9orologiques plus pr\u00e9cises ou de la compr\u00e9hension des changements climatiques . La Suisse s\u2019est engag\u00e9e dans l\u2019aventure spatiale depuis le d\u00e9but et est aujourd\u2019hui consid\u00e9r\u00e9e comme un partenaire comp\u00e9titif et fiable en Europe et dans le monde entier . Elle est parvenue \u00e0 occuper une place solide dans des domaines strat\u00e9giques importants gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 ses comp\u00e9tences telles que la capacit\u00e9 d\u2019innovation et la pr\u00e9cision . Le spatial contribue grandement au fonctionnement de notre \u00e9conomie et de notre soci\u00e9t\u00e9 , mais aussi \u00e0 notre s\u00e9curit\u00e9 et au renforcement de la Suisse en tant que p\u00f4le de recherche . Il comprend des activit\u00e9s \u00e0 forte valeur ajout\u00e9e , r\u00e9alis\u00e9es au b\u00e9n\u00e9fice des g\u00e9n\u00e9rations actuelles et futures . En tant que pays tr\u00e8s d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 , la Suisse se doit de poursuivre pleinement son engagement dans le domaine spatial . La Suisse ne dispose pas de sa propre agence spatiale nationale . Dans le domaine de la recherche et d\u00e9veloppement , elle rejoint , en grand partie , les activit\u00e9s et les programmes de l\u2019Agence spatiale europ\u00e9enne ( ESA ) . sentence1: International Cooperation in Vocational and Professional Education and Training ( IC - VPET ) Strengthening Swiss Vocational and Professional Education and Training ( VPET ) in the international context is the education policy objective according to the strategy for international cooperation in VPET of the State Secretariat for Education , Research and Innovation ( SERI ) . SERI strategy and objectives Swiss education policy IC - VPET Strategy Swiss education policy prioritises international exchanges with other countries . Increasingly , the Swiss VPET system has been the focus of such endeavours in an effort to improve the visibility and level of recognition of Switzerland\u2019s VET sector . Swiss dual - track VET programmes place heavy emphasis on providing young people with competences in demand on the labour market . Steps have also been taken to promote Swiss vocational qualifications and encourage qualification holders to obtain competences in other countries . SERI ' s offers a coherent frame of reference for the various activities . Expertise in skills formation new or existing forums created by national or international partners USA guideline Apprenticeship Toolbox Through bilateral and multilateral contacts and cooperation initiatives , Switzerland promotes the international transfer and exchange of expertise in the area of dual - track VET . With the participation of Swiss VPET and economic stakeholders , SERI receives official foreign delegations wishing to know more about the Swiss VPET system and relies on new or existing forums created by national or international partners to raise the profile of the Swiss VPET system and encourage dialogue with various stakeholders . In addition , Switzerland is involved in activities and cooperation initiatives at both European and bilateral levels , which allows it to share its expertise in the area of skills formation with various partner countries . There are currently several bilateral initiatives with various countries , including the USA . Project funding for international projects in the field of VPET Project funding for international projects is available for persons with a Swiss legal personality ( legal or national persons ) . In accordance with art . 55 of the Vocational and Professional Education and Training Act ( VPETA ) provision of funding is limited to a maximum period of five years . Detailed information is provided by the corresponding guideline ( german ) . In addition , Switzerland works at multilateral level with other countries that also have dual - track VET systems ( Austria , Denmark , Germany , Luxembourg ) . This includes joint efforts to develop the . Mobility and recognition of Swiss vocational and professional qualifications international mobility in education National qualifications framework for vocational and professional qualifications European qualifications framework for lifelong learning recognition of foreign qualifications Encouraging international mobility in education is important for Switzerland . Switzerland participates on a project - per - project basis in the EU education programmes . In this context , Switzerland has developed a National qualifications framework for vocational and professional qualifications ( NQF VPQ ) based on the European qualifications framework for lifelong learning ( EQF - LLL ) . This instrument allows employers in Europe to gain a clearer understanding of what holders of Swiss vocational and professional qualifications can do , thereby enabling comparison with similar qualifications in other European countries and facilitating the mobility of Swiss workers on the European labour market . The aim of achieving the mutual recognition of vocational and professional qualifications is also furthered by bilateral agreements and multilateral agreements ( on the ) . IC - VPET Website objectives and activities pursued by SERI The in the area of IC - VPET are complementary to those of other federal agencies with similar activities in this area . SERI works in conjunction with the cantons and professional organisations to consolidate and further develop the Swiss education system at national and international level . This is achieved partly through the mutual recognition of foreign qualifications combined with support measures for exchange programmes , and partly through the sharing of information and expertise on education policy with interested countries . IC - VPET Website The Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation ( SDC ) , the State Secretariat for Economic Affairs ( SECO ) and the State Secretariat for Migration ( SEM ) contribute to sustainable development through vocational education and training projects and policy dialogue in selected priority countries . These activities are aimed at fostering development , foreign trade and international migration policy . Finally , Presence Switzerland and the Swiss diplomatic network enhance the visibility of the Swiss VPET system abroad . More information on coordination between federal agencies can be found on the . sentence2: Coop\u00e9ration internationale en mati\u00e8re de formation professionnelle ( CIFP ) La strat\u00e9gie du SEFRI pour la coop\u00e9ration internationale en mati\u00e8re de formation professionnelle ( CIFP ) a pour objectif de renforcer la formation professionnelle suisse dans le contexte international . Strat\u00e9gie et objectifs du SEFRI priorit\u00e9 strat\u00e9gie CIFP du SEFRI En mati\u00e8re de formation , la Suisse s\u2019est fix\u00e9 comme priorit\u00e9 de promouvoir les \u00e9changes \u00e0 l\u2019international . La formation professionnelle est toujours davantage concern\u00e9e , car il s\u2019agit d\u2019accro\u00eetre la visibilit\u00e9 et la reconnaissance internationales de notre syst\u00e8me de formation professionnelle duale , ax\u00e9 sur le march\u00e9 du travail . Les \u00e9changes internationaux permettent \u00e9galement de consolider le statut des dipl\u00f4mes suisses et de favoriser l\u2019acquisition de comp\u00e9tences internationales . La offre un cadre coh\u00e9rent pour les diff\u00e9rentes activit\u00e9s . Expertise en formation professionnelle les instruments existants ou ceux cr\u00e9\u00e9s par des partenaires nationaux ou internationaux \u00c9tats - Unis Dans le cadre des coop\u00e9rations et des contacts bilat\u00e9raux et multilat\u00e9raux , la Suisse s\u2019investit en faveur du transfert et des \u00e9changes d\u2019expertise en formation professionnelle duale . Le SEFRI , en collaboration avec des acteurs suisses de la formation professionnelle et de l\u2019\u00e9conomie , re\u00e7oit des d\u00e9l\u00e9gations officielles \u00e9trang\u00e8res int\u00e9ress\u00e9es par le syst\u00e8me suisse de formation professionnelle . Il utilise les instruments existants ou ceux cr\u00e9\u00e9s par des partenaires nationaux ou internationaux afin de promouvoir la visibilit\u00e9 de la formation professionnelle suisse et les \u00e9changes avec les diff\u00e9rents acteurs concern\u00e9s . La Suisse participe en outre \u00e0 des initiatives et \u00e0 des coop\u00e9rations , aussi bien sur le plan europ\u00e9en qu\u2019\u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9chelle mondiale , dans le souci de partager son expertise avec diff\u00e9rents pays partenaires . Actuellement , il existe des coop\u00e9rations avec certains pays , notamment avec les . directive Bo\u00eete \u00e0 outils sur l\u2019apprentissage Promotion de projets internationaux La promotion de projets internationaux est accessible aux acteurs ayant une personnalit\u00e9 juridique suisse ( personnes juridiques ou physiques ) . Conform\u00e9ment \u00e0 l\u2019art . 55 de la loi f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sur la formation professionnelle , des subventions peuvent \u00eatre attribu\u00e9es pour une p\u00e9riode maximale de 5 ans . Des informations d\u00e9taill\u00e9es sont fournies par la directive correspondante . Dans le cadre multilat\u00e9ral , la Suisse soutient l\u2019initiative ( Apprenticeship toolbox ) en collaboration avec d\u2019autres pays poss\u00e9dant un syst\u00e8me de formation professionnelle duale ( Allemagne , Autriche , Danemark , Luxembourg ) . Mobilit\u00e9 et reconnaissance des qualifications professionnelles mobilit\u00e9 internationale dans la formation cadre national des certifications de la formation professionnelle cadre europ\u00e9en des certifications reconnaissance des dipl\u00f4mes La Suisse estime important d\u2019encourager la mobilit\u00e9 internationale dans la formation . Elle participe sur le mode projet par projet aux programmes de formation de l\u2019UE . Dans ce contexte , elle a \u00e9labor\u00e9 un cadre national des certifications de la formation professionnelle en conformit\u00e9 avec le cadre europ\u00e9en des certifications . Cet instrument permet de rendre comparables les qualifications et les comp\u00e9tences des professionnels suisses \u00e0 l\u2019int\u00e9rieur de l\u2019Europe et encourage la mobilit\u00e9 sur le march\u00e9 du travail europ\u00e9en . Des accords bilat\u00e9raux et des conventions multilat\u00e9rales facilitent la reconnaissance r\u00e9ciproque des qualifications professionnelles ( ) . Portail de la CIFP Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration objectifs et les activit\u00e9s du SEFRI Les dans le domaine de la coop\u00e9ration internationale en mati\u00e8re de formation professionnelle sont compl\u00e9mentaires de ceux des autres services de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration \u00e9galement engag\u00e9s dans la CIFP . En collaboration avec les cantons et les organisations du monde du travail , le SEFRI \u0153uvre en faveur du renforcement et du d\u00e9veloppement du syst\u00e8me de formation suisse sur le plan national et international . L\u2019accent est mis , d\u2019une part , sur la reconnaissance des dipl\u00f4mes et la promotion de la mobilit\u00e9 et , d\u2019autre part , sur l\u2019\u00e9change d\u2019informations et d\u2019expertise en mati\u00e8re de politique de formation avec les pays int\u00e9ress\u00e9s . portail de la CIFP Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration La Direction du d\u00e9veloppement et de la coop\u00e9ration ( DDC ) , le Secr\u00e9tariat d\u2019\u00c9tat \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9conomie ( SECO ) et le Secr\u00e9tariat d\u2019\u00c9tat aux migrations ( SEM ) apportent une contribution au d\u00e9veloppement durable dans certains pays prioritaires en menant des projets de formation professionnelle et en instaurant un dialogue politique dans le cadre de la politique de d\u00e9veloppement , de la politique \u00e9conomique ext\u00e9rieure et de la politique migratoire internationale . Pr\u00e9sence Suisse et le r\u00e9seau diplomatique ext\u00e9rieur de la Suisse s\u2019emploient , pour leur part , \u00e0 augmenter la visibilit\u00e9 \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9tranger de la formation professionnelle suisse . De plus amples informations sur la coordination entre les services f\u00e9d\u00e9raux se trouvent sur le . sentence1: Certificates Issued by Swiss Authorities to Facilitate Recognition of Swiss Qualifications Abroad The host country where you wish to work is responsible for recognition of Swiss qualifications abroad . In many cases , a recognition body in the host country will require a certificate from the competent body in Switzerland \u2013 e . g . the State Secretariat for Education , Research and Innovation ( SERI ) , the Federal Office of Public Health ( FOPH ) , the Swiss Red Cross ( SRC ) , the Conference of Cantonal Ministers of Education ( EDK ) , etc . This certificate usually provides information about the level that the given qualification holds within the Swiss education system . For EU / EFTA citizens , specific certificates attesting to professional activity or experience may also be issued at the request of foreign recognition bodies . SERI is the competent authority for issuance of certificates on behalf of holders of Swiss qualifications who seek recognition abroad ( i . e . Swiss upper - secondary vocational qualifications , Swiss tertiary - level professional qualifications and Swiss higher education qualifications ) . Certificates for recognition bodies in EU / EFTA member states are issued in accordance with EU directives . While Switzerland is under no legal obligation to issue certificates to competent authorities of third countries , the competent authority of a third country may ask SERI to issue such a certificate ( e . g . attesting to state recognition of a given Swiss qualification or to the level that this qualification holds within the Swiss education system ) in order to facilitate processing of a recognition application .
sentence2: Attestations pour les autorit\u00e9s \u00e9trang\u00e8res L\u2019Etat d\u2019accueil de votre choix est comp\u00e9tent en mati\u00e8re de reconnaissance des dipl\u00f4mes et certificats suisses \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9tranger . L\u2019autorit\u00e9 de reconnaissance de cet Etat demande souvent une attestation de l\u2019autorit\u00e9 comp\u00e9tente en Suisse ( Secr\u00e9tariat d\u2019Etat \u00e0 la formation , \u00e0 la recherche et \u00e0 l\u2019innovation SEFRI , Office f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de la sant\u00e9 publique OFSP , Croix - Rouge suisse CRS , Conf\u00e9rence suisse des directeurs cantonaux de l\u2019instruction publique CDIP , etc . ) . L\u2019attestation doit en g\u00e9n\u00e9ral fournir des informations sur le niveau de la formation suisse . Des attestations sp\u00e9cifiques relatives \u00e0 l\u2019activit\u00e9 ou \u00e0 l\u2019exp\u00e9rience professionnelle sont \u00e9mises sur demande des autorit\u00e9s \u00e9trang\u00e8res pour les ressortissants des Etats membres de l\u2019UE / AELE . Le SEFRI est l\u2019autorit\u00e9 comp\u00e9tente pour les attestations en faveur des personnes qui ont obtenu une attestation f\u00e9d\u00e9rale de formation professionnelle ( AFP ) , un certificat f\u00e9d\u00e9ral de capacit\u00e9 ( CFC ) , un brevet f\u00e9d\u00e9ral ( examen professionnel ) , un dipl\u00f4me f\u00e9d\u00e9ral ( examen professionnel sup\u00e9rieur ) , un dipl\u00f4me d\u2019une \u00e9cole sup\u00e9rieure ou d\u2019une haute \u00e9cole reconnu au niveau national et des personnes aimeraient le faire reconna\u00eetre \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9tranger . Les attestations pour les autorit\u00e9s des Etats membres de l\u2019UE / AELE sont \u00e9tablies selon les dispositions des directives de l\u2019UE . La Suisse n\u2019a pas d\u2019obligations l\u00e9gales \u00e0 cet \u00e9gard par rapport aux autres pays , faute d\u2019accords internationaux sp\u00e9cifiques . Toutefois , si une autorit\u00e9 d\u2019un Etat tiers r\u00e9clame , dans le cadre de la proc\u00e9dure de reconnaissance , une attestation de la formation suisse , cette derni\u00e8re peut \u00eatre demand\u00e9e aupr\u00e8s du SEFRI .

sentence1: United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization \u2013 UNESCO The United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization ( UNESCO ) was founded in 1945 as a specialized agency of the United Nations . It has over 190 member states and eight associated member states . Switzerland joined UNESCO in 1949 . What does UNESCO do ? UNESCO works to preserve peace and security worldwide by promoting cooperation between peoples in the area of education , research and culture . It operates in the four areas of education , science , culture , communication and information . In doing so , it develops pilot projects , brings together scientists and experts from all over the world and advises governments on the formulation of political concepts and the establishment of institutions . It also serves as a framework for the creation of standards ( ISCED classification ) in the field of statistics . UNESCO is responsible for education as part of implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development , which was adopted by the UN in 2015 . Switzerland plays an active role in UNESCO . It is represented by a permanent delegation at its headquarters in Paris and in the various intergovernmental committees and commissions , depending on the outcome of elections in the various bodies . How does UNESCO work ? UNESCO is made up of various bodies . These include the General Conference , which meets every two years , the Executive Board and the Secretariat . The organisation has 65 offices around the world . In addition , there are ten institutes and centres which support cluster offices and national offices in various specific programmes and are responsible for several countries . UNESCO also has national commissions in over 190 member states . Swiss Commission for UNESCO The Swiss Commission for UNESCO disseminates the values and objectives of UNESCO at national level and advises the federal authorities on relations with UNESCO . In line with its priorities and by means of concrete projects , the Swiss Commission for UNESCO builds bridges between the international community , Swiss citizens and the federal and cantonal political authorities . The Commission consists of 20 members appointed by the Federal Council ; its secretariat is run by the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs ( FDFA ) . What benefits does UNESCO offer Switzerland Through its various platforms , UNESCO primarily serves as a laboratory for ideas , as a standard - setting organisation , as a forum for the worldwide exchange of ideas as well as an advisory body for capacity building and the formulation of political concepts . It also offers Switzerland the opportunity to participate in the drafting and updating of international agreements . Structure and Management Structure and management of UNESCO UNESCO bodies responsible for education : International Institute for Educational Planning IIEP , Paris ( France ) , Buenos Aires ( Argentina ) and Dakar International Bureau of Education IBE , Geneva , ( Switzerland ) UNESCO Institute for Lifelong Learning IUAV , Hamburg ( Germany ) UNESCO Institute for Information Technologies in Education IITE , Moskau ( Russia ) International Institute for Capacity Building in Africa IICBA , Addis Abeba ( Ethiopia ) International Institute for Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean IESALC , Caracas ( Venezuela ) International Centre for Technical and Vocational Education and Training UNEVOC , Bonn ( Germany ) UNESCO bodies responsible for science : UNESCO - IHE Institute for Water Education Delft ( Netherlands ) International Centre for Theoretical Physics ICTP , Trieste ( Italy ) UNESCO institute for statistics : UNESCO Institute for Statistics UIS , Montreal ( Kanada ) Swiss Commission for UNESCO ( german )
sentence2: UNESCO \u2013 Organisation des Nations Unies pour l\u2019\u00e9ducation , la science et la culture L\u2019UNESCO , Organisation des Nations Unies pour l\u2019\u00e9ducation , la science , la culture et la communication , est une agence sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9e des Nations Unies fond\u00e9e en 1945 . Elle compte plus de 190 \u00c9tats membres et 8 membres associ\u00e9s . La Suisse en fait partie depuis le 28 janvier 1949 . Priorit\u00e9s de l\u2019UNESCO L\u2019UNESCO se propose de contribuer au maintien de la paix et de la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 en resserrant , par l\u2019\u00e9ducation , la science et la culture , la collaboration entre nations . Elle est active dans les quatre domaines que sont l\u2019\u00e9ducation , la science , la culture ainsi que la communication et l\u2019information . Dans ces domaines d\u2019activit\u00e9s , l\u2019UNESCO \u00e9labore des projets mod\u00e8les , favorise le rapprochement entre scientifiques et experts du monde entier , conseille les gouvernements dans la formulation de leurs concepts politiques et la cr\u00e9ation de leurs institutions . Elle sert aussi de cadre pour la cr\u00e9ation de normes dans le domaine de la statistique ( classification ISCED ) . Dans le cadre de l\u2019Agenda 2030 pour le d\u00e9veloppement durable , approuv\u00e9 en 2015 par l\u2019ONU , l\u2019UNESCO est en charge de l\u2019\u00e9ducation . La Suisse joue un r\u00f4le actif au sein de l\u2019UNESCO o\u00f9 elle est repr\u00e9sent\u00e9e , au Si\u00e8ge \u00e0 Paris , par une D\u00e9l\u00e9gation permanente , ainsi que dans divers comit\u00e9s et commissions intergouvernementaux en fonction des \u00e9lections par les organes comp\u00e9tents . Comment travaille l\u2019UNESCO ? L\u2019UNESCO est constitu\u00e9e de diff\u00e9rents organes dont la Conf\u00e9rence g\u00e9n\u00e9rale qui se r\u00e9unit tous les deux ans , le Conseil ex\u00e9cutif , le Secr\u00e9tariat et 65 bureaux r\u00e9partis dans le monde . Elle compte \u00e9galement dix instituts et centres qui soutiennent les bureaux multipays ainsi que les bureaux nationaux dans les diff\u00e9rents programmes sp\u00e9cifiques . L\u2019UNESCO dispose en outre de commissions nationales dans plus de 190 pays membres . Commission suisse pour l\u2019UNESCO La Commission suisse pour l\u2019UNESCO concr\u00e9tise sur le plan national les valeurs et les objectifs de l\u2019UNESCO en Suisse et conseille les instances f\u00e9d\u00e9rales sur les relations avec l\u2019UNESCO . En accord avec ses priorit\u00e9s et \u00e0 travers des projets concrets , elle instaure des passerelles entre la communaut\u00e9 internationale , la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 civile en Suisse et les instances politiques f\u00e9d\u00e9rales et cantonales . Elle compte 20 membres nomm\u00e9s par le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral et son secr\u00e9tariat est rattach\u00e9 au DFAE . Qu\u2019apporte l\u2019UNESCO \u00e0 la Suisse ? A travers ses diff\u00e9rentes plateformes , l\u2019UNESCO remplit les fonctions de laboratoire d\u2019id\u00e9es , d\u2019organisation normative , de centre d\u2019\u00e9change d\u2019id\u00e9es , d\u2019instance de conseil en d\u00e9veloppement de capacit\u00e9s et d\u2019aide \u00e0 la formulation de concepts politiques . Elle offre \u00e9galement \u00e0 la Suisse la possibilit\u00e9 de participer \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9laboration et \u00e0 la mise \u00e0 jour de conventions internationales . Structure et gestion de l\u2019UNESCO Structure et gouvernance de l ' UNESCO Instituts de UNESCO pour l ' \u00e9ducation : Institut international de planification de l ' \u00e9ducation de l ' UNESCO IIEP , Paris ( France ) et Buenos Aires ( Argentina ) Bureau international d ' \u00e9ducation de l ' UNESCO IBE , Gen\u00e8ve , ( Suisse ) Institut de l ' UNESCO pour l ' apprentissage tout au long de la vie IUAV , Hambourg ( Allemagne ) Institut de l ' UNESCO pour l ' application des technologies de l ' information \u00e0 l ' \u00e9ducation IITE , Moscou ( F\u00e9d\u00e9ration de Russie ) Institut de l ' UNESCO pour le renforcement des capacit\u00e9s en Afrique IICBA , Addis Abeba ( Ethiopie ) Institut international de l ' UNESCO pour l ' enseignement sup\u00e9rieur en Am\u00e9rique latine et dans les Cara\u00efbes IESALC , Caracas ( Venezuela ) Centre international de l ' UNESCO pour l ' enseignement et la formation techniques et professionnels UNEVOC , Bonn ( Allemagne ) Instituts de UNESCO pour la science : UNESCO - IHE Institute for Water Education Delft ( Pays - Bas ) Centre international de physique th\u00e9orique ICTP , Trieste ( Italie ) Institut de statistique de l ' UNESCO : Institut de statistique de l ' UNESCO UIS , Montr\u00e9al ( Canada ) Commission suisse pour l ' UNESCO

sentence1: Earth Observation \u00a9 ESA Space is the only vantage point from which one to see the entire Earth and observe it to a satisfactory degree of detail . Satellites are able to continuously observe and examine extensive areas of the natural environment and show the impact that human activities have on land , oceans and the atmosphere . Earth Observation data therefore serves as an important basis for decision - making in the area of environmental protection , climate , land use , the monitoring of coastlines , disaster management and sustainable development . Today , the benefits of Earth Observation to society , the economy and science are abundantly clear . EUMETSAT Copernicus programme The ESA ' s Earth Observation programmes focus on the following main areas : the development of science missions ( Earth Explorer missions ) , the construction of satellites and instruments for meteorological monitoring missions ( in partnership with EUMETSAT ) as well as the development of the space component for the EU\u2019s ( formerly Global Monitoring for Environment and Security , GMES ) . In addition , ESA develops dedicated missions and carries out various activities to help maintain Europe\u2019s independent capability for operational Earth Observation . The ESA Climate Change Initiative ( CCI ) contributes time series data captured by satellites to the world - wide datasets of essential climate variables , and thus contributes to the objectives of the Global Climate Observing System ( GCOS ) . Further , ESA receives and provides Earth Observation data from numerous national and international missions . Besides promoting the development of satellites and instruments , ESA also supports the scientific analysis of data and the development of associated products and services . Swiss participation A large number of Swiss companies , universities , research centres and organisations are involved in ESA ' s Earth Observation programmes . Swiss participation in these programmes is mainly intended to facilitate the acquisition of technological and industrial competencies needed to manufacture sensors and other instruments . Swiss participation should also encourage the development of applications and the operational use of Earth Observation data . sentence2: Observation de la Terre \u00a9 ESA La Terre n\u2019est visible dans sa totalit\u00e9 et avec un degr\u00e9 de d\u00e9tails satisfaisant que depuis l\u2019espace . Les satellites permettent d ' observer et d ' \u00e9tudier en continu et \u00e0 large \u00e9chelle l ' environnement naturel et les effets de l ' activit\u00e9 humaine sur les terres \u00e9merg\u00e9es , les oc\u00e9ans et l ' atmosph\u00e8re . L ' observation de la Terre fournit d ' importantes bases de d\u00e9cision en mati\u00e8re de protection de l ' environnement , de climat , d ' exploitation des terres , de surveillance c\u00f4ti\u00e8re , de gestion des catastrophes et de d\u00e9veloppement durable . L\u2019int\u00e9r\u00eat majeur de l\u2019observation satellitaire pour la soci\u00e9t\u00e9 , l ' \u00e9conomie et la science n ' est plus \u00e0 d\u00e9montrer . EUMETSAT Copernicus Les programmes d ' observation de la Terre de l ' Agence spatiale europ\u00e9enne ( ESA ) s ' articulent en trois branches principales : le d\u00e9veloppement de missions scientifiques ( Earth Explorer ) , la construction de satellites et d ' instruments m\u00e9t\u00e9orologiques ( en collaboration avec EUMETSAT ) et le volet spatial du programme europ\u00e9en \u00ab\u00bb ( auparavant : Global Monitoring for Environment and Security ) . Par ailleurs , des missions sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9es sont d\u00e9velopp\u00e9es et des activit\u00e9s men\u00e9es \u00e0 bien au moyen d ' \u00e9l\u00e9ments de programme sp\u00e9cifiques , ce qui contribue \u00e0 maintenir une capacit\u00e9 europ\u00e9enne ind\u00e9pendante pour l\u2019observation de la Terre op\u00e9rationnelle . L ' initiative sur le changement climatique ( CCI ) de l ' ESA fournit des s\u00e9ries chronologiques de donn\u00e9es satellitaires qui alimentent les donn\u00e9es internationales disponibles sur les variables climatiques essentielles . Elle apporte ainsi sa contribution \u00e0 la r\u00e9alisation des objectifs du \u00abGlobal Climate Observing System ( GCOS ) \u00bb . L ' ESA collecte et met \u00e0 disposition les donn\u00e9es d ' observation de la Terre r\u00e9colt\u00e9es par de nombreuses missions nationales et internationales . Elle encourage non seulement le d\u00e9veloppement d ' instruments d ' observation et la construction de satellites , mais aussi l ' analyse scientifique des donn\u00e9es et le d\u00e9veloppement de produits et de services d\u00e9riv\u00e9s de ces observations scientifiques . Participation de la Suisse Un nombre important d ' entreprises , d ' instituts universitaires , de centres de recherche et d ' organismes suisses sont impliqu\u00e9s dans les programmes d ' observation de la Terre de l ' ESA . Les principaux objectifs de la participation suisse \u00e0 ces programmes sont de soutenir l ' acquisition de comp\u00e9tences technologiques et industrielles pour la construction de capteurs et autres instruments et d ' encourager le d\u00e9veloppement d ' applications et l ' exploitation op\u00e9rationnelle des donn\u00e9es d ' observation de la Terre . sentence1: Swiss - US Cooperation in VET Switzerland and the USA have maintained an intensive dialogue in the area of vocational education and training for several years . The signing of a Joint Declaration of Intent on Vocational Education and Training in the summer of 2015 set the stage for cooperation for the first time . In December 2018 , bilateral cooperation was formally extended with the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding . This agreement continues to form the basis for the pragmatic sharing of knowledge and experience on Switzerland ' s model of vocational education and training . Since then , US states and Swiss companies have launched several VET projects . On 3 December 2018 , Federal Councillor Johann N . Schneider - Ammann together with US secretaries of commerce , education and labor signed a Memorandum of Understanding Concerning Cooperation on Advancing Apprenticeship , Career and Technical Education , and Vocational and Professional Education and Training . This MoU extends the formal cooperation institutionalised for the first time under the Joint Declaration of Intent signed back in 2015 . Switzerland and the USA seek to facilitate official dialogue and the sharing of information , experiences and best practices . In addition , the two countries intend to encourage direct contacts , partnerships and cooperation between companies , project promoters and other VET stakeholders . Bilateral fact - finding visits and meetings with experts may also be organised as needed . The MoU is expected to lead to more intensive sharing of knowledge and information between Switzerland and the US in the area of vocational education and training ( VET ) . Each year , several US delegations visit Switzerland to gain first - hand insight into the Swiss VPET system . These delegations include technical experts as well as high - ranking representatives from interested US states . The Swiss VPET system has attracted a great deal of interest from some US states . As a follow - up to official visits to Switzerland , individual states have launched pilot projects with Swiss partners or even begun reforming their education system to align it more explicitly with the Swiss model . As a case in point , the state of Colorado launched the ' CareerWise Colorado ' system to provide young people with skills training . This new system is modelled after the Swiss system . SERI also organised a virtual meeting with representatives of the US departments of labour , education and commerce on the topic of VET in December 2020 . This enabled direct discussion between experts on topics such as how to deal with Covid - 19 in vocational education and training . Swiss companies have also established labour programmes in their US locations , paving the way for the development and implementation of training programmes based on the Swiss model . In September 2020 , Zurich Insurance won one of nine Pledge to America ' s Workers Presidential Awards . These Presidential Awards recognise organisations that demonstrate excellence in workforce education and training . In the fall of 2020 , Zurich Insurance expanded its programme from Chicago to New York City . As a co - founder of the Chicago Apprenticeship Network and Insurance Apprenticeship USA , it helps other companies explore the possibility of apprenticeships . Memorandum of Understanding Concerning Cooperation on Advancing Apprenticeship , Career and Technical Education , and Vocational and Professional Education and Training
sentence2: Coop\u00e9ration en mati\u00e8re de formation professionnelle Suisse - \u00c9tats - Unis Depuis plusieurs ann\u00e9es , la Suisse et les \u00c9tats - Unis entretiennent un dialogue soutenu dans le domaine de la formation professionnelle . La signature d\u2019une Joint Declaration of Intent on Vocational Education and Training en \u00e9t\u00e9 2015 a conf\u00e9r\u00e9 pour la premi\u00e8re fois un cadre \u00e0 cette coop\u00e9ration . En d\u00e9cembre 2018 , la coop\u00e9ration bilat\u00e9rale a \u00e9t\u00e9 formellement prolong\u00e9e avec la signature d\u2019un Memorandum of Understanding . Cet accord continue de constituer un cadre pour un \u00e9change pragmatique de connaissances et d\u2019exp\u00e9riences sur la formation professionnelle selon le mod\u00e8le suisse . Par la suite , des \u00c9tats f\u00e9d\u00e9raux am\u00e9ricains et des entreprises suisses ont lanc\u00e9 des projets dans le domaine de la formation professionnelle . Le 3 d\u00e9cembre 2018 , le conseiller f\u00e9d\u00e9ral Johann N . Schneider - Ammann a sign\u00e9 une d\u00e9claration d\u2019intention commune ( Memorandum of Understanding Concerning Cooperation on Advancing Apprenticeship , Career and Technical Education , and Vocational and Professional Education and Training ) avec les secr\u00e9taires am\u00e9ricains au Commerce , \u00e0 la Formation et au Travail . L\u2019accord prolonge la collaboration formelle qui avait \u00e9t\u00e9 institutionnalis\u00e9e pour la premi\u00e8re fois en 2015 par une Joint Declaration . La Suisse et les \u00c9tats - Unis ont pour objectif de permettre le dialogue officiel et l\u2019\u00e9change d\u2019informations , d\u2019exp\u00e9riences et de bonnes pratiques . L\u2019id\u00e9e est de promouvoir en outre des contacts directs , des partenariats et des coop\u00e9rations entre les entreprises , les porteurs de projet et les autres repr\u00e9sentants d\u2019int\u00e9r\u00eats dans le domaine de la formation professionnelle . Si n\u00e9cessaire , des visites d\u2019information bilat\u00e9rales et des r\u00e9unions d\u2019experts peuvent \u00eatre organis\u00e9es . Cet accord vise \u00e0 stimuler l\u2019\u00e9change de connaissances et d\u2019informations entre la Suisse et les \u00c9tats - Unis dans le domaine de la formation professionnelle . Chaque ann\u00e9e , plusieurs d\u00e9l\u00e9gations am\u00e9ricaines se rendent en Suisse afin d\u2019avoir un aper\u00e7u de premi\u00e8re main du syst\u00e8me de formation professionnelle suisse . Il s\u2019agit aussi bien de d\u00e9l\u00e9gations d\u2019experts que de repr\u00e9sentants \u00e9minents des \u00c9tats f\u00e9d\u00e9raux am\u00e9ricains int\u00e9ress\u00e9s . La formation professionnelle suisse suscite un grand int\u00e9r\u00eat dans plusieurs \u00c9tats f\u00e9d\u00e9raux . \u00c0 la suite des visites officielles en Suisse , plusieurs projets pilotes entre des \u00c9tats f\u00e9d\u00e9raux et des partenaires suisses , voire un processus de r\u00e9forme du syst\u00e8me de formation , ont \u00e9t\u00e9 mis sur les rails , explicitement en \u00e9cho au mod\u00e8le suisse . Au Colorado , par exemple , a \u00e9t\u00e9 cr\u00e9\u00e9 le \u00abCareerWise Colorado\u00bb , un syst\u00e8me pour la formation des jeunes calqu\u00e9 sur le syst\u00e8me suisse . Le SEFRI a en outre organis\u00e9 en d\u00e9cembre 2020 une discussion virtuelle sur le th\u00e8me de la formation professionnelle avec les secr\u00e9tariats am\u00e9ricains au Travail , \u00e0 la Formation et au Commerce . Un \u00e9change direct entre des experts a ainsi pu avoir lieu sur des th\u00e8mes tels que la gestion du Covid - 19 dans la formation professionnelle . Par la suite , des entreprises suisses ont aussi mis en place des programmes de travail sur leurs sites aux \u00c9tats - Unis , ouvrant ainsi la voie au d\u00e9veloppement et \u00e0 la mise en \u0153uvre de programmes de formation bas\u00e9s sur le mod\u00e8le suisse . En septembre 2020 , Zurich Insurance a remport\u00e9 l\u2019un des neuf Pledge to America\u2019s Workers Presidential Awards . Ces prix distinguent des organisations qui fournissent un travail remarquable dans la formation de la main - d\u2019\u0153uvre . En automne 2020 , Zurich Insurance a \u00e9tendu son programme de mani\u00e8re \u00e0 le proposer non seulement \u00e0 Chicago mais aussi \u00e0 New York City . En tant que cofondatrice du Chicago Apprenticeship Network et de l\u2019Insurance Apprenticeship USA , elle aide d\u2019autres entreprises \u00e0 explorer les possibilit\u00e9s qu\u2019offre la formation professionnelle . Memorandum of Understanding Concerning Cooperation on Advancing Apprenticeship , Career and Technical Education , and Vocational and Professional Education and Training

sentence1: Technological Developments for Space Exploration \u00a9 ESA / Bcomp Space exploration requires extremely sophisticated technologies that continuously expand the boundaries of what is possible . Satellites and on - board instruments are expected to function flawlessly , often over a period of several years . For obvious reasons , repairs or maintenance in space are not possible . Satellites and instruments must be able to resist extreme vibration during take - off . Once in orbit , they must also withstand cosmic radiation and very strong variations in temperature . In addition , they must be as light and compact as possible so that they can be launched into space more easily . The scientific instruments installed on satellites often use innovative measuring techniques that require pioneering technologies . To meet all these specifications and enable the European space industry to remain competitive , the European Space Agency ( ESA ) has established long - term technology programmes to support lasting research and development . The ongoing development and standardisation of new technologies are crucial factors in successful and long - term technological innovation . SERI\u2019s Swiss Space Office supports the drivers of technological development , enabling them to acquire and preserve the expertise needed to become firmly established in a very competitive environment . Innovative technologies bring great added value when they make the transition from new to standardised technology . Technology transfer It is not rare for companies or research institutes to apply expertise developed in the space sector to other fields or use technologies from other areas for space science . This is referred to as \ spin - off \ or \ technology transfer \ operations . In Switzerland , there have been several cases of successful technology transfer . One example is the company bcomp , which has successfully adapted its natural fibre - based composite materials for use in space . In the future , this will make it possible to build rocket components and satellites that burn up better and more thoroughly when they re - enter the earth\u2019s atmosphere at the end of their mission \u2013 a technology that contributes to a cleaner world . Main technological priorities for Switzerland In line with its space policy , Switzerland also pursues a niche strategy when it comes to technological development . It seeks to achieve - or defend and consolidate - a leading international position in specific sectors . To this end , Switzerland has established five technological priorities : Link Technology Transfer Natural fibres threaded into satellites for safer missions Contact SBFI , Aur\u00e9lie Pezous T + 41 58 465 31 99 Shopping cart
sentence2: D\u00e9veloppements technologiques pour l ' exploration spatiale \u00a9 ESA / Bcomp L\u2019exploration spatiale fait appel aux technologies les plus pointues et elle repousse sans cesse les limites du possible . Pour des raisons \u00e9videntes , une r\u00e9paration ou une maintenance en orbite n\u2019est pas envisageable . Les satellites et les instruments doivent r\u00e9sister \u00e0 des vibrations extr\u00eames lors du lancement , et une fois en orbite , au rayonnement cosmique et \u00e0 de tr\u00e8s fortes variations de temp\u00e9rature . \u00c0 ces contraintes s\u2019ajoutent celles du poids et du volume qu\u2019il s\u2019agit de minimiser pour la mise en orbite . Les instruments scientifiques qui \u00e9quipent les satellites recourent souvent \u00e0 des m\u00e9thodes d\u2019observation novatrices qui font appel \u00e0 des technologies in\u00e9dites . Une technologie innovante d\u00e9gage une forte valeur ajout\u00e9e lorsqu\u2019elle passe du statut de nouvelle technologie \u00e0 celle de technologie de base ( standardisation ) . On parle dans ce cas de \u00abspinning out\u00bb et de \u00abspinning in\u00bb ( transfert de technologie ) . Cette technologie contribue ainsi \u00e0 une Terre plus propre . sentence1: Swiss Innovation Park The Swiss Innovation Park plays a part in reinforcing Switzerland\u2019s leading position as a location for innovation and maintaining the country\u2019s economic competitiveness . It began operations in early 2016 , with two network locations centred on the two federal institutes of technology in Zurich and Lausanne and four further sites in Aargau , Northwestern Switzerland , Biel and Eastern Switzerland . The Confederation plays a subsidiary role in the innovation park . The Swiss Innovation Park is a private - public partnership of national importance funded and operated by the Confederation and cantons , science community and the private sector . Its purpose is to develop private research and development investment in Switzerland and so provide a valuable addition to the established funding instruments in Switzerland . This new approach seeks to make Switzerland attractive to international research and development players by providing developed parcels of land and floor space with expansion potential in the vicinity of existing higher education institutions and businesses . Ongoing expansion VDK In 2014 the Federal Council approved the configuration proposed by the Conference of Cantonal Directors of Economic Affairs ( ) in 2014 . Under this proposal , the innovation park would have two main locations centred on the two federal institutes of technology including two sites in Aargau and Northwestern Switzerland , forming a single network . In May 2015 the Federal Council decided to add Biel to this configuration . In April 2021 the Federal Council approved a further site in Eastern Switzerland as the sixth component of the Swiss Innovation Park network . In the same year , the Central Switzerland innovation park and the Ticino innovation park were added to the national network under the auspices of the Switzerland Innovation Park Zurich . Federal measures The current federal funding instruments for research and innovation can also be used for activities at the Swiss Innovation Park ' s sites . The Confederation has two further measures to provide additional funding for the park : Foundation as umbrella organisation The Confederation does not play an operative role in the Swiss Innovation Park . This is assumed by the Swiss Innovation Park Foundation . The foundation coordinates and promotes networking among the park ' s sites , raises its profile in an international context and plays its role in promoting Switzerland as a location for science and innovation along with other players such as Switzerland Global Enterprise and Innosuisse . The foundation act as an interface to the Confederation and is responsible for the further development of the park . The network locations and site hosts are primarily funded by the site cantons and private investors in a public - private partnership . The cantons and private sources fund the operation and maintenance as well as the provision of premises for businesses . The network locations and sites generate income from renting out premises and from service provision . The medium - term aim is for them to become self - financing . Il existe depuis 2016 et comprend deux entit\u00e9s en charge des sites situ\u00e9es \u00e0 proximit\u00e9 des \u00e9coles polytechniques f\u00e9d\u00e9rales de Lausanne et de Zurich ainsi que quatre autres implant\u00e9es en Argovie , dans le Nord - Ouest de la Suisse , \u00e0 Bienne et en Suisse orientale . Plusieurs sites r\u00e9gionaux sont rattach\u00e9s \u00e0 ces entit\u00e9s . Le r\u00f4le de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration dans le parc d\u2019innovation demeure subsidiaire . Le Parc suisse d\u2019innovation est une initiative d\u2019importance nationale reposant sur un partenariat public - priv\u00e9 entre le monde politique ( Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration et cantons ) , les milieux scientifiques et l\u2019\u00e9conomie priv\u00e9e . Il aide notre pays \u00e0 d\u00e9velopper les investissements priv\u00e9s dans la recherche et le d\u00e9veloppement en Suisse et vient compl\u00e9ter les instruments d\u2019encouragement existants . Rendre la Suisse plus attrayante au niveau international pour des entit\u00e9s de recherche et d\u00e9veloppement en mettant \u00e0 leur disposition des surfaces enti\u00e8rement viabilis\u00e9es ( terrains \u00e0 b\u00e2tir ou surfaces de planchers ) \u00e0 proximit\u00e9 de hautes \u00e9coles et d\u2019entreprises pour qu\u2019elles puissent s\u2019y installer et \u00e9tendre leurs activit\u00e9s : voil\u00e0 l\u2019approche nouvelle . Un r\u00e9seau en constante \u00e9volution CDEP Le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral avait approuv\u00e9 en 2014 la configuration initiale propos\u00e9e par la Conf\u00e9rence des chefs des d\u00e9partements cantonaux de l\u2019\u00e9conomie publique ( ) . Cette configuration comprenait des entit\u00e9s en charge des sites situ\u00e9es \u00e0 proximit\u00e9 des deux \u00e9coles polytechniques f\u00e9d\u00e9rales de Lausanne et Zurich , dans le canton d\u2019Argovie et dans le Nord - Ouest de la Suisse , l\u2019objectif \u00e9tant de former un r\u00e9seau . \u00c0 la suite d\u2019une proc\u00e9dure de s\u00e9lection compl\u00e9mentaire , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a d\u00e9cid\u00e9 en mai 2015 d\u2019ajouter l\u2019entit\u00e9 \u00abSwitzerland Innovation Park Biel / Bienne\u00bb \u00e0 la configuration de d\u00e9part . En avril 2021 , le Conseil f\u00e9d\u00e9ral a approuv\u00e9 l\u2019admission de \u00abInnovation Park East\u00bb dans le Parc suisse d\u2019innovation en tant que sixi\u00e8me entit\u00e9 en charge des sites . Cette m\u00eame ann\u00e9e a \u00e9galement vu l\u2019admission des sites de la Suisse centrale et du Tessin dans le Parc suisse d\u2019innovation et leur rattachement \u00e0 l\u2019entit\u00e9 \u00abSwitzerland Innovation Park Zurich\u00bb . Les mesures de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration Les instruments existants de l\u2019encouragement de la recherche et de l\u2019innovation par la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration permettent aussi en soi de soutenir des activit\u00e9s sur les sites du Parc suisse d\u2019innovation . La Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration pr\u00e9voit en outre deux autres mesures pour apporter un soutien suppl\u00e9mentaire \u00e0 la r\u00e9alisation du parc d\u2019innovation : Une fondation comme organisation fa\u00eeti\u00e8re Aucun r\u00f4le op\u00e9rationnel pour le parc d\u2019innovation n\u2019a \u00e9t\u00e9 confi\u00e9 \u00e0 la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration . Cette responsabilit\u00e9 est assum\u00e9e par la fondation \u00abSwitzerland Innovation\u00bb . Interlocutrice de la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration pour toutes les questions li\u00e9es au Parc suisse d\u2019innovation , la fondation \u0153uvre au d\u00e9veloppement du parc en assumant les missions suivantes : mettre en r\u00e9seau et coordonner les diff\u00e9rentes entit\u00e9s en charge des sites , asseoir la place du parc face \u00e0 la concurrence mondiale et contribuer avec d\u2019autres acteurs ( p . ex . Switzerland Global Enterprise et Innosuisse ) \u00e0 la promotion \u00e9conomique et \u00e0 l\u2019encouragement de l\u2019innovation en Suisse . Les entit\u00e9s en charge des sites sont financ\u00e9es par les cantons d\u2019implantation et par des investisseurs priv\u00e9s sur le mod\u00e8le du partenariat public - priv\u00e9 . Les charges d\u2019exploitation et d\u2019entretien des sites de m\u00eame que celles li\u00e9es \u00e0 la mise \u00e0 disposition de surfaces \u00e0 l\u2019intention des entreprises qui souhaitent s\u2019installer sont assum\u00e9es par les cantons et par des sources priv\u00e9es . Les sites sont cens\u00e9s acqu\u00e9rir une autonomie financi\u00e8re \u00e0 moyen terme en louant des surfaces et en fournissant diverses prestations . sentence1: Vocational , Professional and Continuing Education The Swiss system of vocational and professional education and training ( VPET system ) not only prepares young people for entry into the labour market , it also paves the way for the next generation of skilled workers and managers . Training is closely correlated with the needs of the labour market and formally anchored within the education system at both upper - secondary and tertiary level . Moreover , there are many different continuing education and training courses to sustain lifelong learning . These courses enable adults to gain new skills and reorient their careers if desired . The State Secretariat for Education , Research and Innovation ( SERI ) works with the cantons , professional organisations and other partners to provide a comprehensive range of appealing training options that prepare people for the future . Focus Swiss VPET System \u2013 A Brief Guide brochure online platform The new brochure explains the key features of the Swiss VPET system and provide readers to facts and statistics , which have been published on a new . List of Vocational and Professional Qualifications The List of Vocational and Professional Qualifications provides an overview of all professional activities for which training is provided under the Federal Act on Vocational and Professional Education and Training ( VPETA ) . Swiss education system Vocational , professional and continuing education courses are designed for different skill levels and address the needs of different age groups . Partnership dynamics within VPET system The three main partners within the Swiss VPET system ( namely the Confederation , the cantons and professional organisations ) work together to maintain consistently high - quality training within the system . Project support Projects subsidised by the Confederation help to further develop and expand forward - looking structures within the Swiss VPET system . Federal subsidies for professional education The Confederation provides financial support to those who complete preparatory training for a federal examination to obtain a professional qualification . Sustainable development Suitable job profiles and training options are needed for sustainable development . The Swiss VPET system contributes to this endeavour . Teachers , trainers and instructors SERI is responsible for recognising training programmes for workplace trainers , branch course instructors and vocational school teachers . VPET research The knowledge gained from federally funded research in this field can be used to further develop and strategically manage the Swiss VPET system . Explosives SERI is responsible for the drafting and adaptation of guidelines and regulations on the handling and management of quality of explosives . sentence2: Formation professionnelle et continue Actualit\u00e9s D\u00e9veloppement durable dans la formation professionnelle et continue Afin d\u2019encourager les partenaires de la formation professionnelle \u00e0 exploiter leurs marges de man\u0153uvre et de les soutenir en ce sens , le SEFRI a d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 le Programme de promotion \u00ab D\u00e9veloppement durable dans la formation professionnelle et continue \u00bb . La formation professionnelle suisse en bref brochure plateforme en ligne La nouvelle brochure explique les points essentiels du syst\u00e8me suisse de formation professionnelle et renvoie \u00e0 des faits ainsi qu ' \u00e0 des statistiques sur une \u00e9galement nouvelle . Positionnement des \u00e9coles sup\u00e9rieures Le projet \u00abPositionnement des \u00e9coles sup\u00e9rieures\u00bb pr\u00e9voit un examen global du positionnement national et international des \u00e9coles sup\u00e9rieures ( ES ) et des fili\u00e8res de formation ES . Formation professionnelle et continue La formation professionnelle permet aux jeunes de prendre pied dans le monde du travail et assure la rel\u00e8ve en formant des professionnels et des cadres qualifi\u00e9s . Elle est orient\u00e9e vers le march\u00e9 du travail et int\u00e9gr\u00e9e au syst\u00e8me \u00e9ducatif . La formation professionnelle s\u2019inscrit au degr\u00e9 secondaire II et au degr\u00e9 tertiaire . L\u2019apprentissage tout au long de la vie , un programme en soi : les adultes peuvent changer et \u00e9voluer professionnellement gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 une large offre de formation continue . Le Secr\u00e9tariat d\u2019\u00c9tat \u00e0 la formation , \u00e0 la recherche et \u00e0 l\u2019innovation s\u2019engage , en collaboration avec les cantons , les organisations du monde du travail et d\u2019autres partenaires , en faveur d\u2019une offre de formation attrayante et porteuse d\u2019avenir . En point de mire Liste des professions La liste des professions offre une vue d\u2019ensemble des professions en vigueur et r\u00e9gies par la loi f\u00e9d\u00e9rale sur la formation professionnelle ( LFPr ) . Syst\u00e8me \u00e9ducatif suisse Les offres de la formation professionnelle et de la formation continue prennent en compte les capacit\u00e9s diff\u00e9rentes des personnes en formation et les besoins sp\u00e9cifiques de chaque classe d\u2019\u00e2ge . Partenariat de la formation professionnelle La Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration , les cantons et les organisations du monde du travail s\u2019engagent conjointement en faveur d\u2019une formation professionnelle de grande qualit\u00e9 . Encouragement de projets Les projets subventionn\u00e9s par la Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration contribuent au d\u00e9veloppement et \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9laboration de structures tourn\u00e9es vers l\u2019avenir dans la formation professionnelle . Subventions f\u00e9d\u00e9rales dans la formation professionnelle sup\u00e9rieure La Conf\u00e9d\u00e9ration apporte une aide financi\u00e8re aux personnes qui suivent des cours pr\u00e9paratoires aux examens f\u00e9d\u00e9raux . D\u00e9veloppement durable La mise en \u0153uvre d\u2019un d\u00e9veloppement durable implique des profils professionnels et des offres de formation adapt\u00e9s . La formation professionnelle apporte sa contribution \u00e0 cet \u00e9gard . Responsables de la formation professionnelle La reconnaissance des fili\u00e8res de formation destin\u00e9es aux responsables de la formation professionnelle est du ressort du SEFRI . Les responsables de la formation professionnelle sont charg\u00e9s de former des apprentis dans les trois lieux de formation ( entreprise formatrice , cours interentreprises , \u00e9cole professionnelle ) . Recherche sur la formation professionnelle La recherche sur la formation professionnelle permet d\u2019acqu\u00e9rir des connaissances en vue du d\u00e9veloppement et du pilotage de la formation professionnelle en Suisse . Service des explosifs Le SEFRI est charg\u00e9 de la mise \u00e0 jour de la documentation et des prescriptions en mati\u00e8re de minage ainsi que de la mise sur pied d\u2019un management de la qualit\u00e9 dans ce domaine . sentence1: EU Framework Programmes for Research and Innovation The European Framework Programmes for Research and Innovation are the European Union ' s ( EU ) main instruments for implementing its common scientific and innovation policy . The current , ninth Framework Programme , \ Horizon Europe \ , runs from 2021 to 2027 and has a total budget of around EUR 95 . 5 billion . Horizon Europe officially began on 12 May 2021 , but came into retroactive effect from 1 January 2021 . Legal basis The EU ' s research and innovation policy , which is set out in the former treaties of Maastricht and Amsterdam and the currently valid Lisbon Treaty , aims to make research in Europe a transnational activity , wherever appropriate . The intention is to share costs and pool resources for large - scale projects and to work together to find solutions to problems affecting the whole of Europe . Horizon Europe The first EU Framework Programmes for Research and Innovation were introduced in 1984 . Up to and including the sixth generation ( 2003\u20132006 ) , the programmes ran over a period of four or five years . Since 2007 , they have run for seven years . The ninth programme was launched under the name of \ \ at the beginning of 2021 . Funding Funding of the EU Framework Programmes for Research and Innovation ( FPRI ) is drawn from the regular contributions made by EU Member States to the EU . In addition , associated countries that have concluded an agreement with the EU on their participation in the FPRI contribute to the programme through a compulsory contribution to the EU . The amount of this contribution is set out in the respective association agreement and was determined in the past by a GDP key . Overview of all Framework Programmes Since their inception , FPRI budgets have continuously grown and the thematic priorities and instruments have been adapted according to social and political needs in Europe . Further information on these developments is provided in the . Project proposals EU ' s Funding and Tenders Portal Project proposals for the EU Framework Programmes for Research and Innovation are submitted by researchers and innovators from one or several states working together , generally in response to specific EU research calls . These project proposals are reviewed by independent experts . Information about currently open calls and funding opportunities is published here . Swiss participation Overview of all Framework Programmes 1 January 2004 is an important milestone in terms of Switzerland ' s participation in the EU Framework Programmes for Research and Innovation ( FPRI ) . Before then , Swiss researchers taking part in FPRI projects had limited rights and received their funding directly from the Confederation . As of 2004 , a corresponding bilateral agreement with the EU enabled Switzerland to participate in the 6th RPFI and the Euratom Research and Training Programme as an associated country with all rights and obligations . A similar bilateral agreement for full Swiss involvement in the 7th FPRI ( 2007\u20132013 ) was also concluded ( see ) . European Research Area With associated country status , Switzerland was entitled to be represented in the project committees and the various steering committees . This gave Switzerland direct access to information and meant it could be involved in developing the current programme and in shaping future EU Framework Programmes and the ( ERA ) . Horizon 2020 Full Swiss association was also planned for the 8th FPRI ( package including Euratom ) . Following the outcome of the popular vote of 9 February 2014 on the mass immigration initiative and subsequent failure to sign the Croatia Protocol , the European Commission denied Switzerland full association to . An agreement on partial association was signed instead on 5 December 2014 , with retroactive effect from 15 September 2014 . This partial association agreement remained in place until the end of 2016 . Switzerland thus continued to take part as an associated state in certain aspects of until it became a fully associated member of the package including Euratom from 1 January 2017 ( see ) . Horizon Europe The latest , 9th FPRI ( ) officially began on 12 May 2021 but came into retroactive effect from 1 January 2021 . The specific conditions for Switzerland\u2019s association will be set out in a separate EU negotiation mandate . Currently , Switzerland participates in and other related programmes and initiatives as a non - associated third country until further notice . This status can be modified ( see ) . Facts and figures on the Swiss participation A look at the 8th FPRI ( 2014\u20132020 ) shows that researchers from Switzerland were also very successful in competing for EU research funds during those years : around CHF 3 . 043 billion in funding was allocated to Switzerland . In the list of participating countries by level of funding , Switzerland ranks eighth and first among the associated countries . Of all the projects submitted , the Swiss projects also had the highest success rate . This is mainly due to the success in European Research Council ( ERC ) individual projects and the Marie Sk\u0142odowska - Curie Actions ( MSCA ) , which account for a large proportion of Swiss participation . In a global comparison for Horizon 2020 , Switzerland is clearly at the top in terms of success rates for individual projects . Within Horizon Europe , Switzerland has so far recorded 1144 project participations and funding commitments amounting to CHF 564 million ( as of October 2023 ) . However , the available data on Horizon Europe are provisional and should be interpreted with caution . The data for the first year of the programme ( 2021 ) are not yet complete and only limited data are available for the calls for 2023 . Facts and figures on the Swiss participation For further information on Swiss FPRI participation and its importance for Switzerland see . The role of SERI The State Secretariat for Education , Research and Innovation ( SERI ) represents Switzerland and defines the strategic and operative measures necessary for Swiss participation in the EU Framework Programmes . It promotes Swiss interests in the various programme committees of the European Commission and helps shape the strategic orientation of initiatives and programmes . In addition , it monitors the evaluation procedures of the EU Framework Programmes for Research and Innovation and represents Switzerland in the European Research Area ( ERA ) and its associated bodies . Euresearch SERI mandates and funds the information network , which provides practical information and advice to researchers and innovators from the private and public sector interested taking part in EU Framework Programmes .
